papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实机器人上验证了有效的人到机器人迁移，以及对未见任务和环境的强泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ThinkWorld框架，引入链式动力学（CoD）作为跨具身的动作表示，并通过世界想象强化学习利用无动作标注的人类视频，实现有效的人机迁移和泛化。
analysis.method: 将每个动作思维表示为离散运动token序列（Chain-of-Dynamics），先用机器人演示初始化，再预测未来状态并与观察结果比对进行强化，从而让无标注视频提供监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ThinkWorld框架，通过链式动力学表示动作推理，并利用世界想象强化学习从未标注人类视频中学习，提升VLA模型的泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，提出动作推理与世界动力学相结合的框架，并通过世界想象强化学习提升策略学习，与本站VLA和世界模型主题高度相关。

figures.caption: We introduce ThinkWorld , a vision-language-action framework that learns transferable Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) reasoning from diverse human and robot experiences. CoD captures action-induced dynamics across embodiments and is reinforced through future imagination, enabling robust generalization in the real world and skill composition guided by human videos.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: ThinkWorld architecture and training stages. In stage (a), supervised fine-tuning (SFT) tokenizes robot actions and annotated human hand motions into a unified discrete motion space to ground Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD) reasoning, while CoD-conditioned imagination predicts the future visual feature. In stage (b), reinforcement learning (RL) uses the alignment between imagined and observed futures as a scalable reward for CoD reasoning over human and robot videos, strengthening action reasoning without motion annotations and improving guidance for continuous control.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.title_zh: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化链式动力学推理的视觉-语言-动作学习框架

papers.abstract: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ

analysis.key_results: 在九项指标平均上，比 UniAR 和 Emu3-Chat 分别提高 22.8% 和 59.2%；据作者所知，是首个在细粒度 OCR 任务上与强连续表示模型（如 Qwen3-VL）具有竞争力的离散表示模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ)，通过对称并行码本量化互补的固定维度视图，缓解离散视觉令牌的饱和问题，实现接近连续表示的语义保真度。
analysis.method: Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ)：使用对称并行码本量化互补的固定维度视觉特征视图。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过提出分解向量量化（FVQ）方法，证明离散视觉令牌在增加有效比特预算后可在多模态理解上达到与连续表示相当的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究离散视觉表示的量化方法及其语义保真度，属于通用视觉-语言模型范畴。它未涉及机器人动作预测、世界模型或视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，与 VLA/WAM 无直接关系，但所提出的量化方法对多模态模型的推理效率与表示压缩具有潜在的方法论价值。

FVQ continues to improve in the high-budget regime and reaches the continuous QwenViT baseline, whereas existing multi-codebook quantizers saturate. (b) Qualitative examples of text recognition at increasing bit budgets. Higher budgets progressively recover the fine-grained textual information required for correct predictions; green and red denote correct and incorrect answers, respectively.

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.title_zh: 离散令牌能否作为视觉信号的语义无损表示？

papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.

analysis.key_results: 在多个视频基准上验证了有效性，尤其在需要细粒度视觉证据的任务上表现更好。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 VideoLVR，在推理过程中构建潜在视觉证据以缓解视觉遗忘，并统一视觉证据重建与文本生成；进一步将方法扩展到强化学习。
analysis.method: 从相关视频时刻的局部区域构造潜在视觉证据，使用视觉 token 预测目标统一视觉重建与文本生成，并将采样视觉 token 作为动作与文本 token 联合优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VideoLVR 通过构建局部区域的潜在视觉证据来支持视频推理，并引入视觉 token 预测目标，在不过度扩展多模态上下文的情况下提升视频理解。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法属于视觉语言模型的视频推理效率优化，虽未直接涉及机器人动作预测或操控，但其对视频中视觉证据的潜在压缩与高效复用，对视觉语言动作模型或机器人世界模型的视觉记忆机制具有一定的参考价值。

figures.caption: Overview of VideoLVR. (a) A teacher MLLM synthesizes evidence-grounded reasoning trajectories through rejection sampling and trajectory polishing. (b) Visual tokens from regions supporting the same reasoning step are grouped and ordered by timestamp to form latent targets. VideoLVR jointly trains text generation with next-token prediction and latent visual evidence generation with visual token prediction over the input-video visual vocabulary. (c) At inference with the supervised model, each decoder hidden state is projected into a latent visual state and fed back as the input for the next decoding step, enabling autoregressive reasoning over latent visual evidence without additional visual observations.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Effect of the inference-time latent-step budget on five video benchmarks. Enlarged markers denote the best results.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
papers.title_zh: VideoLVR：基于定位视频证据的潜在视觉推理

papers.abstract: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one told the true cause. A VLM's internal state carries the late hand almost perfectly, along a direction no closer to the one its answer reads than a random one; whether the answer reports it depends on the wording of the question.

analysis.key_results: 工具滑脱可通过工具手传感读出；哪只手滞后需双臂传感；单手仅能读出自身延迟及部分对方延迟；当工具手滞后时，被动传感无法辨识是否同时推压过弱；VLM内部状态几乎完整携带滞后手信息，但该方向与回答所依赖的方向相差甚远，且回答是否报告取决于问题措辞。
analysis.main_contribution: 系统评估了视觉语言模型在双臂工具操作故障诊断中的能力，量化了不同传感器配置下故障原因的辨识性，并揭示了VLM内部状态与回答一致性之间的差距。
analysis.method: 在模拟双臂工具使用任务中设置多种故障类型，通过扰动成功演示生成故障样本，利用记录轨迹读取真实故障原因，测量各传感通道的诊断信息量，并对VLM的内部表征与输出行为进行分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文研究基于视觉语言模型的故障诊断器在双臂工具使用任务中的表现，分析不同传感通道对故障原因的辨识能力，并探讨VLM内部状态与最终回答之间的关系。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人操作故障诊断中的应用，属于VLA相关的评估与机理分析，虽然未涉及世界模型或动作预测，但对VLA在双臂操作中的可靠性和可解释性具有方法学价值。

A late attempt whose push was also below the hidden threshold τ \tau has the same frames and two causes.

papers.abstract: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboFactory 上平均成功率达 74.0%，比最强基线高 23.7 个百分点；在四个真实机器人任务上平均成功率达 78.8%，高出 13.8 个百分点；在 RoboCasa365 上总体得分为 58.08%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 World Dreamer v5-lite，一个面向多机器人控制的世界-动作模型，利用共享世界状态和姿势感知查询来实现机器人特定的动作预测。
analysis.method: 使用预训练视频编码器在共享工作空间坐标中构建固定大小的世界状态，由视觉语言模型提供场景上下文并为每个机器人生成查询；采用掩码视图协作训练，随机隐藏部分相机视图以鼓励利用其他机器人共享的观测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种多机器人世界-动作模型，通过共享世界状态实现机器人间空间对应和协作，在大规模多机器人数据上取得显著提升。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究世界-动作模型（WAM），面向多机器人设置，属于本站高度关注的主题；它扩展了单一机器人的 VLA/WAM 到多机器人协作场景，引入共享世界状态和跨机器人信息交互，对机器人世界建模和策略学习具有直接价值。

figures.caption: Overall architecture of World Dreamer v5-lite. Multi-robot images and language tokens enter the vision–language model (VLM) before the learnable agent queries, yielding a scene-prefix key/value (KV) cache and one hidden state per robot query. The video strip depicts a temporal window: observed video latents are encoded and combined with camera geometry to build the shared world state ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} ; future latents supply training supervision only. The Action Decoder uses the VLM outputs, ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} , proprioception, and multi-robot noisy actions to predict a flow velocity for each robot.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Constructing the shared world state ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} . Observed video tokens from available views are placed in 3D using the intrinsics K K , the extrinsics, and optional depth. Each token is fused with its geometric embedding ( + + ) and written to the XY, XZ, and YZ planes. The right-hand panels schematically show how ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} is updated over successive observed frames.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer
papers.title_zh: World Dreamer v5-lite：一种多机器人世界-动作模型，共享一个梦境

papers.abstract: Integrated sensing and communication allows wireless networks to recognize human activity from the channel estimates that the receiver computes anyway. The inference, however, runs on the general-purpose processors of the base station, access point or handset, which are the first components a device switches off to save energy. Always-on sensing therefore requires a classifier that is small enough to remain powered while the rest of the system sleeps. We investigate whether Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can provide such a classifier. To this end, we generate SNN accelerators for micro-Doppler activity recognition on the public DISC dataset (IEEE 802.11ay at 60 GHz) with the open-source Spiker+ framework, and implement them together with a spike encoder on a ZCU208 RFSoC, so that the complete chain from micro-Doppler frame to activity label runs in programmable logic. A fully connected SNN with 132 neurons achieves 94.7 % accuracy (90.7 % macro-F1) on unseen subjects and performs an inference in 206 microseconds. Compared to conventional networks of the same topology on the same device, it requires an eighth of the logic and 3.4X less dynamic energy per decision than a network fed the same binary spikes, at comparable accuracy, and 7.6X less than a network fed the 16-bit spectrogram, at 1.2 points lower accuracy. Quantization-aware training reduces its weights to 3 bits within half a percentage point of the 6-bit network at the same encoder threshold

analysis.key_results: 全连接SNN（132个神经元）在未见受试者上达到94.7%准确率（90.7%宏F1），单次推理耗时206微秒；相比同拓扑传统网络，逻辑资源减少至八分之一，动态能耗降低3.4倍（相比输入二进制脉冲）和7.6倍（相比输入16位频谱图），准确率仅降低1.2个百分点；量化感知训练将权重量化至3比特，准确率较6比特网络下降不超过0.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实现了一种脉冲神经网络加速器，使微多普勒活动识别可在ZCU208 RFSoC的可编程逻辑上运行，实现低功耗、小面积和快速推理。
analysis.method: 使用Spiker+框架生成SNN加速器，结合脉冲编码器在可编程逻辑上实现从微多普勒帧到活动标签的完整处理链，并采用量化感知训练降低权重量化比特。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文设计并测量了一种基于脉冲神经网络的低功耗活动识别分类器，用于毫米波感知通信一体化系统中的微多普勒活动识别。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于无线感知网络中的高效推理，提出了一种脉冲神经网络加速器，并应用于微多普勒活动识别。该工作与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型、世界-动作模型（WAM）或机器人操作无直接关系，但其在模型量化与高效推理方面的技术可为机器人领域中的高效模型部署提供参考。

papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

analysis.key_results: 在四个仿真基准上取得成功率：LIBERO 99.3%，LIBERO-Plus 89.9%，RoboTwin 2.0 93.6%，SimplerEnv 81.5%；消融实验表明世界模型监督改善未来预测，并评估了子任务条件、未来物体姿态监督和 ECoT 训练的影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PDRVLA，在 VLA 中引入轻量物理动力学模块，利用未来 RGB、深度和光流特征预测及冻结视频世界模型监督，增强物理理解，而无需在控制回路中进行视频生成。
analysis.method: 从视觉-语言特征中提取物理 token，直接预测未来 RGB、深度和光流特征，通过冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督；训练数据结合人-机器人合成、子任务标注和具身思维链（ECoT）扩展。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PDRVLA 通过轻量物理动力学模块将未来视觉特征预测蒸馏到 VLA 模型中，避免在线视频生成延迟，提升机器人动作生成性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于 VLA 模型范畴，融合视频世界模型知识以增强物理动力学表征，但不进行在线视频生成，与机器人世界模型（WAM）密切相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.

analysis.key_results: 在六个受限仿真环境中，VLA-Stem平均无碰撞任务成功率为52.8%，最强安全基线为23.7%；在无障碍设置中保持基础策略性能；真实实验显示在静态和动态障碍下碰撞显著减少。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLA-Stem：一种轻量级、基于强化学习的安全机制，无需微调VLA策略即可在推理时对动作进行自适应修改，以应对空间约束和动态障碍，同时保留任务意图。
analysis.method: 将VLA动作块转换为运动参考，使用轨迹级引导保留空间意图；结合教师-学生蒸馏和课程学习训练Stem策略；推理时基于参考、机器人本体感知和局部障碍信息修改执行动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Stem，一种无需微调底层VLA策略的轻量级强化学习安全机制，在推理时自适应修改动作以处理空间约束和动态障碍。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型在动态和受限环境中的鲁棒执行问题，提出了一种无需微调的安全机制，对VLA在真实世界部署和与动作执行层结合具有直接价值。

figures.caption: This figure illustrates the biological motivation behind our method. The left side depicts the interaction between higher-level motor control and lower-level sensorimotor regulation: task-directed motor commands are continuously shaped by rapid responses to immediate physical conditions. In this functional analogy, higher-level task control and motor coordination correspond to the base VLA, while the brainstem-inspired lower-level regulation corresponds to our proposed VLA-Stem . The right side shows how VLA-Stem adapts the VLA-directed motion to bypass an obstacle while continuing toward the target object.

figures.caption: VLA-Stem pipeline. The teacher is trained using curriculum learning, progressing from reference trajectory following to static obstacle avoidance and then to dynamic obstacle avoidance, with gradually increasing difficulty. The teacher policy takes as input the trajectory sequence produced by the base VLA policy, robot proprioception, and obstacle information, and additionally leverages privileged task information about the target object to accelerate training. Finally, the teacher policy is used to distill a student policy, removing the dependence on task-specific privileged information at deployment.

papers.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

analysis.key_results: 在涵盖所有模态的综合嵌入基准上，EmbeddingGemma 2 建立了新的帕累托前沿，优于专用模型以及大2到12倍的模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，一个开源的多模态嵌入模型，统一表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合，并通过简化的逐层嵌入、多阶段课程学习以及灵活的效率设计（如选择性模态编码器加载、可调视觉令牌预算、截断嵌入维度、量化权重）取得了全面的质量与效率平衡。
analysis.method: 简化逐层嵌入；多阶段课程与模态及目标递进；选择性模态编码器加载；可调视觉令牌预算；截断嵌入维度；量化权重。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种统一的多模态嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2，通过多项效率设计（如量化权重）在多种模态基准上达到新的帕累托前沿。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦多模态嵌入的效率优化，其中量化权重与可调视觉令牌预算等方法对在资源受限环境下部署 VLA 或世界模型具有借鉴意义，但摘要未直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界建模。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.

analysis.key_results: 在域内外、短视距和长视距机器人操作任务上，AFIL在任务成功率和鲁棒性上均优于现有VLA基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AFIL框架，利用失败轨迹作为自适应负向引导，以提升扩散和流基VLA策略的性能。
analysis.method: AFIL使用预训练VLA在线生成失败rollout，联合训练双动作生成器（成功与失败），共享视觉语言骨干，并在采样时根据成功与失败分布的距离自适应调整动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出自适应失败知情学习框架AFIL，通过在线生成失败轨迹并联合训练成功与失败动作生成器来提升VLA策略的鲁棒性和任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA策略在机器人操作中的鲁棒性问题，提出利用失败轨迹的在线学习框架，属于VLA策略学习核心方向。

papers.abstract: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.

analysis.key_results: 在 0.1% 假阳性率下，n-gram=1 时检测到 79% 的蒸馏模型，n-gram=3 时为 45%，显著优于 token-level 基线（分别为 29% 和 1.3%）；水印信号在量化、剪枝和强化学习后训练后仍可存活。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现水印盆地这一持久信号，并基于此提出黑盒检测器 WM-Basin，无需访问模型权重或 logits 即可检测 API 蒸馏。
analysis.method: 利用固定干净探针模型将文本映射为梯度表示，投影出普通微调任务方向，并检验残差梯度与水印盆地是否对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种黑盒水印检测方法，通过探测模型输出的梯度表示与特定水印盆地对齐来识别被蒸馏的学生模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文不涉及 VLA 或 WAM，属于独立的大语言模型安全与检测工作；但其提出的黑盒检测框架可能对高效推理（如量化、剪枝等模型压缩手段）下的水印保留问题有借鉴价值。

figures.caption: The watermark basin. Training on watermarked traces moves the student into a persistent, key-specific watermark basin , whereas clean traces from the same teacher move it only along the task direction. Watermark Basin Alignment ( WM-Basin ) recovers this geometry from black-box outputs alone to detect distillation.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
papers.title_zh: 水印盆地：通过黑盒检测蒸馏大语言模型

papers.abstract: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.

analysis.key_results: 数据集包含69700个剪辑、1655小时、349.6百万帧，其中1358小时为连续两分钟序列；实验表明使用GameVerse训练能大幅延长交互式世界模型的生成时间。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了GameVerse数据集，填补了长时程交互式世界建模训练数据匮乏的空白，其规模、多样性和标注质量均超越现有数据集，并实验证明训练于该数据集能显著扩展交互式世界模型的时间范围。
analysis.method: 通过统一的流程进行场景一致分割、质量过滤、相机位姿估计和基于事件的字幕标注，为每个剪辑生成分钟级连贯的相机轨迹和区分静态场景与动态事件的字幕。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GameVerse是一个专为长时程交互式世界建模设计的分钟级游戏视频数据集，包含1655小时、349.6百万帧的多样化第一/第三人称游戏画面，并配有稳定的相机轨迹和事件对齐的细粒度字幕。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该数据集服务于交互式世界模型，虽然不直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界-动作模型（WAM），但长时程世界建模与机器人领域的WAM研究有潜在的方法论价值，可为训练更稳定的世界模型提供数据基础。

papers.abstract: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上超越匹配的FastWAM和ImageWAM，在RoboTwin上达到相似或略高的成功率；与FastWAM相比，JAM将成功率从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提升到98.2%/64.5%/91.4%；使用缓存foresight目标，JAM将每个样本每次更新的估计在线训练FLOPs降低73%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Just Action Model（JAM）统一框架，将VLA与WAM的差异分解为骨干初始化、应用于未来观测的目标以及推断时是否需要维护未来损失机制，并证明仅通过训练时未来监督（foresight loss）即可提升控制性能，无需视觉生成或额外推断模块。
analysis.method: JAM采用预训练视觉骨干加动作专家，联合动作损失与foresight损失训练；foresight损失通过一个训练后丢弃的预测头，用当前观测特征预测已记录未来的冻结编码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出统一框架JAM，将VLA与WAM解耦为骨干初始化、未来观测目标和推断时未来损失机制三个可分离选择，并通过训练时仅用未来预测头、推断时丢弃的方式提升控制性能并降低计算开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向VLA与WAM的整合，核心贡献是统一策略学习框架，通过解耦未来预测损失与推断时生成机制，在保持世界模型监督优势的同时消除推断开销，对机器人动作预测和世界建模具有直接的理论与实践价值。

The dashed loop shows generated future observations entering the action expert in some WAMs. (c) JAM uses foresight loss ℒ F \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{F}} across pretraining families, discards its supervision branch, and retains the corresponding action path.

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted actions via a learned, dimension-wise gating mechanism, adaptively rectifying erroneous spatial trajectories while preserving the policy's local reactivity. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art VLA architectures, GR00T N1.7, $\pi_{0.5}$, and StableVLA, demonstrate that R2A consistently and significantly enhances robustness against diverse contextual perturbations. R2A achieves absolute success rate improvements of up to +12% in simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0-Plus) and +40% in real-world deployments, without requiring any finetuning of the base policies. Project page: https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/

analysis.key_results: 在三个VLA架构（GR00T N1.7、π0.5、StableVLA）上，仿真基准（LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0-Plus）绝对成功率提升最高+12%，真实世界部署提升最高+40%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出R2A测试时扩展框架，在不微调基础VLA策略的前提下，利用训练演示中的几何运动基元图检索和门控融合，提升VLA对OOD视觉偏移的鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 构建离线时空运动基元图，推理时通过查询相关的图神经网络定位当前执行并检索未来运动基元，然后使用学习到的维度门控机制将检索到的几何先验与冻结VLA的预测动作融合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出R2A框架，将VLA策略的OOD鲁棒性构造成运动基元检索问题，通过离线时空运动基元图和图神经网络检索兼容未来运动基元，并用学习到的门控机制修正VLA预测动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向VLA策略的OOD鲁棒性问题，通过引入显式运动基元先验来修正VLA动作输出，属于VLA执行层面的改进，与本站VLA/WAM主题高度相关。

At test time, it projects OOD initial states back to the training manifold via diffusion, continuously retrieves context-aligned geometric priors 𝐀 t ref \mathbf{A}_{t}^{\text{ref}} via a kinematic query Q t Q_{t} , and harmonizes them with the frozen VLA’s predictions 𝐀 t π \mathbf{A}_{t}^{\pi} via a dynamic gating matrix 𝐒 t \mathbf{S}_{t} to ensure robust execution under severe visual shifts.

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

analysis.key_results: 标准估计高估了原生样本的可选择空间；结构化动作扰动可增加高达16个百分点的可选择空间；想象未来与真实未来在携带候选结果信息方面无显著损失；选择器将闭环任务成功率从76.9%提高到81.6%（训练任务保留集），未见任务从62.6%提高到69.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于位级可复现分支、重复持续和共同随机数的去噪反事实协议，以准确测量WAM中可由选择器实现的可选择空间（selectable headroom），并构建失败门控选择器实现该空间。
analysis.method: 去噪反事实协议，结合位级可复现分支、重复延续、留出预言机和共同随机数；构建失败门控选择器，仅在WAM读出预测失败时偏离策略块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种去噪反事实协议来测量世界动作模型（WAM）中候选动作的可选择空间，并构建了一个失败门控选择器，在闭环中提升任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接研究世界动作模型（WAM）中通过测试时选择提高策略性能的方法，涉及动作生成、想象未来、闭环控制，对本站的WAM和机器人学习主题具有直接且核心的相关性。

papers.title: How Much Can Best-of-N Help a World Action Model? Measuring Selectable Headroom and Realizing It in Closed Loop
papers.title_zh: Best-of-N 对世界动作模型能有多大帮助？测量可选择空间并在闭环中实现

papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) incorporate the prediction of future observations into robot policy learning. However, most WAMs build on billion-parameter vision-language or video-generation backbones, which incur high training cost and inference latency. In this letter, we present GAWM (Geometry-Aware World Model), a compact multi-task WAM that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. GAWM compresses the features of each camera view into a small set of tokens. A lightweight predictor, conditioned on the task rather than on actions, forecasts these tokens at two future horizons. The forecast is supervised with the dense patch features of future frames, which requires it to encode the spatial layout of the future scene. An action decoder directly regresses a chunk of future actions from the current and predicted tokens. With fewer than 100M parameters and no robot or video pretraining, GAWM outperforms billion-parameter WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 and performs comparably to billion-parameter VLAs on LIBERO. On a dual-arm robot, it achieves lower action-prediction error on held-out demonstrations than a fine-tuned billion-parameter VLA, with substantially lower inference latency. Ablation studies show that the latent world model substantially improves performance when training data or training time is limited. Code is available at https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上超越十亿参数 WAM；在 LIBERO 上性能与十亿参数 VLA 相当；在双臂机器人 held-out 演示上动作预测误差低于微调的十亿参数 VLA，推理延迟显著降低；消融实验显示在训练数据或训练时间有限时，隐式世界模型能显著提升性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 GAWM（几何感知世界模型），一种紧凑型多任务世界-动作模型，利用冻结 DINOv3 潜在空间的轻量预测器和动作解码器，在极低参数（小于 100M）和零机器人/视频预训练条件下实现高性能动作预测。
analysis.method: 将每个相机视角的特征压缩为少量 token；轻量预测器以任务为条件（而非动作）预测两个未来时间步的 token；用未来帧稠密 patch 特征进行监督，从而编码未来场景空间布局；动作解码器从当前和预测 token 直接回归未来动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一种紧凑的多任务世界-动作模型 GAWM，在冻结的 DINOv3 编码器潜在空间中预测未来观测并直接回归动作序列，以极低参数量和推理延迟超越十亿参数级 WAM/VLA。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对世界-动作模型（WAM）和机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）领域，提出将高效隐式世界建模与动作预测结合的紧凑模型，在降低推理延迟和训练成本的同时保持高性能，与本站 VLA 和 WAM 主题高度相关。

The latent predictor, conditioned on the task code g k g_{k} , forecasts these tokens at two future horizons, and the action decoder directly regresses a chunk of future actions from the current tokens, the forecast, the robot state and the task code. Dashed panel: training only; a patch decoder maps the forecast to the encoder’s patch features of the recorded future frames (thumbnails as in Fig. 4 ).

papers.title: GAWM: A Compact Latent World-Action Model for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: GAWM：一种面向多任务机器人操作的小型隐式世界-动作模型

papers.abstract: Self-supervised vision transformers are increasingly used as reusable encoders for Earth observation, but their inference cost on the hardware available in the field is rarely characterized. We deploy a pretrained SAR-optical masked-autoencoder encoder on three commodity x86 nodes, from a low-power CPU without AVX2 to an AVX2+VNNI reference, at FP32, FP16 and INT8 on the CPU and, where present, the integrated GPU, and report latency, energy (RAPL and wall plug) and linear-probe accuracy. Quantization is accuracy-neutral: INT8 changes micro-mAP by only +0.0006, within the seed spread, so precision becomes a pure cost decision. INT8 lowers CPU latency on every node, by 1.45x even on the CPU without AVX2, and CPU energy wherever it is measured, and the VNNI reference (1.53x) suggests a further gain beyond AVX2. The Pareto-optimal device shifts from the integrated GPU, which is 4.38x faster than the CPU on the weakest node, to the CPU as the CPU class improves.

analysis.key_results: INT8量化对准确率无负面影响，在CPU上最多降低1.45倍延迟，在AVX2+VNNI节点上降低1.53倍；集成GPU在弱节点上比CPU快4.38倍，但随着CPU改进，最优设备转向CPU。
analysis.main_contribution: 对自监督地球观测视觉Transformer编码器在不同精度和硬件上的推理成本进行了系统表征。
analysis.method: 在三台商用x86节点上部署预训练SAR-光学掩码自编码器编码器，测试FP32、FP16和INT8精度在CPU和可用集成GPU上的延迟、能耗和线性探针准确率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 部署一个预训练的SAR-光学掩码自编码器编码器到三台商用x86节点上，评估FP32、FP16和INT8精度下的延迟、能耗和线性探针准确率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系：本文关注地球观测编码器的量化边缘推理，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人技术。

figures.caption: Per-inference latency (ms, mean over R = 5 R=5 repetitions; log color scale) by node, device and precision. On the floor node the iGPU is the fastest device; on the step and reference nodes INT8 on the CPU is.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Quantized Edge Inference of a Self-Supervised SAR-Optical Encoder on Commodity x86 Hardware
papers.title_zh: 自监督SAR-光学编码器在商用x86硬件上的量化边缘推理

papers.abstract: Streaming multimodal assistants must make response decisions while events are still unfolding. They need to recognize when the available evidence warrants a response, produce an appropriate continuation, and remain silent otherwise. Supervised fine-tuning learns from recorded assistant turns, but does not directly train on the response prefixes produced by the evolving policy itself. We introduce Live-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation method that uses privileged hints available only during training to supervise the policy on its own outputs. The policy first generates a continuation from the streaming context alone. The same model then re-evaluates that continuation with a hint describing the relevant evidence, and the resulting distributions guide the unhinted policy. On Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, Live-OPSD attains an average score of 59.64 on LiveProBench, 5.26 points above the strongest continued-SFT baseline, and stays competitive on OVO-Bench (65.84). These results indicate that guiding the policy on its own outputs with privileged hints improves both when and how a streaming assistant responds.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B上，LiveProBench平均59.64分，比最强持续SFT基线高5.26分；OVO-Bench为65.84分。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入Live-OPSD在线策略自蒸馏方法，利用仅在训练时可用的特权提示来监督策略自身输出，从而改进流式助手的响应决策。
analysis.method: 先由策略仅依赖流式上下文生成延续，再由同一模型结合相关证据提示重新评估该延续，得到的分布指导无提示策略进行自蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Live-OPSD，一种用训练期特权提示对自身输出进行在线策略自蒸馏，以提升流式多模态助手响应时机与内容的方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究流式视频模型的自蒸馏推理改进，属于视觉-语言与视频领域，未直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）。其对流式多模态模型的在线策略优化方法可能对机器人流式决策有启发，但摘要未提及机器人或动作预测。

figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Supervision at streaming decision points. Each interleaved chunk or user turn carries a decision b t b_{t} and a privileged hint h t h_{t} . Streaming SFT learns the recorded action, whereas Live-OPSD supplies the hint only to the teacher.

papers.title: Live-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Proactive Streaming Large Video Models
papers.title_zh: Live-OPSD：面向主动流式大型视频模型的在线策略自蒸馏

papers.abstract: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell, a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM's own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future; they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell

analysis.key_results: 在五个交互式视觉环境中，Dwell 在可训练方法中实现了最强的整体性能，并大幅降低了想象所需的计算量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Dwell，一个基于模型的强化学习框架，将预训练视觉语言模型重新用作隐式空间中的世界模型和策略，实现高效的持续学习。
analysis.method: 将 VLM 作为递归隐式转移算子，在潜在空间中进行预测、调整和行动；利用 VLM 自身的表征，让智能体从真实交互中预测和评估动作结果，并从潜在想象中改进行为。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 Dwell 框架，将 VLM 重构为递归隐式转移算子，使智能体能够同时利用真实交互和隐式想象进行持续的策略改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文提出将视觉语言模型同时作为世界模型和策略，属于视觉语言动作（VLA）与世界模型（WAM）交叉的范畴，直接涉及基于 VLM 的智能体利用隐式世界模型进行动作预测和策略学习，与本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Overview of Dwell . Left: The VLM learns a recurrent latent world by matching action-conditioned priors to observation-conditioned posteriors, while grounding the latent states with a frozen V-JEPA2 encoder. Right: The same VLM backbone serves as both world model and policy, alternating online interaction with latent planning for policy improvement.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
papers.title_zh: 视觉语言智能体可以在自身的隐式世界中学习

papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

analysis.key_results: 在AndroidControl上，与相同输入的Qwen2.5-VL-7B代理相比，GUI-JEPA在相同GPU上速度提高2.8-4.0倍，参数仅为其6%，并达到86-92%的分布内准确率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GUI-JEPA，一种基于JEPA的无解码器GUI代理策略，在潜空间预测和评分候选动作，无需解码token。
analysis.method: 利用在无标签GUI截图上预训练的JEPA编码器，通过动作和区域条件的潜在预测器生成每个候选动作的潜在表示，再由轻量级头进行批量评分。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出第一个基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的无解码器GUI代理策略GUI-JEPA，在潜空间中选择动作，避免逐token解码，从而实现更快的推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于GUI代理的高效推理，不直接涉及VLA或世界模型。但其无解码器策略学习与潜在空间动作选择对机器人策略的高效推理可能具有方法论借鉴意义。

figures.caption: Overview of GUI-JEPA. Top: on a real AndroidControl step, the frozen JEPA encoder embeds the screenshot once, the residual predictor turns it into one latent per candidate in a single batch, and the structural head and the text matcher score every candidate (bars: a trained base policy’s probabilities on this step; grids are schematic). Bottom: the training stages, and scoring in one pass versus decoding token by token (measured in Section 4.5 ). Circled numbers mark the stage that trains each module (1: JEPA pretraining, 2: policy training, 3: text rankers on the fixed policy); flame = trained, snowflake = frozen; green marks the recorded (correct) action.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: GUI-JEPA：基于候选条件JEPA潜伏表示的快速移动GUI代理动作策略

papers.abstract: Robot foundation models may generalize across tasks and embodiments, but their actions still depend on sensors that can fail. When the policy is frozen or inaccessible, can an external monitor diagnose and repair corrupted inputs without access to its internals? We test a structured surrogate that separates periodic gait from sensor-dependent corrections to guide input repair around a frozen locomotion policy. On simulated Go2, offline diagnosis raises walking success from 259/640 to 429/640 episodes; online repair reaches 382/640, with no triggers in 64 held-out fault-free episodes. A matched boosted-tree surrogate predicts clean actions similarly well but yields no detected repair improvement over no repair. Separate fits improve walking on Go1 and ANYmal C, although phase-aware gradients perform better. Evidence remains limited to one policy and a partly screened simulated fault suite; robot foundation model and hardware validation remain open.

analysis.key_results: 在模拟Go2上离线诊断使行走成功率从259/640提高到429/640，在线修复达到382/640，在64个无故障保留回合中没有误触发；在Go1和ANYmal C上也有改善。
analysis.limitations: 证据仅限于一个策略和部分筛选的模拟故障集；机器人基础模型和硬件验证仍然开放。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种结构化代理模型，分离周期性步态与传感器相关修正，用于指导冻结运动策略的输入修复，提升故障条件下的行走成功率。
analysis.method: 结构化代理模型（将周期性步态与传感器相关修正分开）用于离线诊断和在线修复；与提升树代理模型进行对比。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究在不访问策略内部的情况下，通过结构化代理模型对冻结的机器人运动策略进行传感器故障诊断与输入修复。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文研究针对冻结机器人策略的输入诊断与修复，不直接涉及VLA或世界模型，但结构化代理模型分离环境依赖修正的思路可能对机器人世界建模和策略鲁棒性有方法学参考价值。

figures.caption: Method overview: Diagnosis and input repair. MBD identifies the faulty sensor from the structured surrogate’s per-sensor contributions, and PRR repairs its input before the frozen policy acts. For a + 0.3 +0.3 rear-left thigh-encoder offset: (a) the sensor explains 49% of the abnormal correction across 16 diagnosis logs; (b) PRR supplies its phase-matched healthy value; and (c) repair removes the sideways drift and raises walking success from 3/16 to 16/16 fresh episodes.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: When Black-Box Robot Policies Fail: Online Sensor Diagnosis and Repair with a Transparent Surrogate
papers.title_zh: 当黑盒机器人策略失效时：利用透明代理进行在线传感器诊断与修复

papers.abstract: Camouflaged object detection (COD) depends on weak texture and boundary cues that can be destroyed by aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ). Existing PTQ methods mainly optimize quantizers or reconstruct network blocks, while using a single precision-allocation domain throughout hierarchical backbones. Instead, we introduce AxisQ, a depth-adaptive bit-allocation framework motivated by the observation that the useful allocation axis changes with feature depth. Under a fixed per-layer average activation-bit budget, AxisQ allocates precision in the channel domain for shallow features and in the local-frequency domain for deep features, using COD-aware sensitivity to better preserve subtle foreground regions and ambiguous boundaries. We also formulate a boundary-aware Hessian approximation for reconstruction by incorporating boundary-weighted gradient and error statistics. Experiments across multiple COD models and diverse benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy over the strongest baselines at low bit widths, with relative weighted F-measure gains of 12.7% for CFRN and 33.3% for CamoFormer-P on CAMO under W2A2 quantization. These results support adapting the allocation domain to feature depth as a transferable quantization strategy for hierarchical COD models.

analysis.key_results: 在多个COD模型和基准上，低比特量化下优于最强基线；W2A2量化时在CAMO上CFRN的相对加权F-measure增益12.7%，CamoFormer-P增益33.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出深度自适应位宽分配框架AxisQ，根据特征深度切换分配域，并引入边界感知的Hessian近似来更好地保留细微前景区域和模糊边界。
analysis.method: AxisQ框架，在固定每层平均激活比特预算下，浅层特征在通道域分配精度，深层特征在局部频率域分配精度，同时使用COD感知敏感度和边界加权梯度误差统计的Hessian近似进行重构。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AxisQ框架，在固定激活比特预算下根据特征深度分别采用通道域和局部频率域进行量化位宽分配，并利用边界感知的Hessian近似进行重构，以提升伪装目标检测模型的低比特量化精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于伪装目标检测（COD）模型的后训练量化，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界建模。但其提出的深度自适应位宽分配和边界感知重构策略对于分层视觉骨干网络的量化具有方法论参考价值，可能对机器人视觉模型的轻量化部署有间接启发。

figures.caption: Qualitative comparison of quantization methods on two COD models at W2A2. Model A is CFRN, and Model B is CamoFormer-P. Each pair of rows corresponds to one model, with IoU reported for each prediction against the ground-truth mask. The compared methods show incomplete foreground regions and false detections in the background. In these examples, AxisQ recovers more complete object shapes and clearer boundaries while reducing background false positives.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Depth-dependent sensitivity on a selected COD image. (a) shows the input and ground-truth mask, and (b) shows independently normalized S2 and S4 feature responses. In (c), 17 bands in S2 and two in S4 account for 80% of DCT sensitivity. (d) plots cumulative sensitivity above uniform versus the percentage of top-ranked channels or frequency bands, with separate vertical scales. Sensitivity is more concentrated across channels in S2 and across frequency bands in S4, supporting channel-wise allocation in shallow stages and local-frequency allocation in deep stages.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: AxisQ: Depth-Adaptive Channel--Frequency Quantization for Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.title_zh: AxisQ：面向伪装目标检测的深度自适应通道-频率量化

papers.abstract: Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffusion uses VAE latents from robot and human videos to establish dynamics priors. Joint video+action diffusion trains on robot demonstrations using a coupled diffusion timestep and an asymmetric attention mask. Action-only diffusion denoises actions conditioned on clean image latents. At test time, the model generates a compact action token sequence in a single DDIM step from pure noise, producing smooth action chunks at 84 ms per action chunk on consumer hardware and avoiding the cost of full video generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot experiments, TAPESTRY achieves strong performance with substantially lower inference cost than comparable joint video--action policies. More information can be found at https://tapestry-wam.github.io.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准和真实机器人实验中，TAPESTRY以显著低于可比联合视频-动作策略的推理成本实现了强大性能（每个动作块84毫秒，消费级硬件）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TAPESTRY世界动作模型，通过将动作编码为视频潜在空间中的单补丁令牌，使预训练视频扩散Transformer可同时用于视频生成和机器人控制，且推理时无需生成视频。
analysis.method: 将动作时间步映射为与预训练VAE补丁同维度的令牌，与视频令牌共享patchifying层和Transformer骨干，通过视频扩散、联合视频+动作扩散、仅动作扩散三个目标训练；推理时用单步DDIM从纯噪声生成动作令牌序列。

papers.abstract: Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels. We present RynnWorld-Latent, a cross-embodiment video world model that uses the 3D-grounded latent actions introduced by RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface. This representation enables joint pretraining on human interaction videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without requiring a common native action space. Built on a pretrained video transformer, RynnWorld-Latent combines global action tokens with an identity-initialized local pathway that aligns actions with future video latents. We pretrain on 23 datasets comprising approximately 553.5M frames and adapt the model to target robots through post-training. The framework supports two data-generation routes: digital teleoperation uses target robot commands to generate action-video demonstrations, while latent-action synthesis transfers source motion to an edited initial frame and pairs the resulting rollout with retargeted pseudo robot actions. Experiments show improved video prediction metrics on public benchmarks and two real-robot platforms, alongside qualitative action following when different action sequences share the same initial observation. Synthetic mid-training improves policy success rates on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and both generation routes improve real-world policy success rates over real-demonstration-only training in the evaluated settings. These results support universal latent actions as a scalable interface for learning controllable visual dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments.

analysis.key_results: 在公共基准和两个真实机器人平台上提升了视频预测指标；合成中途训练提高了LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上策略成功率；两种生成路线在评估场景下均比仅使用真实演示训练提高了真实世界策略成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 利用3D基的潜在动作作为共享条件接口，实现跨异构具身数据（人类视频、机器人演示、仿真 rollout）的联合预训练，无需统一原生动作空间。
analysis.method: 在预训练视频Transformer上结合全局动作token与身份初始化的局部通路，使动作与未来视频潜在表示对齐；在23个数据集约5.535亿帧上预训练，并通过后训练适配目标机器人。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出跨具身视频世界模型RynnWorld-Latent，以3D基的潜在动作作为共享条件接口，在异构交互视频上联合预训练，支持数字遥操作与潜在动作合成两条数据生成路线。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作核心为基于潜在动作的跨具身世界模型，属于机器人动作-世界建模（WAM），同时涉及具身策略学习与视频生成，对本主题具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: We fine-tuned a separate $\pi_{0.5}$ policy for each of the five tasks in the MetaFine Open Competition, with a task-specific training mixture and number of actions executed per prediction. Training started from the official demonstrations and expert procedures. Local evaluation exposed recurring grasping, pushing, and insertion failures. We addressed them by revising the demonstrated motions and by adding expert continuations from states the policy reached, while keeping nominal demonstrations in training. Checkpoints were compared on every instruction, so that a gain on one instruction could not hide a loss on another. Our submission, MAI, ranked first overall with a score of 96.66.

analysis.key_results: 方法在 MetaFine 公开竞赛五个任务中取得总分第一名，成绩为 96.66。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出评估引导的演示精炼方法，通过修订演示动作并补充专家续写状态的数据，避免单一指令指标掩盖其它指令损失，提升 VLA 策略性能。
analysis.method: 为每个任务微调独立的 π0.5 策略，使用任务特定训练混合和每次预测执行的动作数；基于本地评估发现抓取、推动、插入失败，修订演示动作并加入专家从策略到达状态开始的续写，同时保留原始演示；对每个指令比较检查点以选择模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过评估引导的演示精炼与专家续写改进视觉-语言-动作策略，在 MetaFine 竞赛五个任务中取得冠军。

papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are laboratory systems that couple experimental planning, automated execution, and measurement feedback in a closed loop. Integrating flexible robot control with the typed application programming interfaces (APIs) and continuous measurements exposed by laboratory instruments remains an execution-interface challenge. To address this challenge, we propose a traceable framework comprising four components: LAM (Lab Action Model), OpenSDL, Safe-SDL, and L3-Bench. LAM is a proposed measurement-conditioned policy architecture that extends vision-language-action paradigms to generate both continuous robot trajectories and typed instrument API calls. OpenSDL is an execution substrate with an initial control implementation, designed to map role-level operations to heterogeneous devices, coordinate execution, and record timestamped causal events. The proposed Safe-SDL runtime gate combines pre-dispatch schema and resource checks with signal temporal logic monitoring during execution, including extended waiting periods. L3-Bench (Level-3 Laboratory Benchmark) specifies an episode-level evaluation protocol covering physical outcomes, timing, reproducibility, safety violations, and fault recovery. Together, these components provide an end-to-end design for linking hybrid action generation, monitored device execution, measurement feedback, and experimental evaluation, addressing coordination and traceability challenges in SDL workflows.

analysis.key_results: 摘要未说明
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个可追踪的自驱动实验室框架，包含LAM策略、OpenSDL执行层、Safe-SDL运行时门和L3-Bench基准，用于统一混合动作（连续机器人轨迹与类型化仪器API调用）、测量反馈和安全执行，解决执行接口与可审计性问题。

papers.abstract: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.

analysis.key_results: 在人类评估中，Hy-Nomas优于现有世界模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Hy-Nomas视频世界模型，通过结构化视频字幕与动作感知因果注意力的对齐，以及多阶段课程学习和扩散蒸馏，增强了交互式世界生成的指令遵循和历史一致性。
analysis.method: 采用8B扩散骨干，利用动作感知因果注意力将描述性上下文与动作指令分离，通过视觉-语言提示增强器将多模态交互历史转化为结构化条件，并采用多阶段课程训练和扩散蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Hy-Nomas，一个基于8B扩散骨干的视频世界模型，支持自由文本指令和连续相机控制的多轮交互式世界生成。

papers.abstract: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline. TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $\pi_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN上取得改进；单步集成下LIBERO-10成功率从53.44%提升至69.67%，推理时间约为基线十分之一；迁移至π0.5策略在所有四个评估设置中一致提升；真实世界实验中上抽屉打开任务成功率从20%提升至80%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出任务导向的先验和调度方法TOPS，通过构造多模态任务源和调整去噪时间调度，提高了基于流匹配的语言条件多任务操作策略的性能和数据效率。
analysis.method: 利用专家动作序列反向映射构造多模态任务源；基于源-目标协方差失配调整插值调度；结合高斯端点模型进行理论分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TOPS通过为每个任务调整流匹配的源先验和插值调度，在不改变网络结构的情况下提升语言条件多任务机器人操作性能。

papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) enable world models to plan from images by predicting future embeddings. However, their visual prediction objectives do not explicitly incorporate task-relevant state information, so the physical state that determines task progress may not be reliably captured in the latent space. Supervising world models with simulator state can make planning more informative, but it requires deciding which state features matter. Features are typically selected by hand or weighted uniformly, and a uniform weighting gives every standardized state feature equal influence, so redundant coordinates can overcount the same variation, while irrelevant ones can obscure task-relevant differences. To address this limitation, we propose SWIM (State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model), which learns state weights from offline trajectories by predicting recorded actions from current states and observed future displacements. The learned weights quantify each feature's contribution to action prediction and define a weighted state metric for state-supervised training, which we demonstrate by aligning latent and state distances. The inverse-dynamics model is used only during training, so the resulting world model plans from images with no additional planning-time computation. Across five simulated robotic manipulation tasks, SWIM consistently improves planning success over uniform state weighting.

analysis.key_results: 在五个模拟机器人操作任务上，SWIM 一致优于均匀状态加权的规划成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SWIM（State Weighting with Inverse-Dynamics Model），从离线轨迹中学习状态特征权重，利用逆动力学模型预测动作，量化各状态特征对动作预测的贡献，并据此定义加权状态度量，用于 JEPA 世界模型的状态监督训练。
analysis.method: SWIM 通过训练逆动力学模型（输入当前状态和未来位移，预测动作）来学习状态特征权重；在训练 JEPA 世界模型时，使用学习到的加权状态度量对齐潜空间与状态空间距离，仅在训练阶段使用逆动力学模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 SWIM 方法，通过逆动力学模型从离线轨迹学习状态特征权重，用于指导 JEPA 世界模型的状态监督训练，提升机器人操作任务规划成功率。

papers.abstract: Low-precision training often relies on stochastic rounding (SR) to keep quantized gradients unbiased and prevent small updates from rounding to zero. Standard SR draws an independent random threshold for every gradient element. However, accelerators generate random numbers on vector units whose throughput lags far behind their matrix units. Drawing one threshold per element saturates the vector unit and can make INT8 training with SR slower than BF16 training. Sharing random thresholds across tensor elements removes this cost but forces those elements to round in the same direction and shifts their rounding errors by a common offset. We find that this offset degrades training primarily through the activation gradient, which propagates the error backward into earlier layers. Because earlier layers cannot cancel an incoming offset using their own local rounding errors, the offset must be removed at the layer where it originates. We propose Structured Subspace Stochastic Rounding (S3R), which quantizes each upstream gradient once for both the activation and weight gradient matrix multiplications and shares a single threshold per token across the hidden dimension. Its error correction, S3R-EC, subtracts the structured mean rounding error from the activation and weight gradients while leaving the optimizer unchanged. In LLM pre-training experiments, uncorrected threshold sharing degrades convergence, whereas S3R-EC eliminates this degradation and matches the validation loss of independent SR. Furthermore, S3R-EC accelerates full INT8 training steps of dense LLMs on TPU v5p by 1.24x to 1.32x over BF16 and by 1.11x over independent SR.

analysis.key_results: S3R-EC消除了阈值共享带来的收敛退化，达到与独立随机舍入相同的验证损失；在TPU v5p上将INT8训练步骤加速1.24-1.32倍（相比BF16）和1.11倍（相比独立随机舍入）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出S3R量化方案和S3R-EC误差校正方法，同时保持训练收敛性并提升INT8训练速度。
analysis.method: S3R在激活和权重梯度矩阵乘法中共享随机阈值，S3R-EC从激活和权重梯度中减去结构化平均舍入误差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出结构化子空间随机舍入（S3R）及其误差校正，解决低精度训练中随机阈值共享导致的收敛退化，并加速INT8训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于模型量化的高效训练，未涉及VLA或WAM，但对机器人模型的高效推理与训练具有一般性方法价值。

papers.abstract: Compact electroencephalography (EEG) decoders enable embedded brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but compression can alter adversarial robustness without proportional hardware savings. We present ORBITAL, a robustness-constrained framework combining hardware-realizable structured compression, recovery-aware operating-point selection, multi-attack evaluation, and native edge validation. Across nine subjects and three seeds on BCI Competition IV-2a, S25-TRADES achieves the highest observed mean true-union robustness among compressed EEGNet models (23.06% vs 21.27% for standard Full), with 26.27% fewer parameters and 25.10% fewer MACs. Matched controls identify TRADES as the main source of robustness recovery, improving S25 union accuracy by 6.74 percentage points over clean recovery (p=0.0039), while per-example analysis reveals boundary redistribution rather than uniform margin expansion. On Jetson Orin Nano, FP16 compression reduces board energy by up to 16.20% and latency by 8.00%. Despite 99.3% prediction agreement, native INT8 Q/DQ incurs about twice the FP16 latency and energy, demonstrating the need for joint robustness and hardware-aware optimization.

papers.abstract: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two shifts: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are quantized to satisfy resource constraints. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled corruption benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects using 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models using A100 TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision, paired with throughput and energy measurements from corresponding Jetson Orin NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our evaluation shows that capture-chain corruptions consistently produce the largest degradation across the evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative error differently. Clean accuracy does not fully predict corrupted performance. INT8 alters corruption robustness substantially more than FP16, with no systematic direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, while slowdowns are also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness-cost frontiers, showing why model selection must consider corruption robustness and measured deployment cost together. The code is available at https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release.

analysis.key_results: 捕获链腐败导致最大退化；干净准确率不能完全预测腐败性能；INT8 显著改变腐败鲁棒性且方向不一，且未一致改善延迟或能耗；INT8 推理效率与重格式化开销强相关，在 INT8 覆盖有限时也观察到减速；精度变化改变了腐败误差排名和鲁棒性-成本前沿。

papers.abstract: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.

papers.abstract: Navigation vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly invoke costly semantic reasoning even when the next command remains unchanged. Command reuse can reduce computation but risks missing instruction-dependent turns or stops. We introduce ASPEN, an event-triggered scheduler based on command persistence prediction: estimating whether the frozen base policy would reissue its previous command. A lightweight multimodal predictor combines temporal observations, language instructions, execution history, and cached VLA confidence. At eligible command boundaries, sufficient predicted persistence permits command reuse. Otherwise, ASPEN triggers fresh semantic reasoning from the VLA. Evaluated with frozen NaVILA on cross-dataset RxR-CE val-unseen, ASPEN reduces VLA calls by 9.5% and estimated inference time by 8.1%, including scheduling overhead. It maintains comparable navigation performance and preserves identical baseline action sequences on 92.1% of episodes.

analysis.key_results: 在RxR-CE val-unseen数据集上，使用冻结的NaVILA策略，ASPEN减少VLA调用9.5%，推理时间估计减少8.1%，并保持相当导航性能；92.1%的episode中动作序列与基线完全一致。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ASPEN，一个基于命令持续性预测的事件触发调度器，在保持导航性能的同时减少VLA语义推理调用次数。
analysis.method: 轻量级多模态预测器结合时序观测、语言指令、执行历史和缓存的VLA置信度，预测命令持续性；仅在持续性不足时触发VLA推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ASPEN通过预测冻结VLA策略是否会重复上一条命令，在命令边界实现事件触发的语义推理调度，减少不必要的VLA调用。

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

analysis.key_results: 在三个真实世界任务（方块提取、抛球、桌面冰壶）上，Rollback相比最强基线分别将成功率绝对提升10.67%、11.11%和11.85%，且在训练过程中实现更稳定的提升；在抛球和桌面冰壶任务上，从远低于人类水平的遥操作演示初始化后，8小时内超过人类玩家平均成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Rollback策略改进范式，利用世界模型回溯到过去决策点、探索反事实未来并将结果对比归因到单个决策，为机器人策略提供行动级监督，无需单独的价值模型。
analysis.method: 将世界模型视为反事实引擎，回滚到关键决策点，分支尝试替代动作，对比结果以归因成功，并将反事实结果蒸馏为细粒度的动作级监督；同时构建统一分布式世界模型搜索与异步真实机器人执行的训练系统，通过LoRA管道将真实环境交互用于修正世界模型动力学。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Rollback范式，把世界模型从被动模拟器转变成反事实引擎，通过回溯关键决策点、分支探索替代动作并对比结果来归因成功，从而为一类机器人策略提供细粒度行动级监督。

papers.abstract: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/

analysis.method: 使用想象令牌初始化扩散过程以提供结构化动作先验，并结合特权信息蒸馏与未来条件增强未来感知的动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出OSWAM，通过想象令牌初始化和特权信息蒸馏，在一步扩散步骤内实现高质量动作生成，显著降低推理延迟。
