papers.abstract: In federated learning (FL), secure aggregation enables a server to compute the sum of local model updates of $N$ clients, without revealing any information on the individual model updates to the server, beyond their sum. Different clients may be subject to heterogeneous bandwidth constraints, and consequently may choose different numbers of quantization levels to represent the information they send. Most secure aggregation works require the clients to project the values of their update parameters to a common finite group (or field), which does not directly accommodate heterogeneous precision constraints on their transmitted masked updates. Existing approaches of secure aggregation with heterogeneous quantization levels reveal partial aggregates of model-updates, and can reveal segments of individual model updates, under certain dropout and client-server collusion patterns. To prevent this privacy breach, we propose an information-theoretic secure aggregation scheme that tolerates client drop-outs, and up to $T$ semi-honest clients that collude with each other and with the server, under heterogeneous quantization at clients. Our protocol utilizes the $(T+1, N)$ threshold black-box secret sharing construction, where secret shares of the client updates, despite belonging to distinct algebraic groups owing to different quantization, are generated from identical linear integer systems.

papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/

analysis.key_results: 直接控制下，代理在短时程任务上领先，整体性能有竞争力，且在泛化维度上变化最小；在长时程、桌面操作和高精度接触密集型任务上表现不及后训练策略；调用后训练策略可提升整体成功率并大幅降低 token 成本，但仍低于各组件单独运行的上限。
analysis.limitations: 组合模式下由于策略调用次优、无子目标的固定指令执行以及代理恢复控制时的抓取干扰，性能低于各组件单独运行的上限。
analysis.main_contribution: 对前沿 MLLM 代理在机器人操作任务上的能力边界进行了系统评估，揭示了其与后训练 VLA 和 WAM 策略的互补性及组合时存在的局限。
analysis.method: 在 EBench 基准上，通过代理框架将 GPT-6-Astra 置于与后训练策略相同的视觉和本体感知观测协议下，采用直接控制和可调用后训练 VLA/WAM 策略的两种配置进行实验。

analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接评估了前沿 MLLM 与后训练 VLA 和 WAM 策略在机器人操作任务中的能力对比与交互，对理解 VLA/WAM 的能力边界及如何设计代理框架以有效调用这些策略具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without observing real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Furthermore, ZAP also generalizes to an unseen embodiment as well as new objects, goals and strategies never seen during training. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界任务中达到96.7%的成功率，超越MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%)，并在单臂Franka上的RoboLab-120基准上达到55.9%的成功率，比领先的VLA/WAM基线高4.9个百分点。

papers.abstract: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

analysis.key_results: OmniBrain-0在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0、R2R-CE Val-Unseen及多个真实世界操作任务上表现出强大的跨领域任务性能，同时推理和执行开销显著低于闭源教师模型。

analysis.method: 渐进式训练框架（具身预训练、领域专家蒸馏、多教师在线策略蒸馏MOPD）和Rubric引导的递归自改进（RSI）数据飞轮。

papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) offer a promising framework for embodied intelligence, yet mainstream approaches remain centered on video foundation models or vision-language models. Even when geometric features extracted by 3D models such as VGGT are incorporated, they are typically passed into a video model or VLM that serves as the primary backbone, leaving 3D geometry as an auxiliary input or prediction target rather than the native foundation for world modeling. We present E0.5, a geometry-native world-action model built directly on 3D foundation models. E0.5 introduces two key innovations. First, it adopts a 3D foundation model as the primary backbone, making 3D geometry the native representation for both world modeling and action prediction. Second, it explicitly predicts future 3D states together with actions, enabling the model to capture geometric world dynamics beyond action-only modeling or future video prediction. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 first demonstrate the effectiveness of E0.5 without embodied-data pretraining, achieving success rates of 89.90\% and 50.09\% under clean and randomized settings, respectively. Building on these results, we further pretrain E0.5 on more than 160k robot trajectories from AgiBotWorld-Beta, jointly learning robot actions and future geometry within the pretrained 3D foundation. This embodied pretraining improves mean real-world manipulation success rates by approximately 15 and 7 percentage points on AgileX Piper and Zerith H1, respectively. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of geometry-native foundations to acquire robot interaction knowledge and transfer it to physical manipulation. E0.5 embodies this geometry-native approach as a member of the VWA family of world-action models.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，无具身数据预训练的E0.5在干净和随机化设置下的成功率分别为89.90%和50.09%；在超过160k条AgiBotWorld-Beta机器人轨迹上预训练后，在AgileX Piper和Zerith H1上的平均真实世界操作成功率分别提升约15和7个百分点。

analysis.method: 采用3D基础模型作为主要骨干，使3D几何成为世界建模和动作预测的原生表示；显式地同时预测未来3D状态和动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出E0.5，一种以3D基础模型为主干的几何原生世界-动作模型，同时预测未来3D状态和动作，并在无具身预训练及大规模轨迹预训练后验证了其有效性。

papers.abstract: Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones. These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.

papers.abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.

papers.abstract: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.

papers.abstract: This work explores a multimodal approach to the alignment of the behavior of open-ended learning autonomous robots with human purposes through the use of large language models as cultural enablers. While autonomous robots can generate their own skills and goals through interaction with the environment, they often lack mechanisms to ensure that these remain relevant and aligned to those of human users. The proposed approach makes use of the general and cultural knowledge contained in LLMs and VLMs to establish a multimodal interactive alignment process in which human purposes, expressed in natural language, are transformed into motivational components of a robot architecture in the form of robot missions and drives that guide the behavior of the robot. The system is structured into three layers for semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling. This design enables a bidirectional interaction loop: human inputs define high-level purposes, robots expand them into executable missions making use of multimodal information relayed by LLMs and VLMs, and feedback maintains alignment with human intent. Experiments in simulation and with a physical robot demonstrate that the process produces valid missions and behaviors, supporting effective human-agent alignment in interactive scenarios with autonomous robots.

papers.abstract: Efficient robotic data collection remains a major bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) policy learning, especially for tasks requiring accurate end-effector positioning and camera-action alignment. This challenge is particularly severe in electronic-waste disassembly, where robots operate in cluttered assemblies of densely packed, visually similar components. Full digital-twin simulation is difficult because many parts are thin, reflective, or mechanically complex, making accurate object-level meshes and contact models difficult to obtain. In this work, we focus on pre-contact reaching and propose a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based data generation pipeline for wrist-camera VLA adaptation. Our method reconstructs the real workspace with 3DGS and renders diverse wrist-camera observations from robot-aligned poses. These observations are paired with smooth, structured reaching trajectories to provide robot-aligned visual-action supervision for VLA fine-tuning. We further augment the VLA policy with an instruction-conditioned reach verifier that estimates target proximity and provides reliable termination before physical interaction. Experiments in motherboard disassembly demonstrate precise VLA-based reaching using wrist-camera observations alone, without an external side-view camera. With $\pi$0.5, 1,500 generated trajectories achieve 80.0\% precise-reaching success across three targets, compared with 58.7\% using 150 teleoperated demonstrations, while requiring less than 10 minutes of active human capture. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/PrecisionReach-GS/

analysis.key_results: 在主板拆解任务中，使用腕部摄像头观测，π0.5策略配1500条生成轨迹在三个目标上达到80.0%精确到达成功率，而150条遥操作演示为58.7%，主动人类采集时间少于10分钟。

papers.abstract: Expressive robot motion positively impacts human-robot interaction by improving user engagement, likability, or task performance. We present a novel approach to automatically generate and modulate complex, expressive full-body gesture sequences from a multimodal (text, audio, video) context description. Based on a unified mathematical implementation of the Principles of Animation using Dynamic Movement Primitives, we use multimodal foundation models to generate such sequences along with parametric motion variations that are highly context-aware. This method extends the state of the art in terms of flexibility and generality by being interpretable, composable, and working across different robot morphologies. Moreover, we integrate the system into a continuous control framework and leverage knowledge distillation to learn a much smaller model, significantly improving token efficiency and system latency. Results from a user study with a human-like platform indicate that participants judged our system's motions to be better aligned with the interaction context than motions produced under a non-modulated or API-level condition. We also demonstrate how the system generates expressive motion for robots with different kinematics, showcasing its versatility. Paper webpage: https://gen-mod-expressive-motion-behavior.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 用户研究表明，在类人平台上，本系统产生的动作比非调制或API级条件更符合交互上下文；并展示了在不同运动学机器人上生成表达性运动的通用性。

analysis.method: 基于动态运动原语（DMP）统一实现动画原理，利用多模态基础模型生成手势序列及参数化运动变体，并通过知识蒸馏学习更小的模型以提升效率。

papers.abstract: Historical maps contain dense morphological and semantic information about past urban environments, but many digitization workflows focus primarily on extracting geometry, and do not capture cartographic semantics such as building use and construction materials. This study introduces ArchiveLens, a generative spatial knowledge framework that operationalizes historical maps as entity-centric, machine-queryable geospatial databases. The pipeline decouples morphological and semantic reconstruction through three stages: tiled YOLOv11-seg instance segmentation for building footprint extraction; deterministic material classification via hue, saturation, and value (HSV)-based color thresholds; and localized attribute parsing using a quantized vision-language model constrained by domain-specific prompts. Extracted entities are integrated into a hybrid Spatial-Temporal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ST-RAG) architecture that combines dense semantic retrieval with symbolic spatio-temporal filtering and mandatory provenance grounding. Applied to 445 georeferenced Sanborn map sheets of Chicago (1918-1950), the framework achieves high geometric and semantic accuracy. Beyond performance, ArchiveLens advances GIScience by formalizing historical cartography as structured spatial knowledge representation, allowing researchers to query building attributes and compare spatial patterns across map sheets and years.

analysis.key_results: 在445张芝加哥Sanborn地图（1918-1950）上取得了高几何和语义精度，并支持跨图幅和年份的建筑属性查询与空间模式比较。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ArchiveLens生成式空间知识框架，将历史地图操作化为实体中心的机器可查询地理空间数据库，实现历史地图的形态与语义解耦重建。
analysis.method: tiled YOLOv11-seg实例分割提取建筑轮廓，基于HSV颜色阈值进行材料分类，使用受领域提示约束的量化视觉语言模型解析局部属性，并集成到混合时空检索增强生成架构中。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ArchiveLens通过将历史地图转化为可查询的实体中心地理空间数据库，实现几何与语义重建。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作构建历史城市环境的结构化空间数据库，与机器人世界模型或视觉-语言-动作策略无直接关系，但其量化视觉语言模型和时空检索方法对高效推理与空间知识表示有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a certified depolarizing-channel threshold point p = 0.064966, a qutrit positivity frontier of 0.2910672, a 44-gate depth-6 Golay state preparation, and a stabilizer-rank bound chi(T^7) <= 10. It also cut SABRE qubit-routing overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 added gates. In hardware, it cut the energy per MAC of an open 8x8 INT8 systolic tile by 77.7% through a full open RTL-to-GDS flow, bit-exact. Three fully autonomous runs ended in honestties with public records; one audit caught a stale record, and one agent-written score pointing the wrong way went unnoticed. We report the failures as carefully: the one self-derived harness generation was rejected on cost, proposers gamed lenient scorers four times, and operator changes were decisive for several results.

analysis.key_results: 在六个天内、约180美元的模型使用成本下，在十四个量子信息开放问题上取得四项超越已发表最优的结果，并将SABRE量子比特路由开销从68,559降至12,087个添加门；在硬件方面，通过全开源RTL到GDS流程将8x8 INT8 systolic tile的每MAC能耗降低了77.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个自改进AI智能体系统，包含可编辑的基因组（提示、工具、技能、手册、元智能体）和内核强制门控，能够自主从文本目标生成经过验证的报告。
analysis.method: 使用完整的工具型智能体在沙箱中生成候选解，通过公/私分数分割进行评估；系统基因组仅通过内核强制的保留集和成本检查进行更改；自主模式包括问题选择、验证器编写、内核校准、对抗审计和独立复检。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文介绍了一个自改进AI智能体系统，用于解决可通过程序或数据验证的问题，并在量子信息和硬件设计问题上取得了超越现有最优的结果。

papers.abstract: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

analysis.key_results: 在单台消费级机器（一张RTX 4090、32GiB主机内存、一块NVMe SSD）上，以约9.5帧/秒生成37.5分钟连续视频，零停顿，主机内存保持恒定；int4存储在密封测试集上无明显质量损失，长间隔回访时图像质量约降低1个MUSIQ点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个分析模型来预测KV缓存溢出点并区分零停顿与非零停顿配置；在此基础上实现了WorldPager，首次将交互式世界模型的KV缓存以零停顿预取方式放置在NVMe层。
analysis.method: 将过去块（chunks）的KV缓存以int4量化存储在GPU/DRAM/NVMe分层内存中，根据外推的相机位姿预取每个块所需的内存，并后台写回，无需重新计算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出WorldPager，利用int4量化分层存储与零停顿预取技术，在单张RTX 4090上让交互式世界模型连续生成37.5分钟视频且无停顿。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对交互式世界模型的高效推理，提出结合int4量化与分层内存的零停顿缓存管理方法，对于在资源受限设备上部署长时程世界模型（WAM）具有直接的方法论借鉴价值，尽管未涉及具体机器人动作控制。

papers.abstract: Existing manipulation data collection methods typically offer either accurate robot-state acquisition through kinematic-chain-based teleoperation or convenient, portable operation through vision-based approaches. We present DEX-PHD, a portable handheld device that combines these advantages for dexterous manipulation by integrating a dexterous robot hand, continuous per-finger control, and multimodal logging. The system records proprioceptive information, fingertip contact data, and wrist-camera video, while the operator directly controls the robot hand through joint-level mapping. Its untethered design enables data collection across diverse environments. We demonstrate DEX-PHD on contact-rich tasks requiring coordinated multi-finger manipulation and deploy the collected demonstrations through open-loop replay on a physical humanoid robot. The results show that open-loop replay preserves the main temporal patterns of finger motion and task-relevant contact. Therefore, DEX-PHD provides a practical platform for portable, multimodal dexterous manipulation data collection.

analysis.key_results: 开环回放在物理人形机器人上保留了手指运动和任务相关接触的主要时间模式。

analysis.method: 操作者通过关节级映射直接控制机器人手，系统记录本体感知信息、指尖接触数据和手腕摄像头视频，采用开环回放部署采集的演示。

papers.abstract: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history, allocates correction strength across action segments by effective support under a fixed displacement budget, and requires no additional model forward pass. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones from 4B to 30B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with all quantized arms sharing the same rollout with 8-bit weights, activations, and KV cache (W8A8-KV8). Across four environment-backbone settings, InterQ-RL achieves the strongest quantized endpoint result, matching BF16 to within 0.7 points and exceeding it in two settings. It matches or exceeds the learning speed of alignment alone while avoiding its late performance regression.

analysis.key_results: 在四个环境-骨干设置中达到最强量化端点结果，与BF16差距在0.7分以内，并在两个设置中超过BF16；匹配或超过仅对齐方法的学习速度，且避免其后期性能退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 InterQ-RL，通过在状态到达策略历史上有界执行前缀校正，在固定位移预算下按有效支持分配校正强度，且无需额外模型前向传播，从而校正量化后仍存在的执行不匹配。
analysis.method: 对状态到达策略历史应用有界执行前缀校正，在固定位移预算下按有效支持分配校正强度；评估采用4B至30B的稠密和混合专家模型，在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上使用8位权重、激活和KV缓存（W8A8-KV8）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对量化智能体多轮强化学习中低成本量化执行策略与学习器之间的执行不匹配问题，提出交互感知的量化强化学习校正方法。

papers.abstract: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.

analysis.key_results: 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上，GPU表内存减少7.8倍，vLLM吞吐量比FP8表提高11%-31%，PopQA分数约下降1点（1.50位/查找）和0.2点（2.10位/查找），在两个模型上验证。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GateRQ，利用门控值决定每回查找的读取深度，将1位残差码阶梯存储，通过优先为门控值高的查找读取更深层来降低量化误差。
analysis.method: GateRQ将每行存储为1位残差码阶梯，仅在GPU内存保留第1级以计算门控值，仅对门控值最高的查找读取更深层。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出GateRQ，一种按查找重要性分配精度的量化方法，用于压缩条件存储器（如DeepSeek的Engram），在不重新训练的情况下大幅减少GPU内存并提高吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要关注大语言模型条件存储器的量化，未直接涉及机器人VLA或世界模型；但所提量化方法可降低模型内存和提升推理效率，对VLA/WAM部署具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through 3D environments. Maintaining persistent episodic memory remains a challenge for VLM-based streaming agents in long-horizon navigation. We present MEMVLN, a streaming episodic memory framework that maintains a bounded bank of compressed perceptual features annotated with timesteps and action-derived relative poses, and produces compact memory tokens via cross-attention. We pair the proposed memory with a frozen pretrained geometry encoder. To learn the memory module, we design a masking-based trajectory summarization task with multi-granularity sub-trajectory decomposition, encouraging route reconstruction exclusively from episodic memory. Under navigation training restricted to the official R2R/RxR trajectories, MEMVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics on standard VLN-CE benchmarks. Long-horizon analyses further characterize when episodic memory is useful. For physical evaluation, we collect 30 instruction-conditioned episodes in one physical scene, use 24 as demonstrations for post-training, and hold out six for testing. On the held-out episodes, MEMVLN improves success over the VLM baseline from 17% to 40%, and post-training further raises it to 47%.

analysis.key_results: 在官方 R2R/RxR 轨迹限制下训练后，在标准 VLN-CE 基准上多数报告指标达到最先进水平；物理场景测试中，30 条指令条件情景收集，24 条用于演示后训练，6 条留出测试，留出集成功率从 VLM 基线的 17% 提升至 40%，后训练后进一步提升至 47%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MEMVLN，一种用于视觉语言导航的流式情景记忆框架，结合有界压缩感知特征、时间戳与动作相对位姿，并通过交叉注意力生成紧凑记忆令牌；同时设计基于掩码的轨迹摘要任务与多粒度子轨迹分解来学习记忆模块。
analysis.method: 使用有界缓存存储压缩感知特征并标注时间戳与动作相对位姿，通过交叉注意力生成记忆令牌；配对冻结的预训练几何编码器；采用掩码轨迹摘要任务与多粒度子轨迹分解进行记忆模块学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MemVLN 提出一种流式情景记忆框架，通过有界压缩特征缓存与交叉注意力生成记忆令牌，提升视觉语言导航智能体在长时程任务中的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦视觉语言导航（VLN），属于具身智能中的视觉-语言-行动任务，与 VLA 紧密相关；其流式记忆机制及长时程导航性能对本站 VLA 研究方向有直接参考价值，但未涉及世界模型（WAM）方法论。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) ground a referring expression in one of two ways. They decode the box as coordinate tokens, which is precise but takes one sequential step per token, or they regress it from a hidden state with a small head, which takes one step but loses accuracy at high IoU. The two fail differently: a head usually finds the right object but places its edges loosely, while coordinate tokens place edges precisely. We therefore use the regression head as a speculative drafter for the model's own coordinate tokens. Locus writes the head's box as coordinate tokens and checks them with the same backbone by Jacobi iteration over a shared image prefix. The fixed point is the model's greedy coordinate-token answer, reached in about 5.60 sequential passes on average instead of 18.46 decoding steps; head and verifier are one set of weights, trained jointly. On the 8 RefCOCO, RefCOCO+ and RefCOCOg splits, verification raises Locus-2B's Acc@0.9 from 54.87 for its own head to 59.13, and the one-pass head is ahead at Acc@0.5 of every published model with at most 3B parameters except Florence-2-L. Against Jag, the strongest open regression-head model, at its own size and training budget, Locus ties at Acc@0.5 and, with typical acceptance, gains +4.52 points at Acc@0.9, with paired significance tests. Exact answers come 1.5x faster than vLLM greedy-decoding the same coordinate tokens with the same weights; a pure regression head remains faster still.

analysis.key_results: LOCUS-2B在8个RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg分割上，Acc@0.9从自身头的54.87提升至59.13；典型接受率下Acc@0.9增加4.52点，精确答案速度比vLLM贪婪解码快1.5倍，平均序列通过次数约5.60，而非18.46步。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LOCUS，利用回归框头作为草稿生成器，用同一VLMs以坐标令牌进行雅可比迭代验证，在保持坐标令牌精度的同时显著减少序列解码步数。
analysis.method: 回归框头输出坐标令牌草稿，同一模型骨干在共享图像前缀上通过雅可比迭代校验这些令牌，直到收敛到贪婪坐标令牌答案。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出LOCUS，将回归框头作为草稿生成器，通过同一主干上的雅可比迭代校验坐标令牌，在视觉定位任务中加速精确坐标令牌的解码。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视觉语言模型中的草稿-验证解码技术，虽然主题为推测解码本身，但其方法与机器人VLA或WAM无直接关联。

figures.caption: Overview of Locus. Top: a box head drafts the box in one pass (green), and the backbone verifies the draft as coordinate tokens in a few parallel passes (blue), returning its own greedy answer. Bottom: accuracy at IoU 0.9 and 0.5, latency, and the overlap between RefCOCO-family training and evaluation targets. All numbers are measured in our harness unless marked as reported; latency is on one RTX A6000 at batch 1.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Architecture and inference of Locus, illustrated with Locus-2B on the RefCOCO val expression “right elephant” (dashed white: ground truth). (a) The image and a fixed prefix are prefilled once. Each question then runs as a short branch over the cached prefix (attention mask on the right), so all box and verifier branches of an image share one prefill. The head reads the final state of the learned [BOX] token; the verifier branch is the backbone’s own grounding prompt, read by its LM head. Head and verifier are trained jointly. (b) The head’s box is rendered as the coordinate tokens the model would write, and the model checks all of them in one parallel pass, keeping the longest prefix it agrees with (green) and correcting the next token (orange). Repeating this until the draft stops changing yields the model’s greedy answer, here in 3 passes instead of 19 decoding steps. Blue tokens are those that verification changed.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: World models are emerging as a fundamental component of policy learning for real-world agents, enabling agents to predict future world states and plan actions within a learned representation of the dynamic environment. Existing approaches, however, often model appearance, metric geometry represented by projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion either partially or independently, overlooking the fact that these modalities are different projections of a shared underlying world state. This separation can lead to information loss and cross-modal inconsistency, ultimately limiting downstream performance. Motivated by this unified view of the world, we propose DriveUniTok, a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes these modalities in a single decodable continuous latent. We freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model, DriveUniWAM, to predict future unified latents; the tokenizer then decodes them into future appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that our unified design achieves better future prediction and planning performance at lower downstream computational cost than separate-stream alternatives. With reinforcement learning post-training, DriveUniWAM achieves a PDMS of 91.54, reaching state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated WAM-based planners.

analysis.key_results: 在NAVSIM数据集上，统一设计相比分离流方法取得了更好的未来预测和规划性能，且下游计算成本更低；强化学习后训练后DriveUniWAM的PDMS达到91.54，在评估的基于WAM的规划器中达到最先进水平。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出统一的多模态分词器DriveUniTok，将外观、投影LiDAR深度和自车运动编码为单一可解码连续隐变量，并基于此构建驾驶世界-动作模型DriveUniWAM。
analysis.method: 编码多模态信息为单一连续隐变量，冻结DriveUniTok并适配预训练扩散模型DriveUniWAM预测未来统一隐变量，随后解码为未来外观、投影LiDAR深度和自车轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DriveUniTok统一多模态分词器，将外观、投影LiDAR深度和自车运动编码为单一可解码连续隐变量，并基于冷冻分词器适配扩散模型DriveUniWAM预测未来统一隐变量，用于驾驶世界-动作模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦驾驶世界-动作模型（WAM），提出统一多模态分词器与扩散世界模型，属于WAM核心研究，对本站主题高度相关。

(a) BEV tokenizers fuse RGB and LiDAR into a visual latent, while (b) Occupancy tokenizers represent the scene with an occupancy latent; both keep ego motion separate. (c) Modality-specific tokenizers encode RGB, LiDAR, and ego motion into separate streams. (d) DriveUniTok jointly encodes RGB, LiDAR-derived geometry, and ego motion into one unified latent.

The latent is expanded back to T T frame positions, and each target is read out through its own set of mask tokens, including a training-only semantic branch. Snowflakes mark frozen components, and all remaining modules are trained.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can select among discrete candidates for pick-and-place manipulation or generate continuous action chunks for motion control. Improving both forms of decision making through a common mechanism while retaining the capabilities of a pretrained policy is an important adaptation problem. Inspired by Jev's structured, probabilistic decision interface, we propose JevVLA, a lightweight energy-based adaptation framework for VLA policies. JevVLA instantiates this inspiration by modeling the relative quality of action proposals: with the base policy frozen, it learns a differentiable scalar energy conditioned on observations, task context, and actions, using execution feedback, expert corrections, or demonstration-derived preferences. JevVLA uses this single learned action preference function in two ways: its values compare discrete candidates, while its action gradients correct continuous actions or guide their generation. Candidate selection and continuous control thus share one trainable decision core. Each benchmark uses independently trained weights and fixed input/output encodings, while retaining the same core network with approximately 80,000 trainable parameters. On the held-out test sets, JevVLA improves task success over the respective matched base-policy controls by 1.28, 2.31, 1.60, 1.52, and 1.28 percentage points on MetaWorld MT50, VIMA, LanguageTable, LIBERO Plus, and CLIPort, respectively. These results support the feasibility of a lightweight, Jev-inspired energy model for adapting both discrete action selection and continuous action guidance. The JevVLA implementation will be open-sourced at https://github.com/ZJU4EmbodiedAI/JevVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在MetaWorld MT50、VIMA、LanguageTable、LIBERO Plus和CLIPort的留出测试集上，相比匹配的基础策略，任务成功率分别提升1.28、2.31、1.60、1.52和1.28个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出JevVLA，一种基于能量模型的轻量级VLA策略自适应方法，通过单一可训练决策核心同时改进离散动作选择和连续动作控制。
analysis.method: 冻结基础VLA策略，学习一个可微分的标量能量函数（约80,000参数），条件于观测、任务上下文和动作，利用执行反馈、专家纠正或演示派生偏好进行训练；能量值用于比较离散候选，能量梯度用于校正连续动作或引导其生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: JevVLA是一个轻量级能量自适应框架，通过冻结基础VLA策略并学习一个可微分的动作偏好能量函数，统一支持离散动作选择和连续动作修正。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA策略的自适应问题，提出统一的能量偏好函数以支持离散与连续动作决策，属于机器人动作策略优化范畴；与WAM无直接关联，但方法可视为轻量级策略微调，对机器人动作生成与选择具有实用价值。

Benchmarks share the core architecture and use independently trained weights. Robot scenes are local simulator renders used as illustrations, not JevVLA rollout frames. Bars show the test-set gains in Table 1 . CLIPort reports strict terminal success from closed-loop execution. Direct evaluates the same frozen base policy without JevVLA.

The core combines a quadratic potential with a nonlinear scalar residual. Its values rank candidates, optionally with the policy prior, while its action gradients provide bounded corrections or guide iterative generation. Execution feedback, expert corrections, or demonstration preferences supervise energy values and action gradients as available; training updates only the adapter. Benchmarks share the 79,817-parameter core architecture and learn separate weights. Robot images illustrate the computation.

papers.abstract: Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per question with a training-free LLM judge. RoR ranks first on the in-domain leaderboard with mean score 0.6788.

analysis.key_results: 在领域内排行榜上取得平均分数0.6788，排名第一。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个双专家框架（Reason-or-Recite, RoR），结合结构化推理微调与风格模仿微调，并通过训练无关的LLM裁判进行候选选择，在2026 AI City Challenge交通异常推理赛道排行榜上排名第一。
analysis.method: 将官方思维链标注重写为结构化、时间锚定的模式，对9B视觉语言模型进行LoRA微调；对4位量化的27B模型仅用答案进行微调以吸收标注风格；使用无需训练的LLM裁判从两个候选答案中选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Reason-or-Recite框架，通过微调两个互补的视觉语言专家模型并用LLM裁判选择答案，在交通异常推理任务中取得最佳性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于交通视频异常推理，结合视觉语言模型微调与模型量化技术，但不涉及机器人操作、VLA或世界模型，与本站主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: GUI agents built on vision-language models interact with continuously evolving interfaces, yet conventional inference repeatedly recomputes representations of largely overlapping observations and histories. This mismatch makes multi-step interaction costly, while changes in context, interface content, and action arguments prevent straightforward cache reuse. We introduce GUIFlow, a framework for full-pipeline incremental inference in multi-image GUI interaction. Our central insight is that advancing a decision need not require rebuilding all supporting representations: each interaction step can instead selectively update computational states maintained across the trajectory. To support new decisions as the context evolves, GUIFlow adapts how past computation is reused: historical KV states are position-aligned and injected into the current context; change signals guide selective updates of current-observation states in the vision encoder and language model; and earlier action responses serve as speculative drafts verified by the target model. Together, these mechanisms enable cross-step reuse throughout visual encoding, prefill, and decoding without additional training, a separate draft model, or changes to the model-visible inputs and action interface. Experiments demonstrate up to 3.39x geometric-mean speedup across offline multi-image benchmarks and up to 3.49x in online, closed-loop interaction on OSWorld, while maintaining task performance broadly comparable to the dense baseline.

analysis.key_results: 在离线多图像基准上实现最高3.39倍几何平均加速，在OSWorld在线闭环交互中实现最高3.49倍加速，同时任务性能与稠密基线基本相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GUIFlow框架，实现多图像GUI交互的全流程增量推理，通过选择性更新跨轨迹维护的计算状态来支持新决策。
analysis.method: 历史KV状态经过位置对齐后注入当前上下文；变化信号指导视觉编码器和语言模型对当前观测状态进行选择性更新；早期动作响应作为草稿由目标模型验证；无需额外训练、单独草稿模型或修改模型可见输入。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GUIFlow提出一种多图像GUI交互的全流程增量推理框架，通过历史KV注入、变化信号引导的视觉与语言模块选择性更新以及早期动作草稿验证，实现无需训练或额外草稿模型的跨步骤复用加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于GUI代理的多模态推理效率提升，将推测解码与视觉-语言模型的增量推理结合，不涉及机器人VLA或世界模型；但其跨步骤状态复用与草稿验证思想对具身智能的高效推理具有潜在借鉴价值。

A local edit modifies only a small part of successive screenshots; across the evaluated tasks, more than 70 % 70\% of observation pairs have RGB-image error at most 5 % 5\% at each temporal gap Δ ​ t ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } \Delta t\in\{1,2,3,4\} . (d–f) Representation-level changes. For the same observation pair, KV-drift maps at layer 6 and the final layer 36 show broadly similar spatial concentrations of change. Along the illustrated trajectory, a large share of tokens has small KV drift ( d K , d V ≤ 0.1 d_{K},d_{V}\leq 0.1 ) during stable-interface segments, with drops around substantial interface changes. figures.caption: Overview of GUIFlow. GUIFlow treats successive GUI decisions as incremental updates to existing computation rather than independent inference passes. (A) Historical State Integration. Historical KV states are positionally aligned and injected into the current context. (B) Current-Observation Refinement. Pixel changes guide visual-encoder updates, while source-aware KV deviations guide deeper language-model updates. (C) Verified Incremental Decoding. Conditioned on the prefill state formed by (A) and (B), the target model verifies historical response drafts, accepting matching tokens and correcting mismatches. papers.abstract: Physical reasoning underpins how embodied systems understand and act in the physical world, yet vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on questions about dynamics and physical causality. Progress is critically constrained by the scarcity of grounded counterfactual training data, as observational videos capture only the factual trajectory that occurred. The self-evolving paradigm offers a route beyond fixed datasets by enabling models to construct their own training problems. Extending this paradigm to physics, however, requires an external source of truth that can both validate model-proposed environments and verify alternative physical outcomes under intervention. We introduce \physevolve{}, a verifier-grounded self-evolving framework that trains VLMs for causal physical reasoning from model-proposed executable worlds and simulation-authored tasks. At each round, a shared VLM proposes executable world programs and evidence schemas; a deterministic physics engine freezes each valid world, simulates matched baseline and body-elided counterfactual branches, and synthesizes discrete, answer-bound visual tasks. Exact verifier feedback from task solving updates both the shared policy via GRPO and an adaptive curriculum over physical intents. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, \physevolve{} achieves targeted gains across PhysBench, CausalPhys, and ContPhy without human intervention data, improving PhysBench Throwing by $8.8$ points and ContPhy Counterfactual Removal and Goal-Pit by $7.4$ and $24.4$ points. These gains concentrate on interaction-sensitive and altered-world questions, demonstrating zero-shot transfer of causal principles to unseen complex dynamics (cloth, fluid, soft bodies) and real-world video.

analysis.key_results: 在PhysBench、CausalPhys和ContPhy上取得提升，PhysBench投掷提升8.8分，ContPhy反事实移除和目标坑分别提升7.4和24.4分；增益集中在交互敏感和改变世界的问题上，并零样本迁移到复杂动力学和真实世界视频。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PhysEvolve框架，利用确定性物理引擎作为验证器，通过模型自生成可执行世界和证据模式，合成反事实训练任务，实现视觉语言模型物理推理能力的自进化提升。
analysis.method: 共享VLM提出可执行世界程序和证据模式；物理引擎验证并模拟基线与体素剔除反事实分支；合成离散答案视觉任务，通过GRPO优化策略和自适应课程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入PhysEvolve，一个通过可执行世界和仿真任务自进化训练视觉语言模型进行因果物理推理的框架。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于视觉语言模型的物理推理能力，通过可执行世界仿真生成反事实训练数据，虽未直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界动作模型，但其自进化训练范式、仿真验证和视觉物理推理对VLA和WAM具有方法学上的参考价值。

papers.abstract: Low-precision arithmetic can make reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models cheaper, but RL requires the sampler and the learner to agree. Several frameworks now run FP8 on both sides. We implement end-to-end MXFP8 RL in verl (Megatron/Transformer Engine training; vLLM and SGLang rollout; dense and MoE models) and measure on B200 GPUs, with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, what this design buys, when it is faster, and how it fails. (1) Matching. For an MXFP8 learner, a sampler on the learner's grid is more consistent than a higher-precision BF16 sampler: in one engine at fixed weights, train-rollout KL is 11% lower with half of the sampler's linear layers on the grid and 16% lower with all of them, and the synchronized weights we checked equal the learner's FP8 forward weights byte for byte. On the MoE model, an FP8 pipeline whose sampler uses another grid has twice the shared-grid pipeline's KL from the first step. Without a quantized KV cache, BF16 end to end remains 2.5-10x more consistent. (2) Speed. MXFP8 training adds a fixed cost per micro-batch and saves a per-token cost, so in our dense setting it pays off only above about 4.5k tokens per micro-batch; a micro-batch sweep on identical data confirms the per-micro-batch cost, and a trace shows the GPU waiting for the host for most of the added time. End to end, MXFP8 cuts MoE step time by 10.7% and generation time by 24%, and slows a short-sequence dense workload by 5%. (3) Correctness. We state seven conditions every weight synchronization must preserve and checks that test them against the live engine. Each of the seven failures we met on hardware broke one condition, five silently; the checks caught two at their first opportunity, each missed by the other checks, and CPU fault-injection tests reproduce five. All runs are single-seed and at most 60 steps long; we make no claim about final model quality.

analysis.key_results: MXFP8 学习器与同网格采样器相比 BF16 采样器 KL 更低（线性层全网格时降低 16%）；MoE 模型中使用不同网格的 FP8 流水线 KL 从第一步起即为共享网格的两倍；无量化 KV cache 时 BF16 端到端一致性高 2.5-10 倍；MXFP8 在 dense 场景微批次超过约 4.5k tokens 才划算；MoE 步时间减少 10.7%，生成时间减少 24%，短序列 dense 工作负载变慢 5%；提出的七个同步正确性条件中，实际遇到的七个失败均违反其一，其中五个为静默失败。
analysis.limitations: 所有实验均为单种子且最多 60 步，不声明最终模型质量。
analysis.main_contribution: 实现端到端 MXFP8 强化学习，并系统测量了匹配一致性、训练/生成速度变化，提出并验证了权重同步的七条正确性条件。
analysis.method: 在 verl 框架中实现 MXFP8 训练与推理（Megatron/Transformer Engine 训练，vLLM/SGLang 生成），通过 KL 散度、微批次扫描、GPU 轨迹和 CPU 故障注入等实验分析数值一致性和性能。

papers.abstract: Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, requires more than using a framework device API as with CUDA. The project must be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Differences in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces create cross-layer problems spanning PyTorch/ONNX models, toolchains, runtimes, and device execution. LLM Agents can invoke tools to address such problems, but may drift because of insufficient domain knowledge, large configuration and repair spaces, or poor path selection. We propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, organizing model adaptation, artifact building, on-target execution, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into one deployment flow. We evaluate AIPC on the on-device NPU path of Qualcomm QAIRT across vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion models. In two optimization cases, 6/7 Skill-arm Whisper-Small runs meet predefined accuracy and latency criteria versus 0/6 control runs, while YOLO-Worldv2 achieves a 2.791x end-to-end speedup versus 1.599x for the control. Under a pre-fixed deployment contract, Skill, tool permissions, and check conditions, some runs achieve zero in-run human intervention (0-HITL). We also examine Qwen3.8-27B as a locally deployable model for driving an Agent workflow.

analysis.key_results: 在Qualcomm QAIRT的端侧NPU路径上评估，Whisper-Small的7个技能臂中有6个满足预定义精度和延迟标准（对照组为0/6），YOLO-Worldv2实现2.791倍端到端加速（对照组为1.599倍）；部分运行实现零人工干预（0-HITL）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion）方法，将模型适配、工件构建、目标执行、精度修复和性能优化整合到统一的部署流程中，以解决跨层部署问题。
analysis.method: 结合结构化技能与工具链、运行时和性能分析证据，驱动跨层诊断与修复，实现端到端部署流程。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AIPC是一种结合结构化技能与工具链、运行时及性能分析证据的智能体方法，用于在端侧NPU上部署和优化PyTorch推理项目。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于PyTorch推理项目在端侧加速器上的自动部署与量化优化，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模，但对模型量化相关研究具有方法论参考价值。

papers.abstract: Reasoning language models generate thousands of tokens per answer, and generation speed is limited by memory bandwidth, so storing weights in two bits instead of bfloat16 can potentially make inference 8$\times$ cheaper. Two-bit methods are usually judged by perplexity and multiple-choice question-answering accuracy, both of which say little about whether a model can still reason through more difficult problems. We present ThinkBit, a strictly scalar two-bit framework built to preserve reasoning, in which every weight is an integer codeword times a bfloat16 scale shared by a group of weights. We first use a sensitivity metric to assign each layer a ternary, 2-bit, or 3-bit tier to allocate bitwidths optimally among layers. This is followed by a layerwise Gumbel-softmax-based scalar quantization algorithm that searches for optimal codewords block by block. Since a layerwise scheme does not capture how quantized layers interact with each other, we recalibrate scales, with the codewords frozen, using a knowledge-distillation-based loss against the teacher model. We then perform a short quantization-aware training (QAT) stage that lets the model mimic the base model's distribution by reassigning codewords. Finally, a paired reasoning test on training problems selects the final checkpoint between the recalibration stage and the QAT stage. On Qwen3-1.7B at matched size, our recalibrated checkpoint scores 46.7 on MATH-500 against 30.0 for EfficientQAT trained on the same data, and 73.0 after QAT on reasoning traces; at 0.52 GB it is smaller than every published 2-bit GGUF of the model yet more accurate on MATH-500. We show that this framework scales and up to 14B, a 3.74 GB model scores 94.8 on MATH-500, against 97.5 for the 29.5 GB bfloat16 model.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，重校准检查点 MATH-500 得分为 46.7，而基于同一数据训练的 EfficientQAT 为 30.0；经过推理轨迹 QAT 后达到 73.0。0.52 GB 模型比所有已发布的二比特 GGUF 更小且更准确。14B 模型（3.74 GB）MATH-500 得分 94.8，对照 bfloat16 模型 97.5。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 ThinkBit 量化框架，专注于在极低比特（严格标量二比特）下保持推理模型的推理能力，并获得优于已有方法的 MATH-500 精度。
analysis.method: 使用灵敏度指标分配层比特位，采用逐层 Gumbel-softmax 标量量化搜索最优码字，通过知识蒸馏损失重校准尺度，并进行量化感知训练（QAT），最后基于推理测试选择最佳检查点。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ThinkBit 提出一种严格标量二比特量化框架，通过层级比特分配、Gumbel-softmax 码字搜索、知识蒸馏尺度和量化感知训练保留推理模型的推理能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型的量化推理效率，未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM），但其量化方法对低比特部署机器人策略模型有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Most in-field crop-monitoring devices sense a single modality -- either a camera looking at the canopy or a probe reading the soil -- and so cannot detect stress that begins below ground before it becomes visible above it. We present AgriDefend, a self-contained consumer-grade edge device that fuses both. A MobileNetV2 convolutional neural network (CNN) analyses canopy imagery, and a Random Forest classifier integrates trend features from a single soil probe: moisture, the rate of change in pH and in N, P, K, and belowground CO2 relative to ambient (a proxy for soil respiration). A logistic-regression meta-learner fuses the two into a five-class crop-health prediction, all on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no cloud or cellular link. On a controlled greenhouse drought trial with wild radish, the fused model reached 87% accuracy (R^2=0.88, MAE=0.05) at 1.4 s INT8 TensorFlow Lite inference, and its soil signals preceded visible wilting by about four days. The complete bill of materials is $205, roughly a fifth of comparable commercial nodes, positioning multimodal, sustainable crop sensing as a practical consumer-electronics product for connectivity-limited settings.

analysis.key_results: 在温室干旱试验中，融合模型达到87%准确率，R^2=0.88，MAE=0.05，INT8 TensorFlow Lite推理耗时1.4秒；土壤信号比可见萎蔫提前约四天；物料成本205美元。
analysis.main_contribution: 一种自包含的低成本边缘设备，融合冠层图像和土壤趋势特征，用于早期作物胁迫检测，并实现全离线推理。
analysis.method: MobileNetV2 CNN分析冠层图像；随机森林分类器处理土壤探针特征；逻辑回归元学习器融合两者进行五分类作物健康预测；在树莓派5上运行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文介绍了AgriDefend，一种融合摄像头和土壤探针的消费级边缘设备，使用MobileNetV2、随机森林和逻辑回归在树莓派5上进行离线作物健康分类。

papers.abstract: Humans exhibit biological sensitivity to safety-critical stimuli that can trigger defensive action. Across three models and two video benchmarks, we investigate whether similar responses emerge in vision-language-action models by examining their internal representations and action tendencies in response to visible hazards and harmful consequences. Our findings suggest that task execution may remain the default response even when danger is internally registered.

analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种评估视觉-语言-动作模型安全性的刺激-响应方法，并发现即使模型内部识别到危险，默认反应仍是执行任务。
analysis.method: 检查模型的内部表征和动作倾向，涉及三个模型和两个视频基准。

papers.abstract: Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. However, it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. To address this issue, we propose FlowVQ, a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. Specifically, we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training, corresponding to a probability flow ODE that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. Based on this, we define the codebook C_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes C_0 from the source space through the learned flow, and obtaining the Voronoi centroids under the induced distribution, leading to a structured discretization. We evaluated on image tokenization and generation, as well as on two tasks requiring high-precision tokenization, demonstrating scalability and improved expressivity of the codebook with full utilization.

analysis.key_results: 在图像令牌化和生成以及两个需要高精度令牌化的任务上进行了评估，展示了码本的可扩展性和改进的表达能力，并实现了完整码本利用率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 FlowVQ 方法，通过将神经量化形式化为使用轻量级流匹配模型的联合建模与聚类过程，替代标准向量量化，实现无码本坍塌且具有完整码本利用率的结构化离散化。
analysis.method: 使用轻量级流匹配模型与训练同时学习潜在空间，将先验码本通过学习的流传输，并在诱导分布下获取 Voronoi 质心，构建结构化离散化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 FlowVQ，将神经量化转化为联合建模与聚类过程，通过流匹配模型学习潜在空间并构建结构化离散化码本，解决 VQ-VAE 的码本坍塌问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于向量量化方法，没有直接涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型。但其提出的无码本坍塌的可扩展量化技术可能对 VLA 模型中视觉令牌化模块的效率优化具有潜在的间接价值。

papers.abstract: Time series forecasting supports decision-making in web applications such as online retail and network management, where planned actions can reshape future dynamics. World models provide a natural paradigm for predicting such action-dependent changes beyond extrapolating historical patterns. However, existing time series world models (TSWMs) typically rely on fixed, domain-specific covariate schemas that limit flexible intervention specification, while multimodal forecasters treat text primarily as passive predictive context. To investigate these gaps, we introduce TSWM-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for multimodal TSWMs spanning seven real-world datasets, with textual interventions grounded in recorded action--outcome data. Our evaluation reveals that conventional multimodal forecasters underperform history-only time series foundation models (TSFMs) despite dataset-specific training, whereas simple text-prefix adaptations improve forecasting across all evaluated TSFM backbones. These findings suggest that pretrained TSFMs encode implicit world knowledge of temporal dynamics, offering a strong foundation for action-conditioned modeling beyond conventional multimodal fusion. Building on this insight, we propose TimeWorld, a plug-in framework that adapts pretrained TSFMs through explicit action-response modeling. Specifically, the Prototype-Guided Latent Modulation (PLM) module grounds textual actions in temporal dynamics by composing representative response prototypes to modulate future representations based on the action and historical patterns. The Action Contrastive Learning (ACL) component strengthens action-specific response modeling by contrasting these updates under alternative interventions sharing the same history, distinguishing action types while preserving relative intensity relationships.

analysis.key_results: 简单文本前缀适配在所有评估的时序基础模型骨干上提升预测性能；传统多模态预测器尽管经过领域特定训练，仍不如仅用历史的时序基础模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TimeWorld框架，通过原型引导潜变量调制（PLM）和动作对比学习（ACL）显式建模文本动作对时序动态的影响；同时引入TSWM-Bench跨域基准。
analysis.method: TimeWorld框架包括PLM模块（组合响应原型调制未来表征）和ACL组件（对比相同历史下不同干预的响应更新），并采用文本前缀适配预训练时序基础模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出TimeWorld，通过适配预训练时序基础模型实现动作条件预测，并构建了文本干预的多模态世界模型基准TSWM-Bench。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注时序领域的世界模型，与本站核心的VLA（视觉-语言-动作）及机器人世界模型主题有一定关联，但不涉及机器人动作或具身智能。其动作条件建模思想和对预训练模型时序先验的利用，可能为机器人世界建模提供方法参考。

papers.abstract: When a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model does not fit in GPU memory, batch-1 decoding is dominated by copying expert weights from host memory. Cache-aware routing reduces these copies by biasing the router toward resident experts, but combined with asynchronous prefetching it makes the model's outputs depend on transfer timing, so a harness that does not simulate that timing no longer evaluates the deployed model. We propose prefetch-steered routing (PSR): routing conditions on a deterministic logical cache, into which at most n experts predicted by the next layer's router are inserted per layer and token; physical copies affect only latency. On OLMoE-1B-7B with 50% and 25% of experts resident on an RTX 4090, PSR decodes 2.2-2.3x faster than exact routing with LRU and 25-30% faster than the Cache-Prior operating point, with mean benchmark differences of +0.1 and +0.5 points (95% lower bounds -0.8 and -0.3). In greedy generation its lead over Cache-Prior depends on the workload and reverses on HumanEval at 50% residency. On Moonlight-16B-A3B, PSR is 1.9x faster than exact routing with LRU at 37.5% residency and, at the latency of Cache-Prior, significantly better on three of eight benchmarks. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, where copies are cheap relative to computation, PSR keeps its advantage over Cache-Prior on the likelihood benchmarks but not its speed. Distillation-trained gates did not help. Speculative decoding with block-level expert selection was slower than PSR with a 1B autoregressive drafter on OLMoE, but with a block drafter on Qwen3.6 it was 2.1-2.9x faster than any autoregressive configuration with at most its GPU memory on the 64 prompts we timed.

analysis.key_results: 在OLMoE-1B-7B上，专家驻留率50%和25%时，PSR比精确路由+LRU快2.2-2.3倍，比Cache-Prior快25-30%，基准平均差异+0.1和+0.5分（95%下界-0.8和-0.3）；在Moonlight-16B-A3B上，37.5%驻留率时比精确路由+LRU快1.9倍，在Cache-Prior相同延迟下八个基准中有三个显著更优；在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上保持概率基准优势但无速度优势；蒸馏训练门控无帮助；投机解码与块级专家选择在OLMoE上慢于带1B自回归草稿模型的PSR，但在Qwen3.6上带块草稿模型时在64条提示上比任何自回归配置快2.1-2.9倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出预取引导路由（PSR），将路由条件建立在确定性的逻辑缓存上，该缓存每个令牌每层最多插入由下一层路由器预测的n个专家，使物理复制仅影响延迟，从而在评估与部署之间保持一致。
analysis.method: PSR：基于确定性逻辑缓存进行路由，异步预取专家权重，并利用下一层路由器预测需缓存的专家；同时对比了缓存感知路由、LRU、Cache-Prior、蒸馏训练门控等方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出预取引导路由（PSR），通过确定性逻辑缓存指导专家选择，提高专家权重卸载到主机内存的MoE模型解码效率。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly run on edge devices aboard robots, where inference latency constrains closed-loop robot control. However, it remains unclear how to design VLA models, their inference software and edge hardware so that robots can run VLA inference in real time. Most VLA models report only task success, while prior studies cover limited action-generation strategies, divide inference into at most three stages, and lack comparisons of inference optimizations on the same models. Therefore, we introduce VLA-HWBench, a benchmark that measures 18 open VLA models on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395, with a seven-stage inference breakdown. Our study reveals three insights. First, action-generation strategy matters more than model size. It dominates 14 of 19 Jetson configurations, latency varies by $82\times$ on Jetson and $157\times$ on AMD, and parameter count explains at most 15% of latency variance. Models that generate long action chunks in a few flow-matching steps keep up with control, whereas token-by-token decoding does not. Second, kernel fusion with 4-bit weights helps most, running $\pi_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7 2.6-2.9$\times$ faster than PyTorch with torch.compile, but it exists for only these two models and only on the Jetson. Optimization also moves the time to the stages it shortens least, as CPU preprocessing grows from 12% to 39% of the GR00T N1.7 call. Third, after optimization, memory bandwidth limits only the stages that process few tokens on the Jetson, such as the denoising steps, whereas software limits all other stages, from unfused kernels to serial preprocessing on the host CPU. Overall, low-latency edge VLAs should use few action-generation iterations, inference software should extend kernel fusion and low-bit weights to more models and platforms, and edge hardware needs high memory bandwidth and a fast host CPU.

analysis.key_results: 动作生成策略影响最大，延迟在Jetson上变化82倍、AMD上157倍，参数数量仅解释最多15%的延迟方差；内核融合与4位权重使π0.5和GR00T N1.7快2.6-2.9倍，但仅适用于这两种模型且仅在Jetson上；优化后CPU预处理从12%增加到39%，内存带宽仅限制处理少量token的阶段。
analysis.limitations: 内核融合与低比特权重优化目前仅适用于两种模型且仅在Jetson上；优化后CPU预处理成为瓶颈，表明软件栈和硬件配置仍有待改进。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLA-HWBench基准，系统测量18个开放VLA模型在两种边缘硬件上的七阶段推理时间分解，揭示了动作生成策略、内核融合和硬件瓶颈对延迟的影响。
analysis.method: 在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor和AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上，对18个开放VLA模型进行七阶段推理分解，对比不同动作生成策略、内核融合与低比特权重优化，并分析延迟来源。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文介绍了VLA-HWBench基准，用于测量18个开放VLA模型在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor和AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上的七阶段推理分解，以指导实时边缘部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接关注VLA模型在边缘硬件上的推理效率，为机器人实时控制提供基准和设计指导，属于VLA核心研究。

papers.abstract: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the \emph{Semantic Sensitivity Index} (SSI), which measures whether clearance and distance-dependent speed and smoothness follow the caution ordering of obstacles. Evaluating VLM-based and vision-language-action (VLA) policies on the benchmark, we find that neither consistently adapts its motion to obstacle safety, even with explicit safety prompts. Our analysis shows that the policies can correctly distinguish obstacles by safety relevance but fail to reflect this distinction in the motion parameters or actions they produce. For VLM-based policies, which recognize the obstacle and then generate a navigation program, adding an explicit parameter-inference step between these two stages improves adaptation. These findings expose a gap in \emph{semantic-to-motion grounding}, highlighting the need to translate semantic caution into appropriately safe motion.

analysis.key_results: 评估的VLM和VLA策略均未一致地根据障碍物安全性调整运动，即使给出明确的安全提示；策略能正确区分障碍物安全相关性，但未在运动参数或动作中反映该区分；在VLM策略中增加显式参数推断步骤可改善适应。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入OSMA-Bench基准和语义敏感性指数，系统评估VLM/VLA策略在障碍物条件安全运动适应上的表现，并揭示语义到运动映射的不足。
analysis.method: 构建空间匹配的不同障碍物场景集，通过语义敏感性指数测量间隙、速度和平滑度对障碍物警惕顺序的遵循程度；并测试显式安全提示和参数推断步骤的效果。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了OSMA-Bench基准和语义敏感性指数，用于评估VLA及VLM策略在家庭导航中是否根据障碍物语义调整运动安全参数。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接评估VLA策略在机器人导航中的语义到运动安全适应的缺陷，属于VLA评测，对本站高度相关。

SSI (Section 3.2 ) measures whether minimum clearance and near-obstacle speed, acceleration, and jerk follow this caution ordering.

papers.abstract: Video world models trained on large-scale robot data promise a safe and scalable approach for learning and evaluating policies that act in the physical world. However, they still struggle with long-horizon rollouts and out-of-distribution generalization, and they remain computationally demanding at inference time. Typically, video world models make predictions in the latent space of a reconstruction-trained autoencoder, which however is not directly optimized for dynamics modeling. On the other hand, world models designed for latent planning usually optimize latents to be predictable, but they forgo accurate prediction of observations in pixel space. In this paper, we show that it is possible to achieve the best of both worlds: a latent geometry optimized to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future observations. More precisely, we find that temporal objectives for representation learning, paired with a past-conditioned decoder architecture, lead to consistent improvements in generative video world models at the same training budget. The gains include up to 5x cheaper inference, over 7x faster training, and 15-24% lower pixel and perceptual errors out of distribution and over long horizons. Our world models also agree more closely with real-world policy evaluation when using a vision-language model to judge task success from their pixel-space predictions. Overall, our study indicates that temporal predictability is an important design criterion for the latent space of video world models, and provides concrete guidance on how to incorporate it into the training of autoencoders.

analysis.key_results: 推理成本降低最多5倍，训练速度提升超过7倍，分布外和长时程的像素及感知误差降低15-24%。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明通过时间性目标函数和过去条件解码器架构优化潜空间可预测性，能够提升生成式视频世界模型在相同训练预算下的预测精度和效率。
analysis.method: 使用时间性目标函数进行表征学习，并采用过去条件解码器架构。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出，通过时间性表征学习和过去条件解码器设计，可以在不牺牲观测预测精度的前提下，提高视频世界模型潜空间的可预测性，并带来训练和推理效率的提升。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究机器人视频世界模型（WAM）的潜空间设计，对本站主题有核心价值。虽然未涉及VLA策略学习，但提出的可预测潜变量和高效推理方法可应用于机器人视频生成和世界建模。

figures.caption: Method overview. (1) An autoencoder is fine-tuned on pairs of nearby video frames x t x_{t} , x t + 1 x_{t+1} , with a reconstruction loss and a temporal objective on the latents z t z_{t} , z t + 1 z_{t+1} and the action a t a_{t} ; the decoder D D conditions on the past frame x t x_{t} to reconstruct x t + 1 x_{t+1} from its latent. (2) An action-conditioned diffusion world model is trained on the latents from the frozen encoder E E . (3) From a context frame x 1 x_{1} and a sequence of actions a 1 : T a_{1:T} , the world model generates latents, which D D decodes conditioning on x 1 x_{1} as the past frame. We highlight in orange and green the two components that distinguish our recipe from a standard video world model: the temporal objective, and the past-conditioned decoder.

figures.caption: Latents can be predictable and informative in a synthetic setting. Left : Synthetic observations have a predictable component (signal, the dot) and an unpredictable noise component (the static). An encoder E E is trained with reconstruction, temporal contrastive learning or both, and three readouts are then trained on its frozen latents: a world model predicts the next latent from the current latent and action, a probe predicts the signal, and a decoder D D reconstructs the observation. Right : the error of each readout at latent size 100, divided by the error of the same readout trained on the raw observation; geometric mean and standard error over 3 seeds, lower is better. Reconstruction alone leaves the next latent as hard to predict as the raw observation and reads the signal far less accurately; contrastive learning alone loses the observation; their combination avoids both failures.

papers.abstract: Assistive agents in shared-control settings face a dual challenge: acting proactively to align with the human's intentions while remaining legible enough for the human to comprehend and fluently respond in real time. We present Dream2Assist, a model-based reinforcement learning framework for tightly-coupled shared decision making that addresses both sides of this challenge. Our approach extends a recurrent state-space world model with intent inference, enabling an assistive policy trained via fictitious co-play to anticipate and support discrete human objectives without overriding human agency. Beyond the computational framework, we describe the full deployment pipeline needed to translate a world-model-based policy into a safe, human-centered system in a resource-efficient way. Crucially, we address the sim-to-real-human gap via policy down-selection and reward restructuring within an iterative human-machine interface design. We validate the framework through three human-subjects studies and a preliminary on-vehicle deployment spanning two qualitatively distinct domains: high-speed racing (N=30) and urban driving with richer intent structure (N=10). Our results demonstrate that intent conditioning yields measurable improvements in torque alignment and collision rate. We surface key design insights and practices for deploying learning-based assistive agents in safety-critical, real-time human-robot teaming.

analysis.key_results: 三项人类受试者研究及初步实车部署表明，意图条件化在扭矩对齐和碰撞率方面带来可测量的改进。
analysis.main_contribution: 将意图推断融入循环状态空间世界模型，并通过虚构协作训练辅助策略，实现共享控制中主动性与可读性的平衡；同时提出将模型驱动策略转化为安全、资源高效的人类中心系统的部署流程。
analysis.method: 扩展循环状态空间世界模型进行意图推断，使用虚构协作训练辅助策略，并结合人工筛选和奖励重塑进行人机交互设计。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Dream2Assist框架，利用带意图条件的循环状态空间世界模型训练辅助策略，使共享控制代理既能主动对齐人类意图又保持可读性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人共享控制中的世界建模与策略学习，属于WAM/世界模型相关范畴，但其应用场景为车辆共享控制，而非通用VLA或经典机器人操作。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) have significantly improved robotic manipulation, yet deploying robots in the open world demands a higher level of autonomy beyond executing predefined tasks. Robot agents offer a promising paradigm for this transition, integrating task discovery, contextual reasoning, physical execution, and adaptive recovery into a closed interaction loop. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated capabilities, failing to capture the complexity of open-world robot autonomy. We introduce RobotAgentBench (RAB), a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating robot agents in realistic, open-world household environments. Through an agent-assisted, human-in-the-loop real-to-sim pipeline, RAB constructs 50 diverse household layouts with interactive objects and physically grounded tasks, encompassing 90 atomic tasks, 18 short-horizon tasks, 8 long-horizon tasks, and 4 open-ended scenarios. RAB provides a multi-level evaluation of robot agent capabilities: (1) task-level assessments systematically examine five complementary dimensions: task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, failure recovery, and robustness; (2) scenario-level evaluation assesses how agents integrate these capabilities to autonomously fulfill high-level user needs. Furthermore, RAB enables systematic comparisons of standalone VLA/WAM models and diverse robot agent architectures under a unified planning-execution-verification framework. Extensive experiments reveal substantial gaps between manipulation and autonomy, demonstrate the advantages of agentic architectures and recursive self-improvement, and highlight the remaining challenges toward open-world robot autonomy.

analysis.key_results: 实验揭示了操作能力与自主性之间存在显著差距，展示了智能体架构和递归自改进的优势，并突出了迈向开放世界机器人自主性仍面临的挑战。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 RobotAgentBench（RAB），一个通过智能体辅助、人在环路的真实到仿真流水线构建的开放世界机器人自主性评估基准。
analysis.method: 构建包含 50 个多样化家庭布局、90 个原子任务、18 个短时任务、8 个长时任务和 4 个开放场景的仿真环境，并在统一规划-执行-验证框架下评估 VLA/WAM 模型与不同机器人智能体架构。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 RobotAgentBench 基准，用于在真实感开放世界家庭环境中系统评估机器人智能体从任务发现、推理、操作到故障恢复的综合自主能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接面向 VLA 和 WAM 模型在开放世界机器人自主任务中的系统评估，是 VLA/WAM 领域的重要评测基准，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-video prediction with robot action learning, yet improvements in task success alone do not reveal how predictive supervision manifests in execution behavior or whether its benefits persist under task and environmental shifts. We conduct controlled future-video prediction loss ablations within FastWAM and OpenWAM, keeping model architecture, initialization, robot training data, and training steps fixed within each model family. Under clean conditions on seen tasks, predictive supervision increases success rates by 24.38 and 72.91 percentage points, respectively. Trajectory clustering further reveals higher success rates within several coarse trajectory clusters, including cases where cluster frequencies change little, indicating that the gains are not solely reflected in changes in the prevalence of trajectory patterns. However, these benefits do not consistently persist under distribution shifts: improvements on unseen tasks vary across models and tasks, while both models exhibit low success rates under the evaluated environmental randomizations, without a consistent advantage from predictive supervision. We further introduce future-video prediction as an auxiliary training objective for $\pi_{0.5}$, where a lightweight Transformer predictor used only during training increases success from 82.94% to 89.19%. These findings support future-video prediction as effective auxiliary supervision for action learning, while distinguishing improved execution on familiar tasks from reliable transfer and showing that such gains need not rely on a large pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) in the evaluated setting.

analysis.key_results: 在干净条件下，预测监督使成功率分别提高24.38和72.91个百分点；轨迹聚类揭示成功率提升并不完全体现在轨迹模式分布变化上；在分布偏移下，未见任务上的改进因模型和任务而异，环境随机化下两种模型成功率均低且无一致优势；将未来视频预测作为辅助目标使π0.5成功率从82.94%提升至89.19%。
analysis.limitations: 预测监督的增益在分布偏移下不能一致保持，未见任务和环境随机化下的优势不稳定。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过在FastWAM和OpenWAM中进行受控的未来视频预测损失消融，深入分析了预测监督对机器人动作执行行为的改善及其在任务和环境分布偏移下的泛化局限性，并展示了未来视频预测作为辅助训练目标对π0.5的增益。
analysis.method: 在保持模型架构、初始化、机器人训练数据和训练步数一致的条件下，对FastWAM和OpenWAM进行未来视频预测损失消融；采用轨迹聚类分析动作执行模式；将未来视频预测作为辅助训练目标应用于π0.5，使用轻量级Transformer预测器仅在训练时使用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 对世界动作模型进行未来视频预测损失的受控消融研究，揭示其对机器人动作学习的增益及其在分布偏移下的局限性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以世界动作模型为核心研究对象，直接探讨未来视频预测监督对机器人动作学习的影响，对理解WAM的有效性和设计轻量级辅助监督具有高度相关性。
