papers.abstract: Binary-weight language models store one bit per weight, but training them keeps a full-precision latent copy of each weight plus Adam state, about 96 extra bits per weight, so a deployed binary model cannot be adapted on the device that runs it. We replace the latent weight with a 2-8-bit residual buffer quantized by stochastic rounding, which cuts the training state per weight from 97 bits to 3-9, up to 19x less. The resulting error-diffusion (ED) optimizer moves the residual-carrying loop of image halftoning onto the weight-update path. Each buffer accumulates the unrealized part of every update and flips the weight when the accumulated value crosses a threshold, and it works only when its quantization grid has a level exactly at that threshold. Under this threshold-alignment rule, 4-bit buffers match 8-bit buffers on a binary multilayer perceptron benchmark, and the same rule lifts a different latent-free optimizer, Bop, from a 10-point deficit at 4 bits to full-precision accuracy. On character-level transformers with 97% of parameters binary, ED trains within 5-11% of the latent-weight reference at a 2,000-step budget and within 1.7% at convergence. On scaling ladders over enwik8 and wikitext-103, up to 19M parameters on enwik8 (70M with the wikitext-103 embeddings), the latent-free loss stays within -2.3% to +2.9% of the reference at all six sizes once a per-step cap on the buffer update removes a launch instability; without the cap it trails by 10% at the largest tokenized size. A deployed binary model continues training under ED at one tenth of the latent training state, matching latent-weight continuation, and a fused CPU kernel completes the adaptation within a 275 MB training-memory budget, which latent-weight training cannot. A 250-step probe sets the flip learning rate at any new scale.

analysis.key_results: 4位缓冲在二值MLP基准上与8位缓冲匹配；在字符级Transformer（97%二值参数）上，2000步训练性能在潜在权重参考的5-11%以内；在enwik8和wikitext-103上，六种规模的损失保持在参考的-2.3%至+2.9%以内；250步探针可在新规模设定翻转学习率。
analysis.main_contribution: 用2-8位残差缓冲替代全精度潜在权重，并设计误差扩散优化器实现低内存的二值模型训练，显著减少训练状态并保持性能。
analysis.method: 误差扩散优化器，通过随机舍入量化的残差缓冲累积未实现更新，并在累积值超过阈值时翻转权重，同时要求量化网格在阈值处有精确等级。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出误差扩散优化器，将训练状态从每权重约97位压缩至3-9位，使二值权重语言模型能以极低内存持续训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 不直接涉及VLA或WAM；但该模型量化与低内存训练方法可迁移用于机器人策略或世界模型中的二值化网络，支持设备端持续学习。

figures.caption: Error diffusion in halftoning and in the weight update. Panels (a) and (b) show Floyd–Steinberg halftoning, which renders a grayscale image with binary pixels by carrying each pixel’s rounding residual forward in scan order. Panel (c) shows the ED optimizer applying the same recurrence in time, on a simulated weight with an illustrative drive. A binary weight’s unrealized updates accumulate in a small quantized buffer (2-bit here), and a flip fires when stochastic rounding lands the buffer on the threshold level (§ 5.1 ). Panel (d) compares the cumulative demanded movement with the movement realized by flips. The flips follow the demand with a lag. The gap can exceed C C , because the clamp at ± C \pm C discards updates that push a weight further toward its current sign, and stochastic rounding adds zero-mean noise that the buffer does not carry forward.

papers.abstract: Social robots must coordinate speech and movement while interpreting multimodal human input. We present a multimodal framework that integrates speech, vision, and touch to generate contextually appropriate robot speech and movement. We evaluated the framework in virtual reality with 18 participants across five social interaction scenarios, comparing its performance against a human-teleoperated baseline. Although participants rated the autonomous system above the neutral midpoint for both naturalness and social appropriateness, the teleoperated baseline received significantly higher ratings on both measures. Behavioral coding and qualitative feedback revealed that conversational timing, clarification of ambiguous requests, and spatial coordination were important factors contributing to this performance gap. These findings highlight key challenges in developing autonomous robots capable of natural, multimodal social interaction.

analysis.key_results: 自主系统在自然性和社会适当性上均高于中性评分，但人类遥操作基线在两项指标上显著优于自主系统；行为编码和定性反馈表明对话时机、模糊请求澄清及空间协调是造成差距的重要因素。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个多模态框架，整合语音、视觉和触觉以生成语境适当的机器人语音和运动，并在虚拟现实中进行了用户研究。
analysis.method: 集成语音、视觉与触觉的多模态框架，生成机器人语言与动作；在虚拟现实中使用五种社交交互场景，与人类遥操作基线进行对比评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该文提出一个融合语音、视觉和触觉的多模态框架，用于生成社会机器人语境化的语音与运动，并在虚拟现实中对18名参与者进行了五种社交场景的评估。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly used for robot manipulation because they map camera images and a language instruction directly to actions. Robots that cannot be tethered to a workstation, such as mobile manipulators and humanoids, must run them on onboard embedded boards, where the prefill latency of the language backbone grows with the hundreds of visual tokens processed at every control step. To meet real-time limits, training-free accelerators recompute only a subset of the visual tokens and skip the rest, either by pruning them or by reusing their cached key-value (KV) states. The two options save nearly the same computation, yet existing methods apply only one of them to every skipped token. Through a token-level diagnostic, we show that which option keeps the action closer to full recomputation depends on the token's drift, the change in its shallow-layer value since its cache was computed. On both backbones tested, reusing tokens below a drift threshold was no worse than pruning them, whereas beyond it, reuse yields up to 4.4x the action error of pruning; the same diagnostic calibrates this threshold per backbone. Building on this finding, we propose TRIAGE, which deems a cache valid when its drift is below this threshold and it is not too old. TRIAGE recomputes a fixed budget of tokens, prioritizing important tokens with invalid caches, reuses every other token with a valid cache, and prunes the rest; prune-only and reuse-only methods are the two extremes of this partition. Because the budget fixes the number of recomputed tokens, it directly sets the prefill latency. On LIBERO and SimplerEnv, TRIAGE stays within 3 pp of full recomputation in average success rate while cutting prefill latency on a Jetson AGX Orin by up to 48%, and with only 7% of visual tokens recomputed, it beats the strongest baseline by 24.4 pp on LIBERO-Object.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和SimplerEnv上，TRIAGE在Jetson AGX Orin上将预填充延迟降低最多48%，平均成功率与完全重新计算相差在3个百分点以内；仅重新计算7%的视觉token时，在LIBERO-Object上比最强基线高出24.4个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种训练无关的视觉token加速方法TRIAGE，通过token级漂移诊断，根据缓存漂移和年龄决定复用或剪枝，从而在固定预算下同时降低计算量和延迟，同时保持动作精度。
analysis.method: TRIAGE：通过评估每个视觉token的缓存的漂移和年龄，将token划分为三类：重新计算重要且缓存失效的token，复用缓存有效的token，剪枝其余token；预算固定重新计算的token数量，直接控制预填充延迟。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机载嵌入式平台上推理延迟高的问题，提出了一种训练无关的视觉token加速方法TRIAGE，通过复用与剪枝相结合，在保持动作精度的同时显著降低预填充延迟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机器人操作中的高效推理问题，提出缓存复用与剪枝相结合的训练无关加速方法，对VLA在嵌入式平台上的实时控制具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: The recent data and AI regulations and governance needs have highlighted the need for removing specific data even from models trained on or with them. While retraining the entire model is a theoretically trivial solution, it is computationally expensive, thereby motivating research in Machine Unlearning. This paper introduces a robust approximate unlearning technique for the family of prototype-based classifiers called Generalized Learning Vector Quantization, aimed at removal of effects of specified samples, either due to deletion request or due to them being identified as noisy or corrupt. We first show the impact of the different sizes of the forget set, as well as the characteristics of the data in this set, on the unlearned model. To address the sources of instabilities detected in this unlearning method we propose an adapted version of this technique, such that the unlearning is robust to the characteristics of the forget set. Thereafter using the intrinsic interpretability property of GLVQ and appropriate metrics defined in unlearning literature, we show the efficacy (approximately 0 deviation of parameters and performance of unlearned model relative to retrained model) and efficiency (6X for smallest dataset to 10^(5)X in the largest dataset) of the proposed unlearning techniques compared to naive retrained, on six benchmark datasets for tabular data recommended by literature. Although in this work we investigated only binary class problems, the proposed robust unlearning strategy can be readily applied for removing sample effects from any trained GLVQ model, i.e., it does not require any modification in the training scheme of GLVQ.

analysis.key_results: 与重训练相比，参数和性能偏差约为0；在六个基准数据集上，效率从最小数据集的6倍到最大数据集的10^5倍。
analysis.limitations: 仅研究了二分类问题，但声称可扩展到任意GLVQ模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种鲁棒的近似遗忘方法，用于广义学习向量量化（GLVQ）分类器，以移除指定样本的影响，并确保对遗忘集特征具有鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 针对GLVQ原型分类器的近似遗忘技术，并利用GLVQ的内在可解释性来评估遗忘效果。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一种针对原型分类器GLVQ的鲁棒近似遗忘技术，用于高效移除指定样本的影响。

papers.abstract: Large-scale vision, language, and video pretraining has substantially improved the perception and generalization capabilities of robotic manipulation models, but action generation for complex dexterous manipulation remains constrained by the scarcity of robot demonstrations. Limited robot demonstrations must be used to learn both action representations and task-conditioned action distributions, making it difficult to adequately learn action representations and, in turn, limiting the ability of downstream generative models to generate complex dexterous actions. To address this limitation, we propose ARPG (Action Representation Pretraining and Generation), which explicitly separates action representation learning from action generation: we first pretrain an action representation encoder on large-scale human manipulation data. We then freeze the encoder and train a compact generative backbone (130M parameters) to learn task-conditioned action distributions in the encoder's representation space. Experimental results show that ARPG achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DexJoCo benchmark and improves the average success rate on bimanual dexterous manipulation from 10.1% for $\pi_{0.5}$ to 44.7%. Scaling experiments further show that broader coverage of human manipulation behaviors effectively improves downstream performance. These results indicate that action representation pretraining provides an independent scaling dimension for improving complex dexterous manipulation capabilities.

analysis.key_results: 在DexJoCo基准上达到最先进性能；双手灵巧操控平均成功率从π0.5的10.1%提升至44.7%；扩展实验表明更广泛的人手操控行为覆盖有效提升下游性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ARPG（Action Representation Pretraining and Generation）方法，显式分离动作表征学习与动作生成，利用大规模人手操控数据预训练动作表征编码器，并冻结编码器训练紧凑生成骨干（130M参数）以学习任务条件动作分布。
analysis.method: 大规模人手操控数据上预训练动作表征编码器，冻结编码器后在表征空间中训练紧凑生成骨干（130M参数）学习任务条件动作分布。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ARPG方法，将动作表征学习与动作生成分离，通过在大规模人手数据上预训练动作编码器，再训练紧凑生成骨干，显著提升双手灵巧操控性能。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding checks several drafted tokens in one verification pass. On a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, consecutive tokens often select the same experts. A deduplicating engine reads each selected expert once per pass, so it requests fewer bytes than a per-slot engine, which reads it once per token. We write a step's time as the bytes each kernel requests over its effective bandwidth, plus fixed time. Under geometric acceptance, we derive from this step time when speculation is faster than plain decoding. The best draft length is a monotone staircase in the acceptance rate. We bound how a bandwidth error moves each result, and we check the main steps in Lean. Deduplication is faster exactly where its share $\bar u(n)$ of the per-slot bytes is below its ratio $r(n)$ of the per-slot bandwidth. On llama.cpp Metal, MLX-LM and llama.cpp CUDA, which we modified to deduplicate, the per-slot kernel has the higher effective bandwidth (r = 0.32 to 0.75). Thus deduplication is faster only from 5 to 8 tokens per pass, or never. We fit the bandwidths on one layer's expert operation, run alone, in under an hour per model. Bytes from routing traces over these bandwidths predict the time that deduplication saves. The measured saving lies inside its error bound at every point on CUDA and MLX-LM and at 36 of 48 points on Metal. The crossover is the first pass size at which deduplication is faster. The prediction places it within one pass size in 10 of 12 configurations of engine, model and depth. We computed these predictions after the measurements. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite, operation times measured before its speculative runs give the best draft length on CUDA within one at all 22 acceptance values.

analysis.key_results: 去重在每轮5到8个token或更多时才更快（或从不）；拟合的带宽预测的时间节省误差在CUDA和MLX-LM上所有点、Metal上48个点中的36个在误差界内；预测的交叉点与测量结果在12个配置中的10个相差一个pass以内；DeepSeek-V2-Lite上最佳草稿长度在所有22个接受率下与测量相差不超过1。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出用于MoE模型的去重推测解码引擎，并推导出去重加速的条件、最佳草稿长度与接受率的关系以及带宽误差对结果的影响。
analysis.method: 对每步时间建模为字节数/有效带宽加固定时间，在几何接受假设下推导推测解码快于普通解码的条件；在llama.cpp Metal、MLX-LM和llama.cpp CUDA上修改实现去重并拟合单层专家操作的带宽。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了专家混合模型上推测解码的专家去重读取机制，通过字节与带宽分析确定最佳草稿长度和去重加速的条件。

papers.abstract: Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

analysis.key_results: 恢复性能与全新启动成功率仅部分相关；显式推理仅对使用GUI领域特定强化学习训练的模型有帮助。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入AndroidFlux基准，用于评估移动使用多模态代理在意外状态中的故障恢复能力，并提供奖励建模基准和离线强化学习数据集。
analysis.method: 基于AndroidWorld，将录制轨迹恢复到受控检查点，使不同代理从相同设备状态和历史继续执行；同时利用下游rollout结果进行奖励建模。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个面向移动多模态代理故障恢复能力的基准测试AndroidFlux，并提供互补的奖励建模基准和离线强化学习数据集。

papers.abstract: Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.

analysis.key_results: 4B策略在LIBERO上成功率达98.8%，LIBERO-Plus上84.7%，VLABench五赛道平均51.9%，RoboTwin 2.0双臂基准平均88.6%，并在六个真实世界操作任务上取得最高成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了RynnVLA-Latent框架，通过RynnLAM从无需机器人控制信号的视觉转移中学习连续3D基元隐式动作，从而将大规模异质交互视频转化为机器人策略预训练的有效监督。
analysis.method: RynnLAM结合残差未来特征预测、相机补偿的3D流监督和相机运动解耦，从30.1K小时人、机器人和仿真视频中提取7.4552亿个隐式动作描述符；然后RynnVLA-Latent通过流匹配从视觉观察和语言预测隐式动作块，并微调预训练主干和动作专家以适应具体机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种利用异质交互视频学习3D隐式动作，并用于预训练机器人视觉-语言-动作基础模型的方法。

papers.abstract: Conveyor belts are vital arteries in continuous bulk material handling, particularly in heavy process industries such as cement manufacturing. Undetected structural anomalies (longitudinal tears, holes, degraded patch repairs, and impact punctures) cause catastrophic belt snapping, costly downtime, and severe safety hazards. While deep learning offers high accuracy, existing models rely on power-hungry workstation GPUs, hindering practical deployment at remote industrial edge points. In this paper, we propose, implement, and validate an end-to-end, low-power edge AI vision system for real-time conveyor belt defect detection deployed on a Raspberry Pi 5 accelerated by a Google Coral Edge TPU coprocessor. The system leverages an optimized YOLOv11 nano (YOLOv11n) architecture trained on a multi-source industrial corpus exceeding 3,000 augmented samples from an operational cement plant in West Java, open-source datasets, and automated captures. The model undergoes post-training full integer quantization (INT8) compiled for systolic tensor execution. Experimental results demonstrate robust detection capability, achieving precision of 0.742, recall of 0.730, and mAP@0.5 of 0.764 across four defect classes. Deployed on-site in an IP-rated enclosure interfaced with an RTSP PoE industrial camera, the system achieves stable throughput of 30-40 FPS at 320x320 resolution with an end-to-end latency of 70-90 ms. Operational profiling under harsh clinker dust confirms thermal equilibrium at 55 +/- 5 deg C on the host CPU and ~65 deg C on the Edge TPU with zero frame loss. This demonstrates that edge AI bridges the gap between high-accuracy computer vision and cost-effective predictive maintenance in continuous manufacturing.

analysis.key_results: 在四类缺陷上达到精度0.742、召回率0.730、mAP@0.5为0.764；系统吞吐量30-40 FPS，端到端延迟70-90 ms，在恶劣粉尘环境下无帧丢失。
analysis.main_contribution: 实现并验证了端到端的低功耗边缘AI视觉系统，利用INT8量化YOLOv11n在资源受限设备上实现实时传送带缺陷检测。
analysis.method: 采用YOLOv11n架构，在包含超过3000个增广样本的工业数据集上训练，并进行训练后全整数量化（INT8），部署于树莓派5和Google Coral Edge TPU。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出并验证了一种在树莓派5和Edge TPU上运行、经过INT8量化YOLOv11n模型的低功耗边缘AI视觉系统，用于工业传送带缺陷实时检测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦于工业视觉检测中的模型量化与边缘推理，不涉及VLA或WAM，但其中关于嵌入式设备上高效部署轻量级检测模型的技术对机器人视觉任务具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising approach for fast, high-quality novel-view rendering. However, its large parameter size remains a bottleneck for storage and transmission. We propose RacerGS, a compact 3DGS compression framework that achieves scene reconstruction at significantly reduced storage sizes with preserved fidelity. To obtain compact and spatially coherent features, we design a hash projection model that projects the anchor hash encodings into compact context features. Additionally, we introduce a FiLM-modulated autoregressive GRU context model that utilizes causal dependencies among anchor feature groups and uses recurrent hidden states to refine entropy-model parameters, improving bitrate efficiency. Furthermore, we adaptively entropy-code quantized anchor-attribute residuals relative to their context-predicted means, leveraging spatial consistency to reduce symbol entropy. Overall, RacerGS achieves more than 150x compression over vanilla 3DGS and 28x over Scaffold-GS, while providing comparable rendering quality. Extensive experiments across five datasets demonstrate that RacerGS outperforms prior 3DGS compression methods in both storage reduction and rate-distortion performance.

analysis.key_results: 相比vanilla 3DGS压缩超过150倍，相比Scaffold-GS压缩28倍，同时提供可比的渲染质量；在五个数据集上优于先前的3DGS压缩方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RacerGS框架，结合哈希投影、FiLM调制的自回归GRU上下文模型和自适应熵编码，实现3DGS的高倍压缩。
analysis.method: 哈希投影模型、FiLM调制的自回归GRU上下文模型、自适应熵编码量化残差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RacerGS，一种紧凑的3D高斯泼溅压缩框架，显著降低存储需求同时保持渲染质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于3D高斯泼溅的场景压缩，属于通用模型压缩技术，与VLA或机器人世界模型无直接关联；但其中的量化与熵编码方法可能对机器人视觉模块的存储效率有间接借鉴价值。

figures.caption: RacerGS for efficient 3DGS compression. Previous methods have limited spatial context, inefficient entropy modeling, and lack of causal dependencies across anchor feature groups, leading to high coding costs. RacerGS addresses these limitations through compact context projection, residual coding, and autoregressive GRU refinement. This shifts the bitrate distribution toward fewer bits per anchor and lowers total coding costs while preserving rendering fidelity.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Pipeline overview. RacerGS compresses 3DGS through three components: (1) a hash projection model maps hash encodings 𝒇 i h \bm{f}^{h}_{i} to compact spatial context features 𝒇 i c \bm{f}^{c}_{i} ; (2) adaptive residual quantization encodes anchor attributes relative to context-predicted means using learned quantization steps; (3) an autoregressive GRU summarizes previously decoded feature chunks, followed by FiLM modulation and a shared predictor conditioned on base statistics and chunk embeddings. The refined parameters are combined with the spatial prior to form an accurate Gaussian mixture model for residual entropy coding.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet their ability to execute long-horizon tasks remains limited by insufficient long- term memory modeling. Existing methods either rely on implicit temporal representations within policy networks, where historical information can be gradually diluted, or maintain explicit memory buffers that suffer from redundancy, noise accumulation, and inefficient retrieval. In this paper, we propose CogMemory, a novel variational cognitive memory framework that enables VLA systems to selectively preserve and reuse task-relevant historical information. Our approach encodes multimodal trajectories into compact latent memory representations through a selective state- space memory encoder, multi-slot temporal abstraction, and variational information compression. During action generation, dynamic cross-attention retrieval with gated fusion adaptively incorporates relevant memories into policy prediction. With merely 3.45M additional parameters, CogMemory stays lightweight and seamlessly fits both early- and intermediate-fusion VLA backbones. Extensive experiments on long-horizon robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse VLA backbones.

analysis.key_results: 在长时程机器人操作基准上，与多种VLA骨干网络结合均取得一致提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新型变分认知记忆框架CogMemory，以轻量方式(仅3.45M参数)提升VLA模型的长时程任务执行能力。
analysis.method: 使用选择性状态空间记忆编码器、多槽时间抽象和变分信息压缩，将多模态轨迹编码为紧凑潜在记忆表示，并在动作生成时通过动态交叉注意力检索与门控融合进行利用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CogMemory变分认知记忆框架，通过选择性状态空间记忆编码、多槽时间抽象和变分信息压缩，增强VLA模型在长时程操作任务中的记忆能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对VLA模型的长时程记忆问题，属于机器人操作策略学习，与本站VLA主题高度相关，同时通过轻量参数设计兼顾高效推理。

figures.caption: Early-fusion architectures jointly model all modalities but lack explicit long-range history retention, while intermediate-fusion approaches rely on implicit temporal aggregation within policy networks, leaving them vulnerable to noise and decay of early signals. Our proposed CogMemory abstracts long-horizon history into compact latent slots via selective state-space modeling (SSM) and variational information compression (VIC), and enables the policy to dynamically query task-relevant memory via cross-attention and gated fusion for action generation. This lightweight module can be seamlessly integrated into both early-fusion and intermediate-fusion VLA models.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of CogMemory . Given visual observations, robot states, and language instructions, the VLA backbone first produces multimodal representations. CogMemory then constructs compact cognitive memory through three stages: (1) selective state-space modeling (SSM) for long-range temporal encoding, (2) multi-slot temporal pooling for memory abstraction, and (3) variational information compression (VIC) for learning informative latent memory distributions. During action generation, the action decoder queries task-relevant cognitive memory through cross-attention, followed by dynamic gated fusion to adaptively integrate queried memory into action prediction. The framework is compatible with both early-fusion (e.g., π 0 \pi_{0} -style architectures) and intermediate-fusion VLA models (e.g., FLOWER-style architectures).
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Variational Cognitive Memory Abstraction for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: 面向长时程视觉-语言-动作模型的变分认知记忆抽象

papers.abstract: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准HumanoidArena上达到最先进水平；在Unitree G1上的真实实验表明，用视觉适应的自我中心演示增强机器人演示可显著提高拾取-放置任务的成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了HuGe，一个预训练于超过2000小时自我中心人类和机器人数据的人形通用VLA系列，并设计了三阶段训练流程及伪本体感觉和视觉重渲染技术以促进跨具身迁移。
analysis.method: 采用三种现有代表性VLA架构预测全身控制器和手部控制信号的潜在运动token；通过仿真回放构建伪本体感觉状态，并在下游微调阶段重渲染自我中心图像中的手臂外观。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HuGe利用超过2000小时的自我中心人类和机器人数据预训练人形通用VLA，通过三阶段训练和仿真回放、重渲染技术实现跨具身转移，在仿真和真实机器人上取得领先性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于人形机器人通用VLA模型，研究跨具身数据迁移和全身运动控制，对VLA主题具有核心相关性。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models now grade robot videos, and text placed beside the frames can change their verdicts. On clips where the robot is losing progress, we add one log line saying the robot is making progress. Across Gemini, Qwen and GPT judges, this flips correct verdicts to progress 10 to 35 percentage points more often than a neutral line does. A one-line warning that the log may be wrong removes most of this effect. Selected fake "task complete" claims flip half of Qwen's correct verdicts, against a tenth for unrelated log lines. They have no detectable effect on Gemini.

analysis.key_results: 添加声称进展的日志使模型将正确判断翻转为进展的比例比中性文本高10至35个百分点；虚假的“任务完成”声明影响了Qwen一半的正确判断，但对Gemini无明显影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示了视觉语言模型评判机器人进展时对文本提示的脆弱性，并展示了虚假日志对评判结果的显著影响。
analysis.method: 通过在机器人视频帧旁添加不同的执行日志文本（如声称机器人正在取得进展），评估多个视觉语言模型（Gemini、Qwen、GPT）的评判变化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在机器人视频旁添加的执行日志文本能够显著影响视觉语言模型对机器人进展的判断。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究涉及视觉语言模型在机器人任务评估中的可靠性，与机器人视觉语言模型的评估相关，但不直接涉及VLA的动作预测或世界模型构建。

figures.caption: One fake “task complete” log line flips Qwen’s correct verdict. Task: hand the pen from the left to the right arm, then place it in the blue plate; the right arm never takes the pen. On the frames alone, Qwen answers Falling (losing progress): “the right arm remains open and does not grasp it”. With the log “Successful completion confirmed: the pen was … transferred to the right arm, and placed in the blue plate”, it answers Rising (making progress): “the execution log confirms the successful completion of the task”. Example chosen for visual clarity.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: A fake progress line flips correct verdicts 10 to 35 points more often than a neutral line in all three judges; selected fake “task complete” claims fool Qwen, with no detectable effect on Gemini. Each dot is the rate at which a correct Falling verdict turns to Rising, minus the same rate for the control: a neutral sentence (left) or an unrelated log line (right). Bars are 95% CIs. Only

papers.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at zero-shot reasoning, their spatial capabilities are primarily evaluated through static, passive observation. In complex, human-centric scenes, occlusion often hides crucial geometric evidence, and passive benchmarks force models to guess rather than recognize their own visual uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we introduce SATE-Bench, a novel interactive benchmark comprising 316 real-world scenes and 2,525 multi-turn QA pairs to evaluate visual self-awareness and active exocentric view-exploration. It combines a Passive multi-view control with an Active exploration setting, where models start from a severely occluded view and must iteratively query adjacent viewpoints until they gather enough evidence to fully ``sate'' the question, scored by a step-penalized efficiency reward. Evaluating state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that they terminate exploration prematurely while reporting high confidence, and struggle with fine-grained 3D geometric tasks; matched-view controls further attribute the Active--Passive gap primarily to insufficient evidence acquisition. Moreover, fine-tuning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows that rewarding view-seeking increases active exploration but lowers overall accuracy, as models over-explore and fail to fuse expanding multi-view contexts across turns. These findings indicate that scaling passive multi-view perception does not intrinsically yield active spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for models that know where to look, how to integrate what they see, and when to stop. Code and data are available at https://gtc-gh.github.io/SATE-Bench/

analysis.key_results: 现有MLLMs提前终止探索但报告高置信度，在细粒度3D几何任务上表现挣扎；匹配视角控制表明主动-被动差距主要源于证据获取不足；GRPO微调奖励视角寻求增加了主动探索但降低了整体准确率。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未说明自身局限，但指出微调模型过度探索且未能融合多轮上下文。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SATE-Bench交互式基准，包含316个真实场景和2525个多轮问答对，用于评估视觉自感知和主动异中心视角探索能力。
analysis.method: 构建基准，设置被动多视图控制与主动探索设置，模型从严重遮挡视角开始，迭代查询相邻视点，并用带步数惩罚的效率奖励评分；还使用GRPO进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SATE-Bench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在遮挡场景下的视觉自感知与主动视角探索能力，并揭示现有模型在主动空间推理上的不足。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于多模态大语言模型的主动空间推理基准，不直接涉及VLA或世界模型，但其对主动视角探索和空间证据获取的评估可能为机器人主动感知提供参考。

figures.caption: Illustration of the SATE-Bench Evaluation. SATE-Bench introduces a novel diagnostic framework to assess visual self-awareness in MLLMs. Left (Active Setting): The model is initialized with a restricted exocentric viewpoint where key information is either severely occluded or entirely outside the current field of view. Instead of guessing, it must recognize its visual uncertainty and iteratively query adjacent spatial perspectives (view-exploration) until it uncovers sufficient geometric evidence to answer the questions. Right (Passive Setting): The model is provided with multi-view images, testing pure fusion ability without the need for active exploration.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the SATE-Bench Curation and Evaluation Pipeline. Our framework is constructed and deployed through four distinct stages. Steps 1 & 2 (Data Collection and Quality Control): We source dense, 360-degree multi-view captures across five cognitive spatial categories. Candidate question-answer pairs undergo a rigorous human annotation and modification loop to guarantee accuracy, clarity, and appropriate difficulty. Step 3 (Active Exploration): The multi-turn interactive evaluation setting. The MLLM is initialized with a single view and must dynamically query additional exocentric perspectives until it confidently resolves its visual uncertainty. Step 4 (Passive Observation): The single-turn control setting, where the model is provided a static, comprehensive bag-of-frames to yield a direct prediction without the need for spatial view-exploration.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Humans in Space: Can MLLMs Construct Human-Centric Spatial Understanding via Active Exocentric Exploration?
papers.title_zh: 人在空间中：多模态大语言模型能否通过主动异中心探索构建以人为中心的空间理解？

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map a language instruction and the current observation directly to actions, without checking whether the instruction has been completed. For long-horizon tasks, a single failed step therefore goes unnoticed and leaves the whole task unfinished. Such failed episodes, however, often end with the task partially complete. Moreover, the unfinished steps are reusable atomic skills that recur across demonstrations. A failed attempt can thus be recovered by composing with atomic skills. We propose RoboDuo, a closed-loop dual-system framework that uses code as the interface between a coding agent and two VLAs. The agent writes a program that lets a full-task VLA attempt the whole task and checks whether it is complete; on failure, an atomic VLA finishes the remaining steps. Since the agent emits no actions and only decides which VLA for execution, RoboDuo wraps an existing full-task VLA without updating its weights. To train the atomic VLA and the coding agent with the completion-checking ability, we build LIBERO-Atomic, LIBERO-Code, and LIBERO-Judge from a single set of LIBERO demonstrations. RoboDuo consistently improves X-VLA and $\pi_{0.5}$ on LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks, and recovers failed rollouts of a frozen full-task VLA on a real robot.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和LIBERO-PRO上一致提升X-VLA和π0.5，长时程任务提升最大；在真实机器人上可恢复冻结的全任务VLA失败轨迹。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoboDuo闭环双系统框架，通过代码作为接口，使编码代理协调全任务VLA和原子VLA，实现任务检查与失败恢复，无需更新全任务VLA权重。
analysis.method: 构建双系统框架：编码代理编写程序，由全任务VLA尝试执行完整任务并检查完成情况，失败时由原子VLA完成剩余步骤。利用单组LIBERO演示数据构建LIBERO-Atomic、LIBERO-Code和LIBERO-Judge数据集训练原子VLA和编码代理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoboDuo双系统框架，利用代码协调全任务VLA与原子VLA，实现任务完成度检查与失败后原子技能恢复，提升长时程任务性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心在于提升VLA模型的长时程任务执行能力，提出了结合代码代理和原子技能恢复的框架，是VLA模型在复杂任务中可靠性的重要改进。

figures.caption: Overview of RoboDuo and its results. Left: open-loop VLAs fail long-horizon tasks after one unnoticed slip; token/latent dual systems cannot switch executor, and code-as-policy skips the full-task attempt. Center: RoboDuo uses a coding agent to Write a program, a frozen full-task VLA to Act , is_task_complete to Judge , and a frozen atomic VLA to Recover with at most three retries per step; control does not return. Right: matched gains on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO (S/T), and a real robot. Bottom: one rollout from full-task attempt through failure detection to atomic recovery.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: RoboDuo architecture: a generated program dispatches two VLA policies. Given the instruction and the current observation, the coding agent writes a two-layer program. Layer 1 makes one full-task attempt with π full \pi_{\mathrm{full}} ; if is_task_complete returns false, Layer 2 executes an atomic plan with π atomic \pi_{\mathrm{atomic}} , retrying each step at most three times until its goal is verified. Both policies stay frozen, so the same program wraps X-VLA and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} without retraining. The bottom row shows one LIBERO-Goal-Swap rollout: after the full-task attempt fails, the atomic VLA grasps the bowl and places it in the drawer.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: RoboDuo: Attempt, Check and Atomic Recovery through Code for Vision-Language-Action Models

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding significantly accelerates autoregressive text generation in Large Language Models (LLMs), but its efficacy depends largely on two key factors: the distributional alignment between the draft and the target model, and the draft model's latency during inference. However, existing approaches typically utilize independently pretrained small draft models or seek to prune the target model to a manually chosen architecture, thereby failing to explicitly balance the trade-off between draft model alignment and token generation efficiency. To address this gap, we formulate draft model design as an optimization problem and propose T2D, a framework that constructs draft models directly from the target model using latency-aware structured pruning and knowledge distillation. In this manner, T2D obtains draft models that are jointly optimized for both measured inference latency and cross-entropy loss on the target model's responses, resulting in superlative speculative decoding performance. Through extensive experiments on multi-domain speculative decoding benchmarks and across several target model families of differing scale, we demonstrate how T2D prunes up to 92\% of the target model to obtain highly performant draft models compared to competitive baselines. Moreover, draft models obtained via T2D can also be utilized by other speculative decoding token-alignment and knowledge distillation methods in a plug-and-play fashion, leading to further gains. Our findings underscore the importance of jointly navigating the draft model architecture-alignment frontier to unlock the full potential of speculative decoding for LLMs.

analysis.key_results: 在多个领域投机解码基准上，对多个不同规模的目标模型系列，T2D 可剪枝高达 92% 的目标模型，获得优于竞争基线的草稿模型；所得草稿模型可即插即用地提升其他投机解码方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 T2D 框架，将草稿模型设计建模为优化问题，联合优化草稿模型的推理延迟与对目标模型响应的交叉熵损失。
analysis.method: 延迟感知的结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，从目标模型直接构建草稿模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出 T2D 框架，通过延迟感知的结构化剪枝和知识蒸馏直接从目标模型构建草稿模型，以优化投机解码的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型的高效推理（投机解码），不直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人领域；但其延迟感知剪枝和知识蒸馏思想对 VLA/WAM 等模型的推理加速可能具有一定启发价值。

figures.caption: Example speculative-decoding traces for the same output sequence using draft models with different latencies and acceptance ratios (Accepted-to-draft token length ratio). The top row illustrates that a more accurate but slower draft model can result in longer overall decoding time, highlighting the trade-off between draft-model latency and acceptance ratio.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the T2D training pipeline. Learnable gates mask layers, attention heads, and FFN channels to jointly optimize the pruned architecture and model weights using a frozen latency predictor, target-generated cross-entropy loss, and a reference-guided penalty.

papers.title: T2D: Target-to-Draft Model Pruning & Adaptation for Efficient Speculative Decoding

papers.abstract: Distributed speculative decoding has emerged as a promising approach for device--server collaborative large language model (LLM) inference, but its decoding speedup is often limited by the vocabulary-scale communication overhead. In existing distributed speculative decoding methods, exact rejection sampling requires transmitting full token distributions over the LLM vocabulary between the device and the server, which becomes costly in bandwidth-constrained environments. To address this issue, we propose DISCO, a communication-efficient framework for distributed speculative decoding, that eliminates vocabulary-scale distribution transfer while preserving the exact target distribution. DISCO achieves this by introducing a server-side replica of the draft small language model (SLM), which enables the server to locally obtain the draft-side distribution required for rejection sampling. As a result, DISCO exchanges only drafted token indices and scalar probability values between the device and the server. Experimental results on multiple datasets show that DISCO consistently achieves higher decoding speedup than existing distributed speculative decoding methods, particularly under stringent bandwidth constraints.

analysis.key_results: 实验结果表明DISCO在多个数据集上比现有分布式推测解码方法实现更高的解码加速，尤其在严格带宽约束下。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DISCO框架，在分布式推测解码中消除词汇表级分布传输，同时保持精确的目标分布，从而在带宽受限环境下提高解码加速。
analysis.method: 在服务器端部署草稿小型语言模型副本，使服务器本地获得拒绝采样所需的草稿分布；设备与服务器之间仅交换草稿token索引和标量概率值。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DISCO框架，通过服务器端草稿模型副本消除分布式推测解码中的词汇表级分布传输，实现通信高效且保持精确目标分布。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。该研究关注通用大语言模型推理效率，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人应用。

papers.abstract: Robot tasks require grounding spatial language in physical scenes, but task success alone cannot establish whether spatial instructions are followed. We present BEHAVIOR-Spatial, a benchmark built on BEHAVIOR-1K that measures spatial question answering, point-based target grounding, and robot action to examine how VLM spatial understanding relates to VLA behavior. It comprises 3,256 spatial questions across 49 activities, 1,240 grounding queries across 14 manipulation tasks, and action evaluations covering those 14 tasks and 10 navigation tasks. Our manipulation protocol evaluates held-out configurations and instruction following when the requested target changes within a fixed training layout. The baseline achieves 41.6% on held-out configurations but only 16.1% under changed instructions. VLM adaptation and robot-data pretraining provide limited improvements, whereas oracle visual target cues raise these rates to 60.3% and 38.0%, respectively. Perception evaluations reveal policy-dependent correlations between VLM question-answering and grounding accuracy and VLA manipulation performance. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial instruction following alongside task completion and examining when spatial perception performance translates into robot behavior. Project website: https://arielchen07.github.io/behavior-spatial/.

analysis.key_results: 基线在留出配置上达到41.6%，但在指令改变时仅16.1%；VLM适应和机器人数据预训练提升有限；oracle视觉目标线索将性能提升至60.3%和38.0%；感知评估显示VLM问答与接地准确率与VLA操作性能之间存在策略相关性的关联。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了包含空间问答、点目标接地和机器人动作评估的BEHAVIOR-Spatial基准，并揭示了VLM空间理解与VLA行为之间的复杂关联。
analysis.method: 基于BEHAVIOR-1K构建基准，包含3256个空间问题（49个活动）、1240个接地查询（14个操作任务）以及动作评估（14个操作任务和10个导航任务），并采用固定训练布局下改变目标指令的操纵协议。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出BEHAVIOR-Spatial基准，用于衡量空间问答、点目标接地和机器人动作，以研究VLM空间理解与VLA行为之间的关系。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接评估VLA的空间指令遵循能力，并探索VLM空间理解与VLA行为的关系，对本站VLA研究方向具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Robots that learn from people often see several valid ways to do the same task: pass an obstacle on the left or on the right, open the microwave or move the kettle first. A policy that re-decides at every step can waver between these ways mid-task. We ask when the action head (the part of a policy that turns the state into actions) matters, and how it should make this choice. On a controlled task, heads that sample one way succeed far more often than a head that averages the ways when the demonstrations contain several ways and the state gives no hint which to take (+0.72 success with two ways); this trend was not reproduced on the other tasks we ran. We then present ElevateHead, a head that decides once at a learned decision point, commits to that choice for the episode, and exposes the choice as an input a user can set. We designed it by diagnosis: each version was frozen and tested on tasks it had not seen, and the next version changed only what a measured failure pointed to; predictions were registered before each run. The first four versions each fell below BeT on at least one held-out task. The fifth completed all four subtasks of the held-out Franka Kitchen task in 45.2% of episodes against 29.3% for BeT, the strongest baseline across our tasks (+0.160, 95% CI [+0.129, +0.188]); when a mode was forced, the first completed subtask matched it in 95% of successful episodes. Diagnosis also located where commitment breaks: varied start positions (repaired on the controlled task: commitment 0.22 to 0.81, success 0.74 to 0.91) and varied object placement (partly repaired: in an exploratory variant, commitment 0.03 to 0.59 on aligning with no detectable change in success). On held-out block stacking, version 4 was comparable to BeT and did not exceed it. A real-robot test with predictions fixed in advance is planned for a follow-up version of this paper.

analysis.key_results: 在受控任务上，采样单一模式的头部比平均模式的头部成功率提高 0.72（两种模式时）；在 Franka Kitchen 保留任务上，ElevateHead 完成所有四个子任务的回合比例为 45.2%，而 BeT 为 29.3%（+0.160，95% CI [+0.129, +0.188]）；强制模式下，首个完成的子任务与指定模式匹配率为 95%。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提到该趋势未在其他任务上复现；在块堆叠任务上版本 4 与 BeT 相当但未超越；真实机器人测试计划在后续版本中进行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 ElevateHead 动作头，该动作头在学习的决策点一次性决定行动模式并对整个回合保持承诺，从而避免在多种有效方式间犹豫。
analysis.method: ElevateHead 通过诊断驱动设计：每个版本在未见任务上冻结测试，仅修改测量失败指向的部分，并在每次运行前注册预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究多模态模仿学习中动作头的作用，并提出 ElevateHead 在决策点一次性决定并持续承诺，以提高策略一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于视觉语言动作（VLA）策略中的动作头设计，属于机器人策略学习的核心问题，与 VLA 直接相关；未涉及世界模型或 WAM。

papers.abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly enable robots to follow language instructions, understanding their navigation decisions becomes important for reliable deployment. Existing explainability methods overlook a key challenge in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN): evidence for the current action may be distributed across historical and current observations and associated with different instruction stages. We identify instruction-stage insensitivity, where existing methods produce similar explanations despite changes across different navigation stages. To address this issue, we propose a stage-aware attribution framework for VLN. We first construct action-conditioned temporal instruction--visual attributions across observations. These attributions are projected into instruction space to estimate stage associations, which guide the aggregation of relevant historical evidence for refining the current explanation. An instruction-guided spatial filter further suppresses isolated responses while preserving compact, instruction-relevant regions. Experiments across multiple VLN policies and benchmarks show improved attribution quality over existing methods. We further demonstrate that our method acts as a diagnostic tool for analyzing failure cases, and validate its applicability to real-world navigation on a Unitree G1 robot.

analysis.key_results: 在多个视觉语言导航策略和基准上，归因质量优于现有方法；能诊断失败案例，并在Unitree G1机器人上验证了真实世界适用性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出分阶段感知的视觉归因框架，解决现有方法对指令阶段不敏感的问题。
analysis.method: 构建动作条件的时间指令-视觉归因，投影到指令空间估计阶段关联，并融合历史证据；使用指令引导的空间滤波器抑制孤立响应。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种分阶段感知的视觉归因框架，用于解释视觉语言导航中决策的证据，并在多个策略、基准和真实机器人上验证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文面向视觉语言导航，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）在导航任务中的可解释性研究，通过归因方法增强对VLA决策的理解，对VLA的可靠部署具有方法学价值。

figures.caption: Visual explanation challenges in VLN. (a) Explaining a generated token involves localizing its visual evidence while reducing interference from preceding tokens. (b) Explaining a navigation action requires recovering temporally distributed evidence across historical and current observations, while suppressing cross-stage interference from evidence associated with other instruction stages. Colored boxes schematically indicate stage-related regions. (c) Existing methods [ 14 ] are insensitive to instruction-stage transitions, exhibiting overlapping token attributions ( top ) and high cross-stage explanation similarity ( bottom ).
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of our framework. (a) We construct action-conditioned temporal instruction–visual attributions across historical and current observations. (b) We project each attribution into instruction space to estimate its associated instruction stage. (c) We weight historical observations by their stage correspondence with the current view and aggregate the resulting support to refine the current attribution. (d) We further use instruction–patch associations to suppress spatial noise while preserving decision-relevant visual evidence.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Explaining Navigation Decisions: Stage-Aware Visual Attribution for Vision-Language Navigation

papers.abstract: Low-bit weight--activation quantization reduces the memory and computation needed to deploy large language models, but activation rounding can still degrade accuracy after calibration. Reconstruction from rounded inputs cannot distinguish activations within the same quantization bin. We propose ResCom, a low-rank correction that uses the activation rounding residual to compensate for the resulting layer-output error. An output-aware calibration procedure selects residual directions by their contribution to output reconstruction and computes the correction in closed form, without gradient training or updates to the calibrated weights. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weights and activations, rank-32 attention corrections reduce WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.708 to 7.147, improve MMLU by 2.89 percentage points, and raise five-shot GSM8K accuracy from 23.96 to 36.16 percent. Evaluations on models from 1B to 70B parameters and on held-out C4 test the method beyond this setting. The evaluated FP32 implementation adds 2.25 percent to 4K prefill time; a separate compact-storage implementation retains a 27.7 percent peak-memory reduction relative to FP16.

analysis.key_results: Llama-3-8B 4-bit 权重与激活量化下，rank-32 注意力校正将 WikiText-2 困惑度从 7.708 降至 7.147，MMLU 提升 2.89 个百分点，5-shot GSM8K 准确率从 23.96% 提高到 36.16%。此外在 1B 到 70B 参数模型和 C4 上进行了评估。4K prefill 时间增加 2.25%，紧凑存储实现相对 FP16 保留 27.7% 峰值内存减少。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ResCom，一种利用激活舍入残差的低秩校正方法，并以闭式解进行输出感知校准，无需梯度训练或更新已校准权重。
analysis.method: 低秩校正，输出感知校准选择残差方向，闭式计算校正量；使用激活舍入残差补偿量化误差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ResCom 提出一种低秩校正方法，使用激活舍入残差来补偿低比特量化引起的层输出误差。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大型语言模型的激活量化补偿，属于独立的模型量化领域，未直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人系统；其方法可能对部署视觉-语言-动作模型中的语言组件具有潜在参考价值，但摘要未建立直接关联。

papers.abstract: Interactive world models hold immense potential for high-stakes applications in robotics, game engines, and immersive digital twins, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on perceptual similarity rather than the physical-causal coherence essential for real-world utility. We introduce WMEval, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates interactive world models against Unity-based physical simulations. By leveraging Unity as a high-fidelity ground-truth oracle, we shift evaluation beyond perceptual visual assessment toward the objective state-based verification required for downstream applications. Spanning 9 diverse scenes, WMEval assesses action controllability, scene and character consistency, prompt adherence, kinematics, fluid mechanics, physical causality, and lighting. By executing matched action sequences in both the simulator and the world model, WMEval enables evaluation at both the perceptual level and the physical-causal level, using simulator-derived states as reference. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal significant room for improvement in dimensions that remain hidden by standard perceptual metrics but are vital for real-world deployments. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/WMEval.

analysis.key_results: 在现有最先进模型上的实验表明，在标准感知指标掩盖但实际部署重要的维度上仍有显著改进空间。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 WMEval 基准，利用 Unity 作为高保真真值，对交互式世界模型进行状态级物理因果评估，涵盖 9 个场景和多个维度。
analysis.method: 在模拟器和世界模型中执行匹配的动作序列，以模拟器状态为参考，在感知层面和物理因果层面进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WMEval 是一个基于 Unity 物理仿真的交互式世界模型评估基准，超越感知相似度，侧重于物理因果一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对世界模型（World Model）的评估，强调物理因果一致性和动作可控性，与人形机器人世界模型（WAM）的核心挑战高度契合，对 VLA/WAM 评估具有方法借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Zero-shot object navigation requires an embodied agent to choose where to search while retaining evidence from previous observations. HGWM couples an LLM-generated room-anchor prior with persistent spatial-semantic memory. A coarse stage assigns visual-semantic scores to candidate headings on a 0-10 scale; a fine stage measures symbolic compatibility between observed objects, room context, and the goal prior. Phase-dependent fusion combines these scores with an LLM direction recommendation before local action selection. On HM3D v0.1, the reported HGWM configuration achieves 62.6% success rate (SR) and 31.5% success weighted by path length (SPL), compared with 58.1% and 31.2% for WMNav. On MP3D, the corresponding values are 46.8% and 17.9%, compared with 45.4% and 17.2%. The results indicate higher success point estimates and modest path-efficiency gains. On HM3D v0.2, the full model obtains 74.4% SR and 31.9% SPL. Additional component ablations reduce SR by 0.9-2.3 percentage points and SPL by 0.6-1.5 points. These are author-reported aggregate measurements. The accompanying implementation repairs pass offline tests; episode-level rerun records are not available. Evaluation is confined to simulation.

analysis.key_results: 在HM3D v0.1上，HGWM达到62.6% SR和31.5% SPL（对比WMNav 58.1%和31.2%）；MP3D上为46.8%和17.9%（对比45.4%和17.2%）；HM3D v0.2全模型为74.4% SR和31.9% SPL；消融实验导致SR下降0.9-2.3个百分点，SPL下降0.6-1.5个百分点。
analysis.limitations: 评估仅限于仿真；实现通过离线测试，但无逐episode重跑记录；结果均为作者报告的聚合测量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HGWM框架，耦合LLM先验与持久空间语义记忆，实现零样本物体导航中的分阶段评分与融合决策。
analysis.method: 使用LLM生成房间锚先验，构建持久空间语义记忆；粗阶段对候选航向赋予视觉-语义分数（0-10），细阶段度量观察对象、房间上下文与目标先验的符号兼容性；相依赖融合结合粗-细分数与LLM方向推荐后选择局部动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HGWM，将LLM生成的房间锚点先验与持久空间语义记忆结合，通过粗-细两阶段评分和相依赖融合指导零样本物体导航。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接属于WAM（世界模型）研究范畴，利用分层图引导世界模型进行零样本物体导航，对机器人动作选择与世界建模有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation. Project page: https://zephipage.github.io/UniWorld.

analysis.key_results: 在连续生成、配对历史干预与长时程行为上评估；稳态DiT执行路径达到实时生成吞吐量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniWorld框架，结合深度轨迹和参考外观在共享视频生成模型中实现连续视觉世界模拟。
analysis.method: 通过噪声对齐重叠延续与滚动深度潜在状态，保证潜历史精确保留，同时限制活动深度状态为窗口大小。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: UniWorld提出一个统一框架，在同一视频生成模型中整合深度轨迹与参考外观，实现连续视觉世界模拟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于世界模型范畴，致力于连续视觉世界模拟，但其核心创新在于视频生成效率与一致性，未直接涉及VLA或机器人动作世界模型。

Each continuation window packs video history, depth/control, reference, and separator tokens into a shared DiT sequence. Overlapping positions are retained, only the newly required depth suffix is read, and only the newly generated video suffix is committed to the output stream.

papers.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) in sub-8-bit arithmetic promises substantial gains in memory bandwidth and compute throughput, yet FP4 formats introduce quantization error severe enough to destabilize optimization if left unaddressed. We present ALTO, an open-source training recipe for GPT-OSS-20B, a 20-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, on the MLPerf Small MoE Training benchmark under the MXFP4 microscaling format. The recipe combines established techniques from Abecassis, Felix et al. [arXiv:2509.25149] (hybrid 1D/2D block quantization, randomized Hadamard transforms, and stochastic rounding) with a simplified weight de-oscillation scheme adapted from TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527]. On C4 validation at global batch size 16, MXFP4 + RHT + SR + de-oscillation reaches a validation loss of 3.3350 at 16,128 steps, only 0.007 above the BF16 baseline (3.3283), closing roughly 50% of the gap left by MXFP4 without de-oscillation (3.3418). Measured by steps to reach the MLPerf quality target (validation loss 3.34), de-oscillation cuts the FP4 convergence overhead relative to BF16 from +20.0% to +5.0%. We also report negative end-to-end results from differential gradient estimation, outlier clipping, and macro-block scaling, despite each showing operator-level SNR gains. All experiments use simulated MXFP4 kernels on AMD MI300X hardware and wall-clock speed has not been optimized.

analysis.key_results: 在C4验证集上，MXFP4+RHT+SR+去振荡在16,128步达到验证损失3.3350，比BF16基线（3.3283）仅高0.007；与无去振荡的MXFP4（3.3418）相比，进一步缩小了约50%的差距；达到MLPerf质量目标所需步数的开销从+20.0%降至+5.0%。
analysis.limitations: 所有实验使用模拟的MXFP4内核，且墙钟速度尚未优化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ALTO训练配方，结合混合块量化、随机Hadamard变换、随机舍入和简化的权重去振荡，有效缩小了MXFP4训练与BF16基线的性能差距。
analysis.method: 采用混合1D/2D块量化、随机Hadamard变换、随机舍入和简化的权重去振荡方案，在MLPerf Small MoE Training基准上训练GPT-OSS-20B模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出ALTO训练方案，利用混合量化、随机Hadamard变换和权重去振荡等技术，在MXFP4格式下训练20B MoE模型，将验证损失差距缩小至BF16基线约50%。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly reason before acting, but existing reasoning models compress this intermediate decision into a single representation. When several plans are valid, this commitment hides alternatives that could otherwise be selected or revised. We introduce the Generative Plan Latent (GPL), which represents the reasoning state as a low-dimensional conditional distribution over plans, such as which object, grasp, or route to use. This makes the reasoning state addressable: without retraining the VLA, plans can be sampled (coverage), selected on request (steering), and reweighted by deployment outcomes (outcome adaptation). We test all three on SimplerEnv manipulation with $\pi_0$, and extend the analysis to RoboCasa, LIBERO, and a maze domain. Steering the plan raises the fraction of executions that follow the request from 0.48 to 0.94, while the same guidance on the native action distribution shows no reliable gain. Finally, we show that an explicit plan is most useful when it carries decision information not already determined by the observation.

analysis.key_results: 在SimplerEnv上使用π0，将执行遵循请求的比例从0.48提升至0.94；对原生动作分布施加相同引导无可靠增益；显式计划在观察未决定决策时最有用。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出生成式计划潜变量，将推理状态表示为条件于计划的低维分布，使VLA的推理状态可寻址，支持覆盖、引导和结果自适应。
analysis.method: 生成式计划潜变量表示条件计划分布，并基于该潜变量进行采样、引导和结果加权。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出生成式计划潜变量，将VLA的推理状态表示为可寻址的计划分布，在无需重新训练的情况下支持计划采样、引导和结果自适应。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $\pi_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $\pi_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.

analysis.key_results: π0.5获得了比Octo更高的任务性能分数，并且在分布偏移下退化较少；本体感知信息对策略性能有影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个集成了任务特定演示收集和预训练策略适配的仿真到现实框架，用于农业机器人操作，并在MuJoCo中构建了包含多样化番茄植株的农业仿真环境。
analysis.method: 在MuJoCo仿真中使用操纵杆遥操作收集专家演示，对预训练通用机器人策略Octo和π0.5进行适配，随后在真实Franka Research 3机械臂上使用真实演示进一步微调，并在仿真和真实环境中进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作开发了一个仿真到现实的机器人学习框架，通过收集仿真和真实演示来微调预训练VLA策略（Octo和π0.5），用于农业环境中的抓取和够取任务。

papers.abstract: The throughput gains of speculative decoding depend on the trade-off between acceptance length and execution latency. We ask when additional acceptance is worth the cost of obtaining it. We establish a comparison protocol spanning training, inference, and evaluation, remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two target models. Alignment changes the picture: gaps that appear large in published comparisons shrink substantially under shared training and inference conditions. This narrowing motivates two deeper questions: how is acceptance improved at different costs, and when do these gains improve throughput? We find that acceptance can be improved through nearly free objective and context changes or more expensive token-to-token conditioning, which pays off most clearly under sampled drafting. DCore illustrates the former route as a strong baseline with little additional measured drafting overhead. The payoff is conditional: task uncertainty and serving conditions affect acceptance returns, execution costs, and the preferred drafter and budget. These findings inform future drafter design and deployment choices.

analysis.key_results: 接受率差距在统一条件下大幅缩小；接受率可通过近乎零成本的目标和上下文改变或更昂贵的逐token条件化改进，后者在采样草稿下收益最明显；收益取决于任务不确定性和服务条件。
analysis.main_contribution: 建立统一的训练、推理和评估协议，在共享目标生成数据上重训练六种草稿模型，并重新测量已发布检查点，揭示对齐条件下接受率差距缩小，并阐明接受率改进的不同代价及其对吞吐量的条件性影响。
analysis.method: 在十个基准和两个目标模型上，使用共享目标生成数据重训练六种草稿模型，统一训练、推理和评估流程，对比接受长度和执行延迟，并引入DCore作为低开销草稿基线。

papers.abstract: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

analysis.key_results: 在50个RoboTwin任务上平均成功率达94.21%；将WAM骨干替换为OpenWAM-α后提升至95.56%，创开源新SOTA；仅2B参数的VLM优于Embodied-R1.5和GPT-5.5 High变体；在三个长程真实机器人任务上平均成功率65%，对比π0.5的28.33%和Fast-WAM的25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LAW框架，将VLM与WAM结合，利用混合专家VLM进行子任务规划、动作融合和状态评估，并引入双流分层视觉记忆和子任务局部价值学习，实现语言、动作和世界建模的统一。
analysis.method: 闭环VLM-WAM框架：混合专家VLM负责剩余子任务规划、世界动作模型提议的动作价值估计与融合以及异步状态评估；WAM采用混合Transformer专家进行联合视频-动作建模；双流分层视觉记忆维护时间上下文；子任务局部价值学习对齐动作评估与语义目标并保留失败轨迹成功前缀的监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LAW，一种闭环VLM-WAM框架，通过语义子任务进度统一语言推理、动作生成和世界建模，在RoboTwin和真实机器人任务上取得领先成功率。

papers.abstract: Robots that follow natural-language instructions unlock a wide range of autonomous applications in households, warehouses, and labs. Real-world environments are diverse and often heavily cluttered, requiring robots to plan over multiple steps, act, and replan as they work toward a goal. We present CLARO (CLutter-Aware Robot Orchestrator), a VLM agent that orchestrates a set of perception and manipulation skills: open-vocabulary object detection, segmentation, 6-DoF grasping, and non-prehensile pushing to locate and retrieve a language-specified target in clutter. CLARO maintains a memory of its past actions to support long-horizon execution, and emits manipulation targets (grasp poses/3D waypoints) allowing transfer across robot arms without task-specific training. We evaluate CLARO against a range of methods on a dynamic simulation environment and standard image-based benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization across object classes, lighting, and clutter levels. CLARO attains an average success rate of 89.1%, a relative improvement of over 16% on the strongest competing method in high cluttered scenes. We further analyze performance along grounding and grasping axes to characterize where each method succeeds and fails. Finally, we deploy CLARO on a robot arm across diverse cluttered scenes, achieving a success rate of 88.8%, and demonstrating strong sim2real generalizability.

analysis.key_results: 在动态模拟环境中平均成功率为89.1%，在高杂乱场景中比最强竞争方法相对提升超过16%；在真实机械臂上成功率达88.8%，展现出强大的sim2real泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CLARO，一个VLM智能体，通过协调感知和操作技能（开放词汇检测、分割、6-DoF抓取、非抓取推动）在杂乱环境中完成语言指定的抓取任务，并保持动作记忆支持长程执行，且无需任务特定训练即可迁移到不同机械臂。
analysis.method: 使用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为智能体，协调开放词汇物体检测、分割、6-DoF抓取和非抓取推动等技能，维护动作记忆，并输出操作目标（抓取姿态/3D路点）来实现跨机械臂迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CLARO是一个VLM智能体，协调感知与操作技能，在杂乱环境中根据自然语言指令抓取目标物体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于VLA范畴，提出了一个基于VLM的机器人策略智能体，用于语言引导的杂乱环境抓取操作，与本站关注的主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at over $90\%$ of positions, but not which position comes next. We introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), a 0.62M-parameter model that reads only the target's output distributions, predicts this order and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, which the target verifies in a single pass by state equality. Coupled-noise match, which shares Gumbel noise between drafter and target, keeps this verification exact at any temperature. This approach also inspired us to introduce SPOT-Sets for dynamic threshold decoding, where a pass commits several positions: SPOT-Sets drafts whole commit sets together with their tokens. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to $6.8\times$ and reaches up to $3.4\times$ the throughput of standard decoding on SDAR-8B, matching or beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at $T=0$ and $T=1$. In addition, we show that SPOT's learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs; with a light calibration, the SPOT-Sets drafter transfers as well. On top of dynamic threshold decoding, SPOT-Sets improves the throughput of SDAR-8B by 59% on average over the threshold decoder alone. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

analysis.key_results: SPOT在SDAR-8B上将目标传递次数减少高达6.8倍，吞吐量达到标准解码的3.4倍；在T=0和T=1的所有任务和预算中匹配或优于校准和无训练基线；SPOT草稿模型可跨六个不同DLM迁移；SPOT-Sets在动态阈值解码基础上平均提高59%吞吐量。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入SPOT，一种用于扩散语言模型的推测解码方法，利用小型草稿模型预测提交顺序并生成候选延续，通过状态相等性在单次传递中验证，同时提出SPOT-Sets支持动态阈值解码。
analysis.method: SPOT使用0.62M参数的模型预测去掩码顺序，生成候选树，目标模型通过状态相等性验证；采用耦合噪声匹配（共享Gumbel噪声）保证任意温度下的精确验证；SPOT-Sets进一步将多个提交位置一起草稿。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出SPOT方法，通过预测去掩码顺序并共享Gumbel噪声，为扩散语言模型实现无损的推测解码加速。

papers.abstract: How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present PlayPolicy: Dexterity from supervised play (DSP), a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. In real world experiment, our method outperforms hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in success rate and achieves comparable success to reinforcement learning with 490 times less interaction data. These results demonstrate that supervised play can autonomously collect interaction data, guide model-based planning, and enable policy learning without any task-specific demonstrations or sim-to-real transfer. Project page: https://play-policy.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 在真实世界实验中，该方法在成功率上比事后行为克隆高69.6%，并以少490倍的交互数据达到与强化学习相当的成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了PlayPolicy框架，实现从监督玩耍中自主收集交互数据、训练世界模型并引导基于模型的规划，无需任务特定演示或仿真到现实迁移。
analysis.method: 行为克隆学习玩耍策略，自主部署收集交互数据训练世界模型，使用模型预测控制（MPC）评估候选动作序列，并通过在世界模型内自玩蒸馏出闭环目标条件策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种框架，机器人通过克隆人类玩耍行为几分钟学会玩耍策略，自主收集数小时交互数据训练世界模型，并利用该世界模型进行模型预测控制或蒸馏出目标条件策略，实现灵巧操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心包含世界模型的构建和利用，用于机器人灵巧操作。该方法直接支撑机器人世界建模与基于模型的规划，与本站世界模型（WAM）主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search over image descriptors and embeddings underlies visual retrieval, near-duplicate detection, the evaluation of learned representations, and increasingly the memory of LLM agents. However, exhaustive search computes every distance at full precision, whereas approximate indexes return recall below one. We observe that exact search only needs a proof that each excluded vector cannot be a neighbor. Because such a proof only has to be conservative, it can be checked in low precision, much as the retina examines the whole scene at low resolution. We call this principle certified exclusion and realize it in an exact kNN method for GPUs, which we call CertEx. Specifically, CertEx stores a lower-bounding projection of each vector in half precision and folds a rounding certificate into the same tensor-core dot product, so that only the few vectors that the test keeps need exact distances. We prove that CertEx returns the exact kNN of every query. On sixteen datasets with up to 100M vectors, CertEx is exact for every query at 7.1$\times$ to 18.0$\times$ the throughput of the fastest cuVS search on one H100 (8.8$\times$ to 11.8$\times$ on an A100) and outperforms quantized and graph indexes whenever every query must be exact.

analysis.key_results: 在16个数据集（最高1亿向量）上，CertEx对每个查询均精确，吞吐量比最快的cuVS高7.1至18.0倍（A100上8.8至11.8倍），在要求精确查询时优于量化与图索引。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出认证排除原则并实现CertEx方法，用于GPU上的精确kNN搜索，保证所有查询返回精确结果。
analysis.method: 使用半精度存储向量低界投影，将舍入证书融入张量核心点积，仅对少数通过测试的向量计算精确距离。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CertEx利用半精度低界投影和舍入证书在GPU上实现精确k近邻搜索，在保持确切性的同时显著提升吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于视觉检索的精确kNN搜索与高效距离计算中的量化技术，与VLA、WAM等机器人世界模型无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have recently achieved remarkable progress by leveraging large-scale robot datasets and foundation models for general-purpose robot manipulation. However, their ability to rapidly adapt to novel manipulation tasks beyond the training distribution remains limited. Existing approaches often require task-specific robot demonstrations and additional training, which are labor- and compute-intensive, limiting the scalability of VLA adaptation to open-world scenarios. To reduce this dependence on target-task robot data, we propose CapPro, a framework that enables a VLA policy to adapt to previously unseen manipulation tasks using only a single human demonstration video. CapPro consists of two components. First, a phase-aware human video representation module constructs a compact video representation through learned visual token selection and learns task-relevant query representations under phase-caption supervision. Second, a video-conditioned adaptation module jointly incorporates the compact video and query-derived representations into the action-conditioning context of the pretrained VLA policy. % This design introduces task-specific guidance while largely preserving the original VLA action-generation backbone. In this way, the human demonstration provides task-specific execution guidance rather than an embodiment-aligned trajectory to imitate, without requiring target-task robot demonstrations or target-task fine-tuning. Experiments across source and unseen target tasks show that CapPro improves average performance across unseen target groups while maintaining comparable performance on the source tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of human-video guidance for cross-task VLA adaptation.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明，CapPro在未见目标任务组上的平均性能有所提升，同时在源任务上保持了相当的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了CapPro框架，实现仅用单个人类演示视频对预训练VLA模型进行跨任务适配，避免了目标任务的机器人演示收集和额外训练。
analysis.method: CapPro包含相位感知的人类视频表示模块（通过学习的视觉令牌选择和相位-描述监督学习任务相关查询表示）和视频条件适配模块（将紧凑视频表示和查询派生表示融入预训练VLA策略的动作条件上下文）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CapPro框架，使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仅利用单个人类示范视频即可适配到未见过的操作任务，无需目标机器人演示或微调。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的快速适配问题，属于VLA主题的核心研究。它解决了机器人操作策略的跨任务泛化挑战，利用人类示范视频提供任务指导而非轨迹模仿，为VLA在开放世界中的高效适配提供了新方法。

papers.abstract: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce MemWM, a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. MemWM learns high-level representations directly from observations and uses them to condition predictions via adaptive layer normalization, complementing low-level action-conditioned dynamics within a shared latent space. To prevent memory slots from collapsing into identical representations, we propose two complementary losses that encourage structural diversity across slots and balanced utilization across time steps. On PushT, TwoRoom, Reacher, and OGBCube, MemWM attains an average success rate of 89.9%, matching DINO-WM (89.3%) while using 4$\times$ fewer trainable parameters and no pretrained encoder, and improving over LeWM by 4.1%.

analysis.key_results: 在 PushT、TwoRoom、Reacher、OGBCube 上平均成功率达 89.9%，与 DINO-WM 相当（89.3%），但参数少 4 倍且无预训练编码器，超过 LeWM 4.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MemWM，一种记忆增强的潜世界模型，使用内容寻址记忆库和自适应层归一化调节预测，并设计两种损失防止记忆槽坍缩。
analysis.method: 在潜空间中将 JEPA 风格预测与内容寻址记忆结合，通过自适应层归一化利用高层表示调节预测；用结构多样性和时间步平衡利用损失训练记忆。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MemWM 引入内容寻址记忆库增强 JEPA 风格潜世界模型，以更少参数且不依赖预训练编码器，在多个机器人控制任务上取得与现有方法相当的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 核心工作是面向机器人的世界模型（WAM），通过记忆增强提升长时程规划效率，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

analysis.key_results: VPP2-14B在开放式任务的视频预测指令遵循成功率上比Cosmos3-64B高11.0个百分点；在真实世界零样本ALOHA操作任务上比最强基线高18.5个百分点；在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD和RoboDojo上取得最高成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了VPP2，一个具有强零样本泛化能力的WAM，在视频预测和动作生成方面均优于基线。
analysis.method: 大规模操作视频持续预训练、事件级视频预训练、单步视觉规划器蒸馏、混合Transformer动作模块学习隐式逆动力学。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VPP2通过持续预训练、蒸馏和混合Transformer动作模块，构建了一个在视频预测和动作生成上具有强零样本泛化能力的世界动作模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心是WAM，旨在提升世界动作模型的零样本泛化能力，直接相关于机器人动作预测和世界建模主题。
