papers.abstract: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned through higher-precision latents and deployed as ternary codes by an export that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts latents to bf16. We audit releases from three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes (Falcon-E, BitCPM) and 1.530% (2B-4T); most Falcon-E and BitCPM disagreements are bf16 products exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints with ULP-matched rates, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% (Falcon-E-1B-Base) and 36.13% to 0.39% (BitCPM-CANN-0.5B), and a bf16 save and reload lowers 2B-4T's by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises at that endpoint. The strict decrease recurs at each of three new seeds in all three models and has the same direction on 607 reserve test rows, but it is recipe-dependent: at Falcon-E's online-loss-selected rate the export was non-inferior, and after a longer recipe no difference was detected. Two remedies, writing the trained codes directly or adjusting bf16 inputs so unchanged tools emit them, met an inherited 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion in all three models, also for the pooled mean over three fixed new trajectories per model and, separately, on the reserve rows. In a frozen study of bf16 latents in fine-tuning (one task, one trajectory per arm), native bf16 writes left 2B-4T's endpoint codes unchanged and changed one Falcon-E code; emulated stochastic-rounding and compensated writers changed codes and were non-inferior to fp32 training at that margin. In two model families, randomized threshold-distance interventions support distance-dependent selection of changed codes.

analysis.key_results: 在发布的检查点中，fp32量化潜在变量与部署代码不一致的比例在0.83-1.77%之间（Falcon-E、BitCPM）及1.530%（2B-4T）；文档化导出流程使Falcon-E-1B-Base在GSM8K上的严格准确率从58.79%降至0.78%，BitCPM-CANN-0.5B从36.13%降至0.39%；两种补救方法在三个模型中均满足4个百分点的严格准确率非劣效性标准。
analysis.limitations: 论文指出导出问题依赖于具体配方：在Falcon-E的在线损失选择速率下导出非劣效，且在更长配方后未检测到差异；补救方法的非劣效性仅在所采用的4个百分点标准下成立。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过审计三组发布的三元语言模型，揭露了导出流程中bf16转换导致的三元代码不一致现象及其对下游任务性能的显著负面影响，并提出了两种有效补救措施。
analysis.method: 对多个发布的三元语言模型检查点进行审计，比较导出的三元码与直接由潜在变量量化得到的代码之间的差异；在不同微调端点和随机种子下评估导出流程对GSM8K严格准确率的影响；提出直接写出训练后的码或调整bf16输入两种补救方法，并通过非劣效性检验验证其有效性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文审计了三个实验室发布的三元语言模型，发现将高精度潜在变量转换为bf16再导出为三元码的过程会导致大量代码不一致，并显著降低模型在GSM8K上的严格准确率，同时提出并验证了两种补救方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究的是三元语言模型导出流程中的量化问题，属于独立的模型量化主题，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或世界模型（WAM）无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和VLABench上，推理策略和要点策略均比最强基线成功率高近6%；要点策略在单卡A6000上推理延迟从1081ms降至169.5ms，加速高达6.38倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出IG-VLA框架，通过潜在时空推理在视觉表示空间想象未来场景演化，并利用场景要点记忆将其内化为紧凑的场景要点令牌，从而在不进行显式未来想象的情况下保持推理优势并大幅提升效率。
analysis.method: Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning和Scene Gist Memory，在视觉表示空间学习任务相关的未来场景演化，并将推理得到的场景-行为关联压缩为场景要点令牌。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过潜在时空推理与场景要点记忆，使VLA模型能够内化未来想象，在保持推理效果的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接改进VLA模型的推理效率，通过内化时空想象降低推理延迟，对部署VLA于机器人操作任务具有直接实际价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target forward pass. However, as the context grows, existing state-of-the-art drafters become increasingly expensive, eroding the very efficiency advantage they are designed to provide. We argue that this scaling is unnecessary. A standalone language model must grow with its prefix because it is solely responsible for every token it produces. A drafter, by contrast, only proposes candidates; the target catches and corrects every error before any token is committed. The drafter's decoding cost can therefore be made entirely independent of the prefix length. We introduce LongSpark, a block-diffusion drafter that achieves this by extracting fixed-size, multiscale views from the target's verification pass, thereby eliminating the need for a growing persistent state. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LongSpark achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end efficiency across multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions. Notably, it delivers the lowest time-per-output-token on long-context tasks while reducing the drafter's context state by several orders of magnitude.

analysis.key_results: 在多个模型规模和真实服务条件下实现最先进的端到端效率；在长上下文任务上实现最低的每输出令牌时间，同时将起草器的上下文状态缩减数个数量级。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 LongSpark，一种块扩散起草器，通过从目标验证过程中提取固定尺寸多尺度视图，消除对持续增长状态的需求，实现起草器解码成本与上下文长度无关。
analysis.method: LongSpark 块扩散起草器，从目标验证过程中提取固定尺寸多尺度视图，实现固定成本并行起草。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LongSpark 提出一种块扩散起草器，使推测解码中起草器成本与前缀长度无关，从而提升长上下文场景下的端到端效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。该论文专注于推测解码这一通用高效推理技术，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作/世界建模。

(b) Three fixed-size context views are extracted from the target’s state: a boundary state, a recent KV window, and a global context summary. (c) The drafter uses these views to propose the next token block at a cost independent of prefix length.

papers.abstract: Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

analysis.key_results: 在科学、数学和通用视觉理解基准上，VisKG达到与基线相当或更好的性能，且所需token少于基于描述的表示；使用GDPO训练相比GRPO平均准确率提升2%。
analysis.main_contribution: VisKG框架：利用强化学习将视觉输入转换为问题特定的知识图谱表示，遵循最小充分信息原则过滤感知噪声，从而支持链式思维推理并降低推理成本。
analysis.method: 基于RL的视觉到知识图谱转换（VisKG），采用GDPO（组奖励解耦归一化策略优化）进行稳定RL后训练，并在监督阶段引入负样本推理路径；推理时使用知识图谱表示代替详细的图像描述。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VisKG框架，通过强化学习将视觉内容转换为问题特定的知识图谱表示，在减少token数量的同时保持推理精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文针对视觉问答中的高效推理，提出使用知识图谱作为视觉输入的紧凑表示。虽然不直接涉及VLA或WAM，但其核心思路——用结构化、最小充分信息替代冗余的视觉描述——与机器人任务中对视觉信息的高效编码和推理需求有方法上的相似性，可视为对未来在VLA中引入知识图谱表示以减少计算开销的潜在启发，但目前无直接关联。

figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the VisKG training framework. The framework consists of two rollouts: standard rollout (black solid line) and KG-based rollout (black dashed line). In the standard rollout, the model generates information in a predefined format given an image and a question, and receives an answer reward and a format reward. In the KG-based rollout, the model generates a reasoning trace and final answer conditioned on the KG and the question, and receives a minimality reward and a sufficiency reward. The total reward is computed as the sum of all rewards from both rollouts and is used to update the VLM.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning

papers.abstract: Four-bit post-training quantization can reduce the memory demands of large language models, but preserving accuracy under strict MXFP4 W4A4 requires coordinating several design choices. Coordinate transforms change block-encoding errors, which in turn affect the residuals propagated through the network. The useful algorithmic decomposition is therefore not fully known before search. LLM-driven program evolution offers a way to explore these choices, but performance scores alone do not explain which design should change next. We introduce QuantForge, a PTQ discovery system that records competing explanations, selects controls that distinguish them, and checks that successor code implements the resulting conclusions. This residual compilation guides program revisions while retaining useful programs even when their original explanations are rejected. Remeasuring the revised program reveals the next error to address. This process discovers HiRes, a fixed MXFP4 quantizer that shapes coordinates, refines legal code assignments, and recovers errors along attention and MLP paths. Each stage acts on residuals measured after the preceding stage has executed. Across seven tasks, HiRes achieves the lowest seven-model Robust Fit (0.09300) and the lowest quantized Fit-7 at 32B. In matched-budget comparisons of LLM-driven program evolution, each with 240 evaluator calls, QuantForge reaches a held-out transfer target in six of eight runs, compared with three each for textual memory and reflection memory, and one for score-only evolution, despite evaluating fewer new programs. These results show that QuantForge improves the discovery of transferable PTQ algorithms by turning controlled evidence into subsequent program changes. We have open-sourced the QuantForge search framework.

papers.abstract: Expert demonstrations often specify what a robot should do, but not how fast it can do it. Imitation Learning (IL) inherits demonstration timing, while directly accelerating the learned motion can fail when faster execution changes the robot-object dynamics. We study faster-than-demonstration execution as a dynamics-aware control problem and introduce Expert-Play Contouring Control (EPCC), which combines slow expert demonstrations with fast, non-expert play. Expert demonstrations train a latent trajectory generator whose predictions are reparameterized into a time-independent contour of successful task progression, while play trains a world model (WM) of fast-action outcomes. At deployment, our proposed planner uses the WM to optimize actions that makes maximize progress along the expert-derived contour while penalizing deviation from the intended task evolution. Averaged across three visuomotor manipulation tasks, EPCC achieves a $2.0\times$ the throughput of the IL baseline, including $2.2\times$ that of the throughput of the strongest acceleration baseline on a task with interaction-sensitive object dynamics. Our analysis shows that the gains concentrate where faster execution changes robot-object evolution. Together, our results highlight a simple yet effective principle: demonstrations provide task intent, while play data provides the dynamic coverage needed to execute that intent faster.

analysis.key_results: 在三个视觉运动操作任务上平均实现2倍于IL基线的吞吐量，其中一个交互敏感任务上实现2.2倍于最强加速基线的吞吐量。

analysis.method: 专家演示训练潜轨迹生成器并重参数化为时间无关轮廓；游玩数据训练快动作结果的世界模型；部署时规划器使用世界模型优化动作以最大化轮廓进度同时惩罚偏离任务演化。

papers.abstract: As robotic systems grow more general, legal norms are needed to integrate them into society. This paper extends the isomorphism problem of aligning legal source texts with their encodings, and measures two key challenges to robot normative control: (1) the grounding isomorphism gap, where perception error grounds false atoms for legal reasoning, and (2) the ontological isomorphism gap, where one legal conclusion admits many faithful translations into planning constraints. The paper introduces a legal planning stack that employs Defeasible Deontic Logic (DDL) to constrain a motion planner. The stack leverages learned world models to plan and to provide legal context, enabling ex ante governance that intervenes before an illegal action is executed. It was deployed on a simulated robot arm pushing a cube across a 3x3 grid. The findings were (1) the legislated agent abided substantially more often than the non-legislated one, and modeling perception uncertainty lifted abidance even further, (2) the legal reasoning ran efficiently at runtime and its verdicts were auditable, and (3) the stack adapted to exogenous signals and endogenous rule changes. Both gaps were measured: (4) world model and probe error corrupted the factual input for the DDL reasoner, and (5) a single law admitted several faithful metric interpretations yielding drastically different abidance. Thus, ex ante legislation functions as intended, and closing these gaps with a standardized mapping from the law to runtime constraints and improved fact grounding from perception will yield robust laws that align robot behavior with society's norms. Project page: https://dylanwaldner-cail.github.io/Legislated-Planner/.

papers.abstract: Developers download quantized large language models (LLMs) from public registries to run them locally. None of the registries we examined documented functional testing of their files. We tested all 305 eligible code-capable GGUF tags (the llama.cpp format) across 15 model lines in the official Ollama library, plus 22 popular Hugging Face community files. A 15-task code screen identified suspects, which we retested on all 164 HumanEval+ tasks. Seven official tags (2.3%) solved at most six of them. All were low-bit quantizations of models with at most four billion parameters. We rebuilt five suspect files from the original weights. All five registry files matched our uncalibrated rebuilds tensor for tensor, so none was corrupted. Exact reproducibility did not imply function. With the weights, toolchain and tensor mix held fixed, adding an importance matrix raised three Qwen2.5-Coder-3B builds from zero to 76-113 solved tasks. The same uncalibrated recipe left the smaller Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B functional, showing that the recipe alone does not predict failure. None of 66 sampled tags that passed the screen was non-functional. We release the audit data and the quantcheck tool and recommend screening low-bit tags before publication, then calibrating or withholding failures.

papers.abstract: World models promise a general route to embodied intelligence: learn predictive dynamics once, then reason, plan, and act with them. Increasingly, the representations beneath such models are pretrained on large-scale video, interaction, and multimodal corpora, which raises a question prediction quality alone cannot answer: when is a learned representation actually actionable? We identify a failure mode we call counterfactual collapse: a model predicts visually plausible futures while failing to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences. This arises whenever a representation is optimized for perceptual similarity rather than intervention structure, which is precisely the objective under which most large-scale pretrained encoders are learned. We introduce Counterfactual Latent World Models (CLWM), which combine a recurrent belief-state encoder, action-conditioned latent dynamics, and a contrastive counterfactual objective that separates futures induced by distinct interventions even when their observations look alike. Across occluded manipulation, aliased navigation, and long-horizon manipulation, CLWM improves planning success over the strongest baseline (65.1% $\to$ 74.6% on Occluded Push and 67.3% $\to$ 78.9% on Aliased Maze) and reduces exploitative planning failures (18.4% $\to$ 9.7% on Deferred Kitchen), with ablations attributing the gains to hard counterfactual negatives, especially perceptual-alias negatives. Finally, our counterfactual separability metric, which tracks planning success across the five baseline model classes ($r \ge 0.94$), is representation-agnostic: given intervention-outcome labels, it can audit any encoder, pretrained or trained from scratch, before a planner trusts it. We do not yet measure it on large-scale pretrained encoders. Here we establish the metric and its relationship to planning success for world models trained from scratch.

analysis.key_results: 在Occluded Push上规划成功率从65.1%提升到74.6%，在Aliased Maze上从67.3%提升到78.9%，在Deferred Kitchen上剥削性规划失败率从18.4%降低到9.7%。

papers.abstract: Reliable robot-to-human handover requires the robot to infer when the person is ready to receive the object and release it safely, comfortably, and at the right time. This is challenging because visual observations alone may not disambiguate clear taking intent from accidental contact, weak grasping, wrong-direction forces, or transient interactions. In this work we treat human-robot handover as an intrinsically multimodal problem. Our approach couples a VLA model with a compliance controller that reduces interaction forces during object transfer. We finetune the VLA model with human demonstrations using RGB observation, temporally encoded tactile feedback and proprioception. We evaluate the complete system in a human-subject study against two baselines: one without tactile feedback and one using tactile feedback without compliance control. We hypothesize that combining compliance and temporal tactile encoding yields the most reliable and comfortable handovers, as compliance facilitates physical interaction while tactile history captures sustained taking intent. Performance is measured through objective metrics and an ad-hoc questionnaire. The results show that the two components provide complementary benefits and substantially outperform the baselines. Project page: https://hsp-iit.github.io/temporal-tactile-bimanual-handover/.

papers.abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference while holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state risk control conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration typically assumes that the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, a condition that policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional risk control remains valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous validation of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that validity proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. We call the resulting method RouteCert. On a clinical electrocardiogram task with a staged, cost-ordered lead protocol, the deployed policy answers 71.2% of held-out patients, with an observed 7.4% disagreement with the cardiologist's diagnosis at 48.8% of the prespecified ordinal cost of acquiring each stage, and all three acquisition stages are validated separately. On masked multimodal benchmarks, validating pointwise at each terminal pattern holds observed worst-pattern selective risk, measured against the full-information reference decision rather than the true label, at 0.034, where a pooled design reaches 0.145 against a 0.10 cap, at a comparable answered fraction (0.350 vs 0.342); under the budget-matched simultaneous comparison, the answered fraction falls to 0.305.

papers.abstract: Generative Vision-Language Models (VLMs) express bounding boxes as coordinate sequences, whose token identities often leave axis and place value implicit. We study how explicitly encoding these roles improves visual grounding. Hi-Token assigns a distinct token to each combination of axis, decimal place, and digit value, representing a box with 12 tokens drawn from 60 types. This design exposes coarse-to-fine coordinate structure and increases token reuse relative to atomic location tokens while retaining the existing VLM architecture. Hi-GAR complements this representation with a geometry-based reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), combining box overlap, coordinate accuracy at multiple scales, strict-IoU bonuses, and validity gating. Matched training comparisons show that Hi-Token improves localization throughout the evaluated IoU range, with gains across three VLM backbones. Hi-Token also outperforms an additionally tuned atomic-token baseline on the RefCOCO family before reinforcement learning. Hi-GAR further improves localization and is used only during training. The resulting Hi-R1 model achieves higher values than strong specialist baselines on most reported metrics. Token-frequency and geometric diagnostics characterize the representation and reward stages. These results establish explicit axis and place-value encoding as an effective design for generative visual grounding. Project page: https://xyzzzh.github.io/Hi-Token/

analysis.key_results: 在匹配训练比较中，Hi-Token 提升了整个 IoU 范围内的定位性能，在三个 VLM 骨干上均有提升，并在 RefCOCO 系列上优于原子令牌基线；Hi-GAR 进一步提升定位性能且仅用于训练，所得 Hi-R1 模型在多数报告指标上超过强专家基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Hi-Token，一种将边界框坐标分解为轴、小数位和数字值的分层令牌化方案，并配合基于几何奖励的 Hi-GAR 强化学习策略。
analysis.method: Hi-Token 将每个框表示为 12 个从 60 种类型中抽取的令牌；Hi-GAR 结合框重叠、多尺度坐标精度、严格 IoU 奖励和有效性门控进行 GRPO 训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过显式编码坐标的轴、小数位和数字值，Hi-Token 将边界框表示为 60 种令牌中的 12 个令牌，以改进生成式视觉定位。

papers.abstract: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its predecessors. Such independently sampled marginals tend to produce sequences with tokens that are individually likely, but jointly improbable under the target model's distribution, which verifies each token conditionally. This can cause early rejection and limits acceptance length. To address this, we propose xPress as a means to restore the missing causality in diffusion drafters. xPress is a lightweight causal refiner that reconciles the whole diffusion block at once through parallel refinement, restoring and propagating causal dependencies across the draft without a token-by-token loop. On Qwen3-8B, across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, xPress raises acceptance length by about 30% on average (up to +56%) and its end-to-end decoding throughput by about 1.3 on average (up to 1.7) compared to the original dFlash diffusion drafter.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-8B上，七个数学、代码和聊天基准测试中，接受长度平均提升约30%（最高+56%），端到端解码吞吐量平均提升约1.3倍（最高1.7倍），相较于原始dFlash扩散起草器。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出XPress，一种轻量级因果细化器，通过并行细化恢复扩散起草器中缺失的因果依赖，提高接受长度和端到端解码吞吐量。
analysis.method: XPress并行细化器，一次性协调整个扩散块，恢复并传播草稿中的因果依赖，无需逐token循环。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出XPress，通过并行细化恢复扩散起草器缺失的因果性，从而提升推测解码的接受长度和吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于推测解码效率优化，未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但所提出的并行细化方法可潜在提升机器人和具身模型中自回归解码的效率。

papers.abstract: Natural language interaction provides an intuitive way for non-expert users to communicate with robotic platforms. However, transforming user requests into executable navigation actions remains a challenging task, requiring the integration of language understanding, environment perception, and autonomous navigation. This work presents a language-driven navigation framework that enables mobile robots to interpret user requests in natural language to move the robot to a destination and autonomously navigate towards it. The framework is composed of modular ROS 2 components that cooperate to transform natural language instructions into navigation actions. Given a natural language request referring to a target in the environment (e.g., "go to the mail box"), the system identifies the referenced object, estimates its position using RGB-D data, and generates a navigation goal, which is then executed through the ROS 2 Nav2 navigation stack. The ROS 2-based implementation facilitates portability across different robotic platforms, requiring only the configuration of the corresponding topics and services. The system is evaluated in both simulation and real-world scenarios using a TurtleBot3 Waffle and a Unitree Go2 robot with a RealSense camera. Experimental results show that the framework successfully interprets both direct commands and contextual requests, generates meaningful natural-language feedback, and navigates towards the desired target. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining semantic perception and autonomous navigation to provide an intuitive human-robot interaction paradigm. Code will be released as open source upon acceptance.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实场景（TurtleBot3 Waffle和Unitree Go2）中验证了框架能解释直接命令和上下文请求，并生成有意义的自然语言反馈。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个模块化的ROS 2框架，结合视觉-语言理解和RGB-D感知，将自然语言指令转换为自主导航动作。
analysis.method: 使用ROS 2模块，通过自然语言理解、RGB-D物体定位和Nav2导航栈实现从语言到导航目标的转换。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种基于ROS 2的移动机器人语言驱动导航框架，将自然语言指令转化为导航目标。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）在移动机器人导航中的应用，虽然侧重于导航而非操作，但涉及语言指令到机器人动作的映射，与本站的VLA主题相关。

papers.abstract: In open large language model (LLM) ecosystems, models are frequently adapted across multiple domains and applications, forming multi-stage derivation chains. Consequently, tracking and verifying historical contributions is essential for model provenance and intellectual property protection. However, existing watermarking methods are mainly designed for single-user, one-time embeddings, often fail under repeated model derivation and incremental updates. To address this problem, we propose LineageMark, a multi-user white-box watermarking framework for model derivation chains. The framework encodes watermarks in model parameters using a projection-based approach. Stable carriers are first selected to reduce sensitivity to model changes, each watermark bit is then represented as a projection statistic over these carriers. Additional watermark insertions introduce only bounded perturbations in the projection space, and margin constraints are used to maintain signal integrity. We evaluate the effectiveness of LineageMark in multi-stage model derivation chains. Experimental results show that LineageMark preserves contributor watermarks across multi-stage derivation and supports incremental multi-user watermark insertion. Furthermore, it exhibits robustness against perturbations such as re-watermarking, fine-tuning, quantization, and pruning.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明LineageMark在多阶段派生中保留贡献者水印，支持增量插入，并对重新水印、微调、量化和剪枝具有鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LineageMark框架，用于在模型派生链中实现多用户白盒水印，以追踪和验证历史贡献。
analysis.method: 采用基于投影的方法，在稳定载波上编码水印位，并使用边际约束保证信号完整性，支持增量多用户插入。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出LineageMark，一种用于大型语言模型多阶段派生链中多用户白盒水印追踪贡献的框架，可对抗包括量化在内的各种扰动。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM模型水印，不直接涉及VLA或世界模型；但其对量化扰动的鲁棒性与模型量化技术相关，对本站主题的量化方向具有方法参考价值。

papers.title: LineageMark: Multi-user White-box Watermarking for Contribution Tracing in Model Derivation Chains

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上达到98.6%成功率，在RoboTwin上达到91.22%成功率，并在真实世界操作任务中取得有竞争力的效果；每块动作预测耗时187毫秒，延迟比像素空间世界行动模型低高达24倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出潜在世界行动模型（LaWAM），利用潜在空间中的潜在行动条件世界模型（LaWM），通过预测潜在视觉子目标而非完整视频来实现动态感知的机器人控制。
analysis.method: 在预训练视觉基础模型的潜在空间中训练潜在行动模型，重用其前向解码器预测未来观测特征，并基于预测的潜在视觉子目标条件生成机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LaWAM通过紧凑的潜在视觉子目标代替重建未来视频，将预测动态引入机器人策略，实现高效世界行动模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是提出一种高效的世界行动模型（WAM），通过潜在空间建模避免像素级视频生成，为机器人策略提供动态预测能力，直接推动VLA/WAM在机器人控制中的实际部署。

Stage 1 learns a latent-action-conditioned world model from visual transitions: an inverse-dynamics encoder infers latent actions, and the decoder is retained as LaWM to predict future observation features. Stage 2 integrates LaWM into a VLA policy: latent-action distillation teaches the policy to drive LaWM, whose predicted latent visual subgoal is passed to an Alternate-DiT action expert for subgoal-conditioned action generation.

papers.abstract: Force signals provide critical interaction cues for contact-rich robotic manipulation. However, existing methods mostly use force as an additional observation modality, without fully exploiting its role in modeling future interaction dynamics or guiding execution-time feedback correction. In this paper, we propose FAWAM, a force-aware world action model that incorporates force information at three levels: perception, prediction, and closed-loop execution. FAWAM first encodes historical 6-axis force/torque signals to modulate action generation, then jointly predicts future actions and end-effector wrenches to explicitly model contact evolution. It further introduces a residual correction module that uses the predicted wrench trajectory as an execution-time reference to refine actions online based on real-time force feedback. Real-world experiments across multiple contact-rich tasks show that FAWAM improves the average success rate by 36.25% over vision-only baselines and 21.25% over existing force-aware baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our force-aware framework for robust contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在多个接触丰富任务上，平均成功率较仅视觉基线提高36.25%，较现有力感知基线提高21.25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FAWAM框架，通过历史力/力矩编码调制动作生成、联合预测未来动作与末端力/力矩以显式建模接触演化，并引入残差校正模块利用实时力反馈在线细化动作。
analysis.method: 在感知层编码历史6轴力/力矩信号调制动作生成；在预测层联合预测未来动作和末端力/力矩；在执行层使用预测力/力矩轨迹作为参考，结合实时力反馈进行残差校正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种力感知世界动作模型FAWAM，在感知、预测和闭环执行三个层次融入力信息，以提升接触丰富操作任务的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接提出世界动作模型（WAM），并将力信号引入世界建模、动作预测与闭环执行，属于机器人世界模型范畴，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used to provide predictive visual representations, yet it remains unclear which pretraining signals induce action-relevant structure in their latent spaces. We study this question through a unified probe-based evaluation across diverse encoder families, including image-only self-supervision, video pretraining with and without latent prediction, reconstruction-based autoencoders, diffusion models, and shortcut-forcing dynamics models. Using a common inverse-dynamics probing objective, we find that action-relevant structure is driven primarily by temporal video pretraining rather than pixel reconstruction fidelity: models with strong pixel decoding quality can exhibit near-zero action recoverability, while video-pretrained self-supervised encoders consistently achieve the best Pareto trade-off between visual fidelity and action prediction. Comparing V-JEPA and VideoMAE further shows that most gains arise from natural-video temporal context, with feature-level latent prediction providing a smaller additional benefit. These trends transfer across robotic benchmarks, though CALVIN reveals that static-environment tasks can partially mask the importance of temporal structure by allowing strong image priors to suffice. Finally, inverse-dynamics supervision substantially improves robustness to visual corruption, suggesting that action-aware objectives regularize latent geometry beyond clean-setting performance. Our results identify temporal predictive structure -- not reconstruction fidelity -- as the primary ingredient underlying action-relevant video representations.

analysis.key_results: 时序视频预训练是动作相关结构的主要驱动力；视频预训练的自监督编码器在视觉保真度与动作预测之间取得最佳Pareto权衡；V-JEPA与VideoMAE的对比表明大部分增益来自自然视频时序上下文，潜预测仅提供小幅额外增益；逆动力学监督显著提高对视觉损坏的鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 识别出时序预测结构（而非重建保真度）是视频表示与动作相关的核心因素，并系统比较了多种预训练编码器在动作可恢复性与视觉保真度之间的权衡。
analysis.method: 使用统一的逆动力学探针，对图像自监督、视频预训练（含/不含潜预测）、重建自编码器、扩散模型和捷径强制动力学模型等多种编码器家族进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过统一探针评估多种编码器，发现视频世界模型潜空间中的动作相关结构主要来源于时序视频预训练，而非像素重建质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究视频世界模型潜空间的动作相关性，对WAM中哪些预训练信号能产生有利于机器人控制的表示具有直接指导意义；实验包含CALVIN等机器人基准，并指出静态环境任务可能掩盖时序结构的重要性。

papers.title: What Makes Video World Model Latents Action-Relevant: Prediction over Reconstruction

papers.abstract: World models enable intelligent agents to predict the consequences of their actions on the environment. In this paper, we propose Multi Rigid Object Gaussian World Model (MRO-GWM), a novel model that learns action-conditional dynamics of rigid objects in 3D. Using object-centric Gaussians, we can represent arbitrary object shapes and multi-object scenes. We develop a novel temporal-spatial transformer architecture that predicts future rigid body motion from a history of object Gaussians and future actions. Objects are represented by Gaussians in an object-centric frame, which allows to describe object motion as a rigid body transformation. Our model is trained on reconstructions from multiple viewpoints, which requires the model to also handle partial observations of objects due to occlusions. We analyze prediction performance of our approach on synthetic datasets composed of typical household objects with multi-object dynamics and interactions by a robot end effector. We also evaluate our model in model-predictive control for non-prehensile manipulation in simulation and for image-based tracking and prediction of object motion in simulated and real-world scenes.

analysis.key_results: 在由典型家用物品组成的合成数据集上分析了预测性能；在非抓取操作的模型预测控制仿真中评估，并在模拟和真实场景中评估基于图像的对象运动跟踪与预测。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Multi Rigid Object Gaussian World Model (MRO-GWM)，一种学习刚体对象动作条件动态的新模型，可表示任意对象形状和多对象场景。
analysis.method: 使用对象中心高斯表示对象，并通过新型时空交叉注意力变换器从历史对象高斯和未来动作预测未来刚体运动；训练时使用多视角重建，处理遮挡造成的部分观测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 MRO-GWM，利用对象中心高斯表示学习刚体对象的动作条件三维世界模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接致力于机器人世界建模，使用高斯泼溅表示和动作条件预测，属于世界模型核心主题，对机器人操作和基于模型的策略学习具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Block-diffusion drafters have recently emerged as a powerful alternative for speculative decoding by predicting multiple future-token distributions in a single parallel step. However, since these parallel predictions are sampled from position-wise marginals rather than fully conditioned sequences, committing to a single greedy path often fails to capture the target model's preferred trajectory. To address this, we propose BASTION, a budget-aware speculative decoding framework with tree-based diffusion drafting. Unlike existing methods that rely on static tree topologies, BASTION dynamically constructs query-dependent trees by balancing draft quality against hardware constraints. Our framework integrates three synergistic components: (1) an acceptance surrogate that estimates expected accepted length via path confidence, (2) an online latency estimator that calibrates a hardware-aware roofline model, and (3) an adaptive best-first expansion that grows the tree until marginal gains no longer justify incremental verification costs. BASTION is training-free, preserves the target model's distribution, and requires no per-setting tuning. Across diverse benchmarks and GPU architectures, BASTION achieves up to a $6.61\times$ speedup over standard autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art block-diffusion baselines by 39%.

analysis.key_results: 在多样化基准和GPU架构上，相对标准自回归解码实现高达6.61倍加速，优于现有最佳块扩散基线39%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出预算感知的推测解码框架BASTION，通过树结构块扩散草案动态构建查询相关树，平衡草案质量与硬件约束。
analysis.method: 集成接受代理、在线延迟估计器和自适应最佳优先扩展，动态构建查询相关树，训练免调且无需每设置调优。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了一种预算感知的推测解码框架BASTION，通过树结构块扩散草案动态构建查询相关树，在保留目标模型分布的同时实现显著的加速。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于推测解码技术，未直接涉及VLA或WAM。但该技术可潜在应用于机器人策略模型的自回归推理加速，具有方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable agents to plan in latent space by imagining the outcomes of candidate actions, yet task specification remains a bottleneck. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on distinct large generative models. We introduce LAGO (Latent Goal Prediction from Language), a hierarchical world model in which a single predictor both forecasts action-conditioned dynamics and grounds language instructions as sequences of intermediate latent subgoals, training both modes with a single regression objective over a shared latent space. At each planning step, LAGO predicts a sequence of latent subgoals from a language instruction and optimizes an action sequence using a soft-minimum alignment cost that rewards subgoal proximity without enforcing a rigid path. Subgoals are repredicted as the agent's state evolves, turning a single long-horizon instruction into a sequence of locally tractable objectives. Across environments spanning navigation and manipulation, LAGO outperforms flat and hierarchical image-goal planners, with the largest gains on long-horizon navigation with curved, hazard-constrained paths, where it more than doubles the success rate of a goal-conditioned behavior cloning policy trained on the same demonstrations. Grounding language in the world model's own latent space also outperforms vision-language reward models, including one that plans with ground-truth dynamics.

papers.abstract: World models have emerged as a central paradigm for embodied intelligence, enabling agents to predict action-conditioned future and reason about environmental dynamics. However, existing embodied world model benchmarks are still largely confined to vision-only prediction, offline embodied applications, and simulator-based evaluation, making them insufficient for assessing increasingly comprehensive world models. In this work, we introduce WorldArena 2.0, an expanded benchmark that systematically broadens embodied world model evaluation along three dimensions: modality, functionality, and platform. Along the modality dimension, WorldArena 2.0 extends evaluation from vision-only to visuotactile modalities, enabling assessment of multimodal perception and prediction. Along the functionality dimension, it extends beyond policy evaluation and planning to assess world models as interactive RL environments for policy optimization. Along the platform dimension, it moves beyond simulator-only evaluation to a diverse suite of simulated and real-world robotic settings across multiple embodiments. Under a standardized protocol, WorldArena 2.0 comprehensively evaluates perceptual quality, interactive utility, and cross-platform performance, providing a comprehensive testbed for tracking progress toward embodied world models. The project page including codes and demos is available at: https://world-arena.ai/.

papers.abstract: Large language model-driven multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) excel at complex tasks, yet unreliable agents remain a key bottleneck to system-level reliability. Automatic failure attribution is therefore critical, but existing approaches, such as direct prediction of agent-error pairs and agent-first failure attribution, rely on local logs of agents and miss global failures that only manifest over full interaction trajectories, such as cross-step inconsistencies and inter-agent coordination errors. Moreover, directly predicting failures induces a large combinatorial search space, hindering fine-grained attribution. To address these challenges, we propose VerifyMAS, a hypothesis verification framework for agent failure attribution. Instead of directly predicting faulty agents and error types, VerifyMAS formulates and verifies failure hypotheses against full trajectories. This verification-based approach decomposes attribution into trajectory-level error validation and fine-grained agent localization, providing an error-first attribution approach that captures global failure patterns while substantially reducing the search space. We further introduce a hypothesis-based data construction strategy grounded in a structured error taxonomy and fine-tune a specialized LLM verifier model for trajectory-level failure verification and agent attribution. Experiments on Aegis-Bench and Who&When show that VerifyMAS consistently improves diverse backbone models, including open-source Qwen and API-based GPT models, outperforming prior methods without sacrificing inference efficiency for long multi-agent trajectories.

analysis.key_results: 在Aegis-Bench和Who&When上，VerifyMAS持续改进多种骨干模型（包括Qwen和GPT），优于先前方法，且不牺牲长轨迹推理效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VerifyMAS，一种基于假设验证的故障归因框架，将归因分解为轨迹级错误验证和细粒度智能体定位，并构建假设驱动数据微调专用验证模型。
analysis.method: 假设验证：先验证轨迹级失败假设，再进行代理定位；基于结构化错误分类构建数据并微调LLM验证器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种假设验证框架，通过轨迹级错误验证和细粒度智能体定位来改进LLM多智能体系统的故障归因。

papers.abstract: Recent feed-forward reconstruction models, such as VGGT, have proven competitive with traditional optimization-based reconstructors while also providing geometry-aware features useful for other tasks. Here, we show that the quality of these models scales predictably with model and data size. We do so by introducing VGGT-$\Omega$, which substantially improves reconstruction accuracy, efficiency, and capabilities for both static and dynamic scenes. To enable training this model at an unprecedented scale, we introduce architectural changes that improve training efficiency, a high-quality data annotation pipeline that supports dynamic scenes, and a self-supervised learning protocol. We simplify VGGT's architecture by using a single dense prediction head with multi-task supervision and removing the expensive high-resolution convolutional layers. We also use registers to aggregate scene information into a compact representation and introduce register attention, which restricts inter-frame information exchange to these registers, in part replacing global attention. In this way, during training, VGGT-$\Omega$ uses only about 30% of the GPU memory of its predecessor, allowing us to train with 15x more supervised data than prior work and to leverage vast amounts of unlabeled video data. VGGT-$\Omega$ achieves strong results for reconstruction of static and dynamic scenes across multiple benchmarks, for example, improving over the previous best camera estimation accuracy on Sintel by 77%. We also show that the learned registers can improve vision-language-action models and support alignment with language, suggesting that reconstruction can be a powerful and scalable proxy task for spatial understanding. Project Page: http://vggt-omega.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 训练GPU内存降至约30%，监督数据量扩大15倍；在Sintel上相机估计精度提升77%；学习到的寄存器可改进视觉-语言-动作模型并支持语言对齐。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle in long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation because success-only imitation provides little supervision for execution drift, while failed rollouts are often discarded. We introduce RePO-VLA, a recovery-driven policy optimization framework that assigns distinct roles to success, recovery, and failure trajectories. RePO-VLA first applies Recovery-Aware Initialization (RAI), slicing each corrective suffix into a new episode so corrective actions depend on the current adverse state rather than the preceding failure. It then learns a Progress-Aware Semantic Value Function (PAS-VF), aligning spatiotemporal trajectory features with instructions and successful references. The resulting labels salvage useful failure prefixes via reliability decay, while low-value labels mark drift and terminal breakdowns, teaching differences among nominal, failed, and corrective actions. The data engine turns adverse states into planner-generated or human-collected corrective rollouts, teaching recovery to the success manifold. Value-Conditioned Refinement (VCR) trains the policy to prefer high-progress actions. At deployment, a fixed high-value token biases actions toward the learned success manifold without online failure detectors or heuristic retries. We introduce the Failure-Recovery Benchmark (FRBench), with standardized error injection and recovery-focused evaluation. Across simulated and real-world bimanual tasks, RePO-VLA improves robustness, raising adversarial success from 20% to 75% on average and up to 80% in scaled real-world trials. Code and video results are available at https://1018weijia.github.io/RePO-VLA-Web/.

papers.abstract: Dexterous robotic hands require high-speed multimodal sensing across many degrees of freedom, yet existing readout architectures often impose trade-offs between sensor count, wiring complexity, and sampling bandwidth. This paper presents a scalable analog sensor readout architecture based on a serial-in parallel-out (SIPO) shift-register principle. The proposed architecture supports versatile integration of heterogeneous analog-output sensors, scalable expansion using only three signal lines between sensor modules, and fast, configurable sampling. We validate the approach on a tendon-driven robotic hand integrating 16 joint sensor modules and one four-channel tactile sensor module, enabling acquisition of 20 sensor channels at a full-scan rate of 1 kHz, with stable operation up to 1.5 kHz. Joint sensor characterization showed a maximum slope absolute percentage error (APE) of 0.446% and sub-degree estimation error, indicating that the proposed readout system preserves sensing performance. For tactile sensing, LSTM-based models enabled real-time force estimation and contact-location classification at 1 kHz. System-level experiments showed that the joint sensors provided more accurate feedback than motor-based estimation during interaction. Closed-loop experiments further demonstrated improved joint trajectory tracking using joint-sensor feedback and force-controlled object pinching using tactile feedback. The proposed architecture offers a practical path toward sensorized robotic hands for dexterous manipulation.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic controllers that map visual observations and language instructions to continuous actions. However, pretrained VLAs typically provide limited information about the reliability of their generated actions, making deployment challenging when execution failures must be anticipated. We address this problem by introducing SentryVLA, a lightweight runtime wrapper for frozen VLA policies. At the action level, SentryVLA uses conformalized quantile regression to estimate a calibrated upper bound on the deviation between sampled VLA actions and expert-like behavior under the calibration distribution. The predicted deviation is then used to rank multiple stochastic candidates for action selection. At the execution-monitoring level, SentryVLA applies a Mahalanobis-distance-based anomaly score to the contextualized latent execution state extracted before final action prediction, providing a complementary signal for detecting abnormal execution states during closed-loop control. The framework does not require retraining or architectural modification of the underlying VLA policy. Experiments in simulation and on a physical robot show that SentryVLA improves action selection and provides useful runtime warning signals for abnormal execution states. These findings demonstrate the practical value of post-hoc reliability scoring for improving the runtime behavior of pretrained VLA policies. Project webpage: https://robotic-vision-lab.github.io/sentryvla/.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和实体机器人上的实验表明，SentryVLA改善了动作选择，并为异常执行状态提供了有用的运行时警告信号。

papers.abstract: Transformers achieve state-of-the-art performance in language processing and computer vision. Their computation increasingly depends on hardware that can keep pace not only with large matrix multiplications, but also with nonlinear operations like Softmax within the core attention mechanism. On digital accelerators, Softmax accounts for only a small fraction of total operations, yet it can disproportionately impact overall inference latency. Here, we use thin-film lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZM) as analog computing elements for low-latency Transformer attention. Our high-speed nonlinearities based on the intrinsic sinusoidal MZM response achieve performance close to digital baselines in Vision Transformers and GPT-2, even under 4-bit input and output quantization. We experimentally characterize the electro-optic response at symbol rates up to 10 GBaud and assess model robustness under corresponding noise conditions. Accounting for the full signal chain, our analysis indicates more than an order of magnitude lower latency relative to previous custom electronic and photonic Softmax implementations. These results establish analog electro-optic devices as nonlinear function units well suited for integration into emerging co-packaged electronic-photonic hardware, offering a path toward high-speed Transformer inference.

analysis.key_results: 在Vision Transformer和GPT-2上，模拟电光非线性单元在4比特量化下实现接近数字基线的性能；相比先前定制电子和光子Softmax实现，延迟降低超过一个数量级。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实验验证了基于薄膜铌酸锂MZM的模拟电光非线性单元，用于加速Transformer注意力中的Softmax计算，实现超过先前定制电子和光子Softmax实现一个数量级的延迟降低。
analysis.method: 利用薄膜铌酸锂马赫-曾德尔调制器的固有正弦响应作为模拟非线性函数，在Transformer注意力中实现Softmax，并支持4比特输入输出量化；实验表征了高达10 GBaud符号率下的电光响应及噪声鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 利用薄膜铌酸锂马赫-曾德尔调制器作为模拟计算单元，实现低延迟Transformer注意力中的Softmax非线性操作，并展示在4比特量化下接近数字基线的性能。

papers.abstract: A fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy can easily place the alphabet soup in the basket on command, just as it saw during fine-tuning. However, if the basket is shifted five centimeters to the left, it drops the soup off the table. We developed an interpretability pipeline to investigate what such a policy is computing. Injecting task A's activations into the action expert while the policy looks at task B's scene makes pi0.5 execute task A's motor trajectory in 99.6\% of episodes ($n{=}1{,}968$). The injected program is bound to absolute workspace coordinates and ignores the visible scene, which provides a mechanistic account of the perturbation brittleness that concurrent benchmarks report. The binding holds on a physical UR10e: directed replay redirects the commanded task in 26/26 rollouts in one direction and 18/26 in the other, with no-injection and random-direction controls at the floor, and once the source object is moved 10--15\,cm the arm grasps and releases at the recorded coordinates in 50/50 trials, picking up the wrong block when one sits there and closing on empty air when none does. Applying the same interventions to six VLAs on LIBERO, MetaWorld, SimplerEnv, and ALOHA over 420{,}000+ rollouts yields three further findings: every architecture encodes the instruction, and four of the five weight it below vision whenever the scene alone identifies the goal; under the standard replacement write-back the SAE pooling that preserves behavior is architecture-specific (pi0.5 per-token, SmolVLA indifferent), and goal selection and motor generation separate into VLM and expert pathways wherever the two are distinguishable. We release \textbf{Action Atlas} (https://action-atlas.com), an interactive platform covering all 520+ trained SAEs, 79 identified concepts, and the scored UR10e rollouts. Code: https://github.com/CWRU-AISM/action-atlas

analysis.key_results: 注入任务A激活后，pi0.5在99.6%的回合中执行任务A轨迹；物理UR10e上重放成功率26/26（一方向）和18/26（另一方向）；源物体移动10-15cm后，50/50次在录制坐标抓取释放；在LIBERO、MetaWorld、SimplerEnv、ALOHA上超过420,000次rollout验证了多个架构特异性发现。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一套可解释性流程，能够将任务A的激活注入动作专家，使策略在任务B场景下执行任务A的电机轨迹，并系统揭示了VLA策略对绝对坐标的依赖及架构特异性。
analysis.method: 通过将任务A的中间激活注入动作专家，结合场景观察与干预实验，分析VLA策略的内部计算机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过可解释性流程揭示VLA策略将任务A的激活注入动作专家后，会在绝对工作空间坐标下执行A的电机轨迹，并泛化到多个VLA架构。

papers.abstract: Museum audiovisual archives are important records of visual culture, yet in-gallery video remains difficult to search because it lacks catalogue-compatible metadata. We propose CaGMulA, catalogue-grounded multimodal attribution for museum video: a locally deployable pipeline that combines video-language models, structured catalogue retrieval, and abstention-aware decision policies. The system summarises visible artworks, generates catalogue-style descriptions, and attributes title and artist only when evidence is sufficient. We evaluate VideoLLaMA2 and Qwen2-VL across four model configurations and four attribution modes on 18 in-gallery videos. Open-ended generation fails under conservative conditions, producing 0\% coverage across models. By contrast, closed-set catalogue retrieval reaches 100\% coverage with 62\% accepted title--artist correctness, while a verifier-gated hybrid mode reduces coverage to 50\% but improves accepted correctness to 78\%. The results show that reliable museum-video attribution is driven less by unrestricted generation than by catalogue grounding, visual retrieval, and selective abstention for curatorial review.

analysis.key_results: 开放生成覆盖率为0%；闭集目录检索覆盖率达100%，接受正确率62%；验证器门控混合模式覆盖率降至50%，接受正确率提升至78%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CaGMulA流程，通过目录检索与选择性弃权提升博物馆视频归属的可靠性，并实证对比开放生成、闭集检索与验证器门控混合模式。
analysis.method: 结合视频-语言模型（VideoLLaMA2、Qwen2-VL）、结构化目录检索和弃权感知决策策略，在18个馆内视频上评估四种模型配置与四种归属模式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一个可本地部署的博物馆视频归属流程，结合视频-语言模型、结构化目录检索与弃权决策，在资源受限下实现可靠的作品识别。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦视觉-语言模型在资源受限下的高效推理与选择性弃权，属于通用的高效推理方法，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型，但与本站关注的模型效率主题有一定方法学关联。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models combine multimodal perception with robotic control, demonstrating remarkable potential for generalizable manipulation. Yet, enhancing their execution typically relies on auxiliary sensory inputs (e.g., depth, 3D point clouds) or costly fine-tuning. Inspired by the insight that Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) act as key-value memory, we propose Action-Entropy-Weighted and Attention-Guided Retrieval of Observation Evidence (AWARE), an effective, training-free, and plug-and-play module for VLAs. Specifically, AWARE tracks layer-wise uncertainty via an element-wise Action Entropy metric, and retrieves observation evidence into the element's FFN through associative memory lookup. Crucially, the retrieved features are weighted by instruction-guided cross-modal attention to isolate task-relevant observation cues, while injection strength is adaptively scaled by the element's entropy and relative network depth. This selectively channels observation evidence to high-entropy action dimensions and deep layers where grounding decays, while leaving converged representations intact. Across LIBERO, SIMPLER, CALVIN, and real-world robot manipulation, AWARE consistently improves diverse VLA architectures with minimal computational overhead, achieving the largest gains on long-horizon tasks without architectural changes or additional training. Project page: https://jiabingyang01.github.io/AWARE/.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER、CALVIN和真实世界机器人操控中，AWARE一致地提升了多种VLA架构，计算开销极小，在长程任务上增益最大。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AWARE，一个有效、免训练、即插即用的VLA模块，利用FFN的关键-值记忆特性，通过动作熵加权和注意力引导的检索机制增强任务相关的观测证据注入。
analysis.method: AWARE跟踪逐层动作熵不确定性，通过联想记忆查找将观测证据检索到FFN中，并用指令引导的跨模态注意力加权检索特征，自适应调节注入强度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种免训练、即插即用的模块AWARE，通过动作熵加权和注意力引导的观测证据检索来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的操控性能，尤其是在长程任务上。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理增强，通过高效、免训练的方式改进机器人操控策略，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: The pursuit of general-purpose robotic manipulation is hindered by the scarcity of diverse, real-world interaction data. Unlike large-scale web vision-language data, robotic data collection incurs prohibitive physical costs. The key challenge is thus not merely to collect more robot data, but to obtain informative training data that broadens behavioral coverage across objects, scenes, and skills. Yet automatically curating task proposals to maximize the utility of collected data remains under-explored. We introduce RoboGene, an agentic framework for generating diverse, informative manipulation tasks across single-arm, dual-arm, and mobile robots. RoboGene combines (1) diversity-driven sampling for broad task coverage, (2) agentic self-reflection for task-quality assessment, and (3) human-verified feedback memory for execution-grounded validation and continual refinement. Through quantitative analysis and large-scale real-world experiments, we collect 18k trajectories and introduce metrics for task feasibility and diversity. RoboGene significantly outperforms frontier foundation models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro. VLA models trained on RoboGene-generated data achieve higher success rates and stronger generalization, highlighting the value of high-quality task generation. Project page: https://robogene-boost-vla.github.io/. Datasets: Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/X-Humanoid/RoboGene) and ModelScope (https://modelscope.cn/datasets/X-Humanoid/RoboGene_tasks).

analysis.key_results: RoboGene在任务可行性和多样性指标上显著优于GPT-4o和Gemini 2.5 Pro；基于RoboGene数据训练的VLA模型成功率更高，泛化能力更强。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoboGene框架，通过多样性采样、智能体自我反思和人类验证反馈记忆，自动生成高质量机器人操作任务，提高VLA预训练数据的覆盖率和有效性。
analysis.method: 多样性驱动采样、智能体自我反思、人类验证反馈记忆，以及通过大规模真实世界实验收集18k条轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RoboGene是一个用于生成多样化、信息丰富的机器人操作任务的智能体框架，旨在提升VLA模型的预训练数据质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接服务于VLA模型预训练，通过生成高质量多样化任务数据提升VLA模型的性能和泛化能力，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Post-training compression of transformer models commonly relies on truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) strategies leading to low-rank approximations of the original model weights. However, the underlying single shared subspace modeling can degrade accuracy even at moderate compression. Sparse dictionary learning provides a more flexible union-of-subspaces representation, but existing approaches often suffer from costly iterative dictionary and coefficient updates. We propose $\textbf{COMPOT}$ ($\textbf{C}$alibration-$\textbf{O}$ptimized $\textbf{M}$atrix $\textbf{P}$rocrustes $\textbf{O}$rthogonalization for $\textbf{T}$ransformers), a training-free compression framework that uses a small calibration dataset to estimate a sparse weight factorization. COMPOT employs orthogonal dictionaries that enable closed-form Procrustes updates for the dictionary and analytical single-step sparse coding for the coefficients, reducing significantly the overall optimization cost. To handle heterogeneous layer sensitivity under a global compression budget, COMPOT further introduces a one-shot dynamic allocation strategy that adaptively redistributes layer-wise compression rates. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures and tasks show that COMPOT consistently delivers a superior quality-compression trade-off over strong low-rank and sparse baselines, while remaining fully compatible with post-training quantization for extreme compression.

analysis.key_results: 在多种架构和任务上的广泛实验表明，COMPOT在质量-压缩权衡上持续优于强低秩和稀疏基线，并且完全兼容训练后量化以实现极端压缩。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出COMPOT，一种训练无关压缩框架，利用小校准数据集估计稀疏权重分解，采用正交字典实现闭式Procrustes更新和一步稀疏编码，显著降低优化成本；并引入一次性动态分配策略自适应分配层压缩率，以处理全局压缩预算下的异构层敏感性。
analysis.method: COMPOT框架：使用校准数据集估计稀疏权重分解；采用正交字典的闭式Procrustes更新和分析性单步稀疏编码；引入一次性动态分配策略自适应分配层压缩率；可与训练后量化结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练无关的Transformer压缩框架COMPOT，利用稀疏字典学习和动态分层预算分配实现优于低秩和稀疏基线的质量-压缩权衡，并可与训练后量化结合。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文为独立的模型压缩方法，专注于Transformer的高效推理和量化，虽未直接涉及机器人或世界模型，但其训练无关的低秩稀疏压缩和量化兼容性对在资源受限机器人硬件上部署大型VLA/WAM模型具有重要借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence and large language models (LLMs) are transforming educational technology by enabling conversational tutoring, personalised explanations, and inquiry-driven learning. However, most AI-based learning systems rely on continuous internet connectivity and cloud-based computation, limiting their use in bandwidth-constrained environments. This paper presents Arapai, an offline-first large language model architecture designed for AI-assisted learning in low-connectivity settings. The system performs all inference locally using quantized language models and incorporates hardware-aware model selection to enable deployment on low-specification, CPU-only devices. By removing dependence on cloud infrastructure, the system provides curriculum-aligned explanations and structured academic support through natural-language interaction. To support learners at different educational stages, the system includes adaptive response levels that generate explanations at varying levels of complexity: Simple English, Lower Secondary, Upper Secondary, and Technical. The system was evaluated with 120 students and 9 instructors from secondary and tertiary institutions under limited-connectivity conditions. Results indicate stable operation on legacy hardware, acceptable response times of 1-3 seconds for typical queries, and positive user perceptions of its effectiveness in supporting self-directed learning.

analysis.key_results: 在120名学生和9名教师的评估中，系统在旧硬件上稳定运行，典型查询响应时间为1-3秒，用户对其支持自主学习的效果给予积极评价。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出离线优先的LLM架构Arapai，通过量化语言模型和硬件感知模型选择，在低连通性环境下实现本地推理和自适应教育支持。
analysis.method: 使用量化语言模型进行纯本地推理，结合硬件感知模型选择以适应低规格CPU设备，并设计自适应响应级别以生成不同复杂度的解释。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种离线优先的LLM架构Arapai，通过本地量化和硬件感知模型选择，在CPU-only的低规格设备上实现低连通性环境下的AI辅助学习。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于通过模型量化实现离线高效LLM推理，不涉及VLA/WAM或机器人领域，但量化技术对在机器人端侧部署VLA/WAM模型具有潜在的方法借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models can generate plausible end-effector motions, yet they often fail in long-horizon, contact-rich tasks because the underlying hand-object interaction (HOI) structure is not explicitly represented. An embodiment-agnostic interaction representation that captures this structure would make manipulation behaviors easier to validate and transfer across robots. We propose FlowHOI, a two-stage flow-matching framework that generates semantically grounded, temporally coherent HOI sequences, comprising hand poses, object poses, and hand-object contact states, conditioned on an egocentric observation, a language instruction, and a 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) scene reconstruction. We decouple geometry-centric grasping from semantics-centric manipulation, conditioning the latter on compact 3D scene tokens and employing a motion-text alignment loss to semantically ground the generated interactions in both the physical scene layout and the language instruction. To address the scarcity of high-fidelity HOI supervision, we introduce a reconstruction pipeline that recovers aligned hand-object trajectories and meshes from large-scale egocentric videos, yielding an HOI prior for robust generation. Across the GRAB and HOT3D benchmarks, FlowHOI achieves the highest action recognition accuracy and a 1.7$\times$ higher physics simulation success rate than the strongest diffusion-based baseline, while delivering a 40$\times$ inference speedup. We further demonstrate real-robot execution on four dexterous manipulation tasks, illustrating the feasibility of retargeting generated HOI representations to real-robot execution pipelines.

analysis.key_results: 在GRAB和HOT3D基准上，FlowHOI获得最高的动作识别准确率，物理模拟成功率比最强扩散基线高1.7倍，推理速度快40倍，并在四个灵巧操作任务上展示了真实机器人执行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlowHOI，一个两阶段流匹配框架，生成语义基础且时间连贯的手-物交互序列，显式表示手-物交互结构，并通过运动-文本对齐损失和3D场景标记实现语义基础。
analysis.method: 两阶段流匹配框架，解耦几何抓取和语义操作，以第一人称观察、语言指令和3D高斯场景重建为条件，使用3D场景标记和运动-文本对齐损失，以及从大型第一人称视频重建的HOI先验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FlowHOI提出一个两阶段流匹配框架，利用语义动作生成手-物交互（HOI）序列，以实现跨机器人、接触丰富的灵巧操作任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接改进VLA模型在灵巧机器人操作中的表现，通过显式表示手-物交互结构来弥补长程接触丰富任务的不足，生成的HOI表示可跨机器人重定向，属于VLA领域的核心贡献。

The generated motions can be retargeted to robot hands for real-world execution.

papers.abstract: Multimodal action understanding requires complementary sensory observations to be connected with structured semantic knowledge. This is particularly challenging in vehicle cabins, where fine-grained actions exhibit similar upper-body motion, relevant objects may be small or occluded, and appearance varies substantially across illumination conditions. Existing in-cabin datasets, however, rarely provide synchronized visual modalities together with dense object annotations and explicit action--object alignment, limiting the study of object-grounded multimodal recognition. To address this gap, we introduce the Driver Action with Object Synergy (DAOS) dataset, containing 9,787 video clips, 36 fine-grained actions, 15 object categories, and more than 2.5 million annotated object instances. DAOS provides synchronized RGB, infrared, and depth observations from four camera views, thereby combining complementary appearance, low-light, and geometric information. Building on DAOS, we propose the Action-Object-Relation Network (AOR-Net), a vision-language framework that organizes multimodal understanding at three semantic levels: action, object, and human-object relation. Its Chain-of-action Prompting mechanism progressively grounds global motion with localized object and relation cues, while a textual prototype bank supplies corresponding semantic descriptions. A Mixture of Thoughts module then dynamically selects and integrates the most informative semantic levels and visual modalities under object-rich and object-scarce conditions. Extensive experiments show that AOR-Net consistently outperforms strong baselines on DAOS, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining heterogeneous visual sensing with structured action-object-relation semantics for fine-grained multimodal video understanding.

analysis.key_results: AOR-Net 在 DAOS 上一致优于强基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 DAOS 数据集（9,787 视频片段、36 种细粒度动作、15 类物体、超 250 万物体实例标注），并提出 AOR-Net 视觉-语言框架。
analysis.method: AOR-Net 采用链式动作提示（Chain-of-action Prompting）逐步关联全局运动与局部物体和关系线索，并利用文本原型库及思想混合模块（Mixture of Thoughts）动态选择语义级别和视觉模态。

papers.abstract: Learning structured task representations from human demonstrations is essential for bimanual manipulation, where action ordering, object involvement, and interaction geometry vary significantly across executions. A key challenge lies in jointly capturing the discrete semantic task structure and the temporal evolution of object-centric geometric relations in a form that supports reasoning over task progression. We introduce a semantic-geometric graph-based task representation that jointly encodes object identities, inter-object semantic relations, and per-object motion histories, via a Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) encoder and a Transformer-based decoder. The encoder operates solely on the temporal scene graph, producing structured representations decoupled from action labels. The decoder then conditions on action-context to forecast future actions, associated objects, and object motions. This decoupling learns task-agnostic representations, enabling encoder reuse across embodiments through decoder-only finetuning on a small robot dataset. Across eleven bimanual tasks from two datasets, we find that the benefit of structured semantic--geometric representations over simpler sequence-based models grows with task variability in action ordering and object involvement. At deployment, a planner couples the action and motion predictions with learned Probabilistic Movement Primitives, achieving full task success on two real-robot bimanual tasks and outperforming graph ablations, Transformer, decoder-only, and finetuned vision-language model baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在十一个双臂任务中，结构化语义-几何表示相比简单序列模型在动作顺序和对象参与度变化时优势更明显；在真实机器人双臂任务上实现完全成功，并优于图消融、Transformer、仅解码器和微调视觉语言模型基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种语义-几何图任务表示，联合编码对象身份、语义关系和运动历史，实现任务无关的表示学习，支持跨具身迁移和机器人动作规划。
analysis.method: 使用消息传递神经网络（MPNN）编码时间场景图，Transformer解码器基于动作上下文预测未来动作、关联对象和对象运动；通过解耦表示和动作标签，实现编码器复用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种语义-几何图任务表示，通过MPNN编码器和Transformer解码器从人类演示中学习双臂操作的任务结构，并在真实机器人上实现动作规划。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable generalization by mapping web-scale knowledge to robotic control, yet they remain blind to physical contact. Consequently, they struggle with contact-rich manipulation tasks that require reasoning about force, texture, and slip. While some approaches incorporate low-dimensional tactile signals, they fail to capture the high-resolution dynamics essential for such interactions. To address this limitation, we introduce DreamTacVLA, a framework that grounds VLA models in contact physics by learning to feel the future. Our model adopts a hierarchical perception scheme in which high-resolution tactile images serve as micro-vision inputs coupled with wrist-camera local vision and third-person macro vision. To reconcile these multi-scale sensory streams, we first train a unified policy with a Hierarchical Spatial Alignment (HSA) loss that aligns tactile tokens with their spatial counterparts in the wrist and third-person views. To further deepen the model's understanding of fine-grained contact dynamics, we finetune the system with a tactile world model that predicts future tactile signals. To mitigate tactile data scarcity and the wear-prone nature of tactile sensors, we construct a hybrid large-scale dataset sourced from both high-fidelity digital twin and real-world experiments. By anticipating upcoming tactile states, DreamTacVLA acquires a rich model of contact physics and conditions its actions on both real observations and imagined consequences. Across contact-rich manipulation tasks, it outperforms state-of-the-art VLA baselines, achieving up to 95% success, highlighting the importance of understanding physical contact for robust, touch-aware robotic agents.

analysis.key_results: 在接触丰富操作任务上，超越最先进的VLA基线，成功率最高达95%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DreamTacVLA框架，将高分辨率触觉图像作为微视觉输入，与腕部相机局部视觉和第三人称宏观视觉结合，并通过预测未来触觉信号来深化模型对接触动态的理解，从而提升接触丰富操作任务的性能。
analysis.method: 采用层级感知方案，利用Hierarchical Spatial Alignment (HSA)损失对齐多尺度感觉流，先训练统一策略，再用触觉世界模型微调以预测未来触觉信号，并构建混合大规模数据集以缓解数据稀缺。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DreamTacVLA通过层级感知和对齐多尺度视觉触觉信息，并结合预测未来触觉状态的世界模型，增强了VLA模型在接触丰富操作任务中的表现。

papers.abstract: Diffusion Policy (DP) excels in embodied control but suffers from high inference latency and computational cost due to multiple iterative denoising steps. Existing diffusion model (DMs) acceleration methods improve inference speed by reducing computational overhead, as DMs for image generation are computation-bound. In this work, we reveal that DP are I/O bound, and thus propose using speculative decoding, a parallel computing framework, to accelerate DP for the first time. However, it is non-trivial to address the following challenges: (1) How to preserve the denoising quality of the base model at reduced computational cost under time-varying task difficulty in embodied settings; and (2) How to dynamically allocate computation according to task difficulty in such environments. Therefore, we propose Temporal-aware Reinforcement-based Speculative Diffusion Policy (TS-DP), the first framework that enables speculative decoding for DP with temporal adaptivity. First, to handle dynamic environments where task difficulty varies over time, we distill a Transformer-based drafter to imitate the base model and replace its costly denoising calls. Second, an RL-based scheduler further adapts to the time-varying task difficulty by adjusting speculative parameters to maintain accuracy while improving efficiency. Extensive experiments show that TS-DP achieves up to a 4.17x NFE reduction and a 3.2x wall-clock speedup with a draft acceptance rate of over 85% in simulation. Real-world experiments further demonstrate a 3.8x NFE reduction while improving success rates on real-time tasks (e.g., a 23% gain on the conveyor-belt task), reaching an inference frequency of 26 Hz and enabling real-time control while maintaining comparable task performance. The code is available at https://github.com/ChildTang/TS-DP.

analysis.key_results: 仿真中 NFE 降低最高 4.17 倍，墙钟时间加速 3.2 倍，草案接受率超过 85%；真实世界中 NFE 降低 3.8 倍，实时任务成功率提升（如传送带任务提升 23%），推理频率达 26 Hz。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 TS-DP 框架，首次将推测解码引入扩散策略，并通过蒸馏 Transformer 起草模型和 RL 调度器实现时序自适应，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
analysis.method: 蒸馏 Transformer 起草模型替代代价高昂的去噪调用；利用强化学习调度器动态调整推测参数以适应任务难度变化；采用推测解码并行计算框架加速扩散策略推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文首次将推测解码应用于扩散策略（DP）的加速，通过蒸馏起草模型和强化学习调度器实现时序自适应的高效推理，在仿真和真实机器人任务中显著降低计算量并提升实时性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对机器人操作中的扩散策略（DP）推理加速，属于高效推理与机器人策略学习的交叉，对 VLA/WAM 中基于扩散的动作生成模型具有直接借鉴意义。

figures.caption: Vanilla Diffusion Policy (DP) vs. Our TS-DP . For embodied tasks, DP completes a task through multiple interactions with the environment, generating several segments of actions. Each segment typically requires hundreds of model calls for denoising, making the process highly time-consuming. TS-DP introduces a customized speculative decoding framework for temporal-complexity-aware accelerating DP. A lightweight drafter generates multiple denoising results, which are verified in parallel by the DP for near-lossless acceleration. A scheduler further adjusts key speculative decoding parameters—such as the number of drafts and the acceptance rate—based on the complexity of different task phases, achieving adaptive and efficient acceleration.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: The framework of TS-DP . TS-DP is the first temporal-aware speculative decoding framework designed to accelerate Diffusion Policy. ① Decision stage: A PPO-based scheduler evaluates time-varying task difficulty using past observations and actions, and produces adaptive speculative parameters. It operates in parallel with the observation encoder, adding no extra inference latency. ② Denoising stage: Guided by the scheduler, a lightweight drafter executes multiple denoising steps sequentially, effectively replacing expensive DP calls and reducing computational load. ③ Verification stage: DP verifies all drafted steps in parallel, accepting those that pass validation and correcting the first rejected draft via reflection-maximal coupling to better align it with the target distribution. ④ Reward generation: Based on task progress, the framework provides process rewards that encourage the scheduler to produce more valid drafts, and a final success-driven reward upon task completion, jointly guiding the scheduler toward efficient and successful task execution.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Safeguarding the Intellectual Property (IP) of Large Language Models (LLMs) against model theft represents a critical challenge in contemporary AI research. Although fingerprinting is essential for establishing forensic evidence for model derivation, existing methods are susceptible to false claim attacks, weight manipulations, or high false positive rates, undermining their utility. To overcome these limitations, we propose SELF, \rev{a novel intrinsic weight-based fingerprinting scheme tailored for robust IP forensics via adversarial model lineage verification}. SELF eliminates dependency on input and inherently resists false claims, achieving robust \rev{provenance detection} through unique, scalable and transformation-invariant fingerprint extraction via singular value and eigenvalue decomposition of LLM attention weights. Experimental results demonstrate that SELF maintains high IP infringement detection accuracy while significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in reducing false positives and showing strong robustness against various downstream modifications, including quantization, pruning, and fine-tuning attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/HanxiuZhang/SELF_v4.

analysis.key_results: 实验结果表明 SELF 在保持高侵权检测准确率的同时，显著优于最先进基线，降低误报率，并对量化、剪枝、微调等下游修改表现出强鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种新的基于权重的内在指纹方案 SELF，通过奇异值和特征值分解提取独特、可扩展且变换不变的指纹，消除对输入的依赖并抵抗虚假声明攻击，实现强鲁棒性溯源。
analysis.method: 对 LLM 注意力权重进行奇异值和特征值分解，提取独特、可扩展且变换不变的指纹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 摘要介绍了一种基于大语言模型注意力权重奇异值和特征值分解的固有指纹方案，用于鲁棒的知识产权侵权检测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦于大语言模型指纹与知识产权保护，未涉及 VLA、世界模型或机器人学习；其与本站主题仅因涉及量化（下游修改攻击之一）而具有一般的推理效率关联，无直接 VLA/WAM 关系。
